segments_en: Zamʿah had a slave woman with whom he had relations, and he suspected another man of being with her. She gave birth to a child resembling the one he suspected. Zamʿah died while she was pregnant, and Sawdah mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The child belongs to the bed. Observe hijāb from him, O Sawdah, for he is not your brother."
label: machine translation

segments_en: While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a man came to him from Yemen and began informing him and telling him about ʿAlī. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, three men came to ʿAlī disputing over a child, [all of whom] had relations with a woman in one period of purity." And he related the rest of the hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was with the Prophet ﷺ, and ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, was in Yemen at that time. A man came to him and said, "I witnessed ʿAlī being brought three men who claimed the child of a woman. ʿAlī said to one of them, 'Will you give him up to this one?'
He refused and said, 'Will you give him up to this one?'
He refused and said, 'Will you give him up to this one?'

He refused. ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, said, 'You are quarrelsome partners, and I will cast lots among you. Whichever of you the lot falls upon, the child is his, and he owes two-thirds of the blood money.'
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ laughed until his molars showed.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent ʿAlī to Yemen, and a boy was brought to him whom three men were disputing over. And he related the rest of the hadith.
Salamah ibn Kuhayl differed from them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he accepted Islam, but his wife refused to accept Islam. Then their young son, who had not reached puberty, came. The Prophet ﷺ seated the father here and the mother there, then let him choose, and said, "O Allah, guide him."
So he went to his father.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Thābit ibn Qays ibn Shammās struck his wife and broke her hand. She was Jamīlah bint ʿAbdullāh ibn Ubayy. Her brother came complaining about him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for Thābit and said to him:
"Take what is hers from you and let her go." He said, "Yes."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to wait for one menstrual period and then rejoin her family.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wives of the Prophet ﷺ, and she is Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Subayʿah gave birth a few days after the death of her husband, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to marry.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked ʿĀʾishah how the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was. She said: When the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution, he would place his hands in the vessel, mention the name of Allah, and complete the ablution. Then he would stand and face the qiblah, say the takbīr, and raise his hands level with his shoulders. Then he would bow, placing his hands on his knees and keeping his arms away from his sides. Then he would raise his head and straighten his back, and he would stand upright for a time slightly longer than your standing. Then he would prostrate, placing his hands facing the qiblah and keeping his arms apart as far as he could, as far as I saw. Then he would raise his head and sit on his left foot and set up the right, and he disliked falling over onto his left side.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Good fortune (al-judūd) was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying, and one man said: The good fortune of so-and-so is in horses.
Another said: The good fortune of so-and-so is in camels.
Another said: The good fortune of so-and-so is in sheep.
Another said: The good fortune of so-and-so is in slaves.
When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer and raised his head from the last rakʿah, he said:

"O Allah, our Lord, to You belongs all praise, filling the heavens and filling the earth and filling whatever You will beyond that. O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, none can give what You have withheld, and the fortune of the fortunate cannot benefit him against You."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ lengthened his voice when saying "al-jadd" so that they would know it is not as they were saying.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: We would feel sorry for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ because of how far he held his hands away from his sides when he prostrated.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his head from bowing, he would not prostrate until he was standing upright.
When he prostrated and then raised his head,
he would not prostrate again until he was sitting upright,
and he would spread out his left foot [and sit on it].
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "O ʿAlī,
do not sit like a dog sits on its haunches."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said to me:
"When you raise your head from prostration, do not sit on your haunches as a dog does. Place your buttocks between your feet,
and press the tops of your feet to the ground."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When you send blessings upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, do so in the best manner, for you do not know, perhaps it is presented to him.
He said: They said to him, "Then teach us."

He said: Say: "O Allah, send Your blessings, mercy and favours upon the master of the messengers, the leader of the God-fearing, and the seal of the prophets, Muḥammad, Your servant and Your messenger, the leader of goodness, the guide to goodness, and the messenger of mercy. O Allah, raise him to a praiseworthy station that the first and the last will envy. O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and upon the family of Muḥammad as You sent blessings upon Ibrāhīm and upon the family of Ibrāhīm; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There is no Muslim who sends blessings upon me but the angels send blessings upon him for as long as he sends blessings upon me. So let a servant do little of that or let him do much."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever forgets to send blessings upon me has missed the way to Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Prophet ﷺ make a circle with the thumb and middle finger and raise the finger next to them, making supplication with it in the tashahhud.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAlī led us in prayer on the day of the Camel, a prayer that reminded us of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; either we had forgotten it or we had abandoned it. He gave the salām to his right and to his left.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray and give the salām once.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"When the imam gives the salām, return it to him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to give the salām to our imams and for some of us to give the salām to others.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ prayed the dawn prayer, he would say upon giving the salām:
"O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It was said to the Prophet ﷺ — and perhaps Sufyān said, "I said" — O Messenger of Allah, the people of wealth have gone off with the reward; they say as we say, and they spend while we do not spend.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Prophet ﷺ turn away [after the prayer] to his right and to his left.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd Yaghūth said to him: "What prevents you from speaking to your maternal uncle ʿUthmān about his brother al-Walīd ibn ʿUqbah? People have said a great deal about what he has done."
ʿUbaydullāh said: So I stood waiting for ʿUthmān when he came out to the prayer, and I said to him, "I have a need to put to you, and it is a piece of advice."
He said, "O man,
I seek refuge in Allah from you," so I left.
When the prayer was finished, I sat with al-Miswar and Ibn ʿAbd Yaghūth,
and I told them what I had said to ʿUthmān and what he had said to me.
They said, "You have done what was incumbent upon you."
While I was sitting with them,
the messenger of ʿUthmān came to me,
and they said to me, "Allah has put you to the test."
So I went until I entered upon him,
and he said, "What is this advice of yours that you mentioned a moment ago?" I said the testimony of faith and then said, "Allah sent Muḥammad ﷺ and revealed the Book to him,
and I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ and believed in him,
and I made the two earlier migrations,
and I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and saw his guidance,
and people have spoken much about the matter of al-Walīd ibn ʿUqbah,
so it is your duty to carry out the legal punishment on him."
He said to me, "O son of my brother, did you meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" I said, "No,
but knowledge of him has reached me as it reaches a maiden in her seclusion."
He said: Then ʿUthmān recited the testimony of faith and said, "Allah sent Muḥammad ﷺ with the truth and revealed the Book to him,
and I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ and believed in what Muḥammad ﷺ was sent with.
And I made the two earlier migrations, as you said,
and I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and pledged allegiance to him.
By Allah, I never disobeyed him nor deceived him until Allah took him in death.
Then Allah appointed Abū Bakr as successor, and by Allah, I never disobeyed him nor deceived him.
Then ʿUmar was appointed successor,
and by Allah, I never disobeyed him nor deceived him. Then I was made successor.
Do I not have the same right over you that they had over me?" I said, "Yes."
He said, "Then what are these reports that reach me from you? As for what you mentioned about al-Walīd ibn ʿUqbah,
we shall deal with it, Allah willing, in accordance with the truth." He said: So al-Walīd was flogged forty lashes,
and [ʿUthmān] ordered ʿAlī to flog him,
and [ʿAlī] was the one who flogged him.
Yūnus and the son of the brother of al-Zuhrī said, from al-Zuhrī: "Do I not have the same right over you as they had?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ sent an army to Banū al-ʿAnbar. They seized them at Rukbah, on the side of Ṭāʾif, and drove them to the Prophet of Allah ﷺ. I rode out and reached the Prophet ﷺ ahead of them, and I said, "Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings! Your soldiers came to us and seized us, though we had become Muslims and had cropped the ears of the livestock." When Banū al-ʿAnbar arrived, the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said to me,
"Do you have proof that you became Muslims before you were seized in these days?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Who is your proof?"
I said, "Samurah, a man of Banū al-ʿAnbar, and another man," whom he named. The man testified, but Samurah refused to testify. So the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said,
"He has refused to testify for you, so will you swear an oath along with your other witness?" I said, "Yes."
So he had me swear, and I swore by Allah that we had become Muslims on such and such a day and had cropped the ears of the livestock.
Then the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said,
"Go and divide the wealth with them by halves, and do not touch their children. Were it not that Allah does not love fruitless deeds, we would not have taken from you even a hobbling rope."
Az-Zubayb said: My mother called me and said, "This man took my small carpet." So I went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him, and he said to me, "Detain him."
So I seized him by the collar and stood with him in our place. Then the Prophet of Allah ﷺ looked at us standing there and said,
"What do you want with your prisoner?"
So I released him from my hand. Then the Prophet of Allah ﷺ stood and said to the man,
"Return to this boy's mother her carpet that you took from her."
He said, "O Prophet of Allah, it has already left my hands."
He said: So the Prophet of Allah ﷺ took the man's sword and gave it to me. And he said to the man,
"Go and add a ṣāʿ of food for him."
He said: So he added for me a ṣāʿ of barley.
label: machine translation

segments_en: With the same meaning as its chain of narration: that two men,
laid claim to a camel in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, and each of them brought two witnesses, so the Prophet ﷺ divided it between them in two halves.
label: machine translation

segments_en: If the two parties dislike taking the oath, or both prefer it, then let them draw lots for it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said, meaning to a man whom he was administering the oath,
"Swear by Allah, besides Whom there is no god, that he has nothing of his with you." Meaning, for the claimant.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, meaning to Ibn Ṣūriyā,

"I remind you by Allah, Who saved you from the people of Pharaoh, split the sea for you, shaded you with clouds, sent down upon you manna and quails, and sent down upon you the Torah to Moses: do you find stoning in your Book?"
He said, "You have reminded me of something momentous, and I cannot lie to you." And he went on to narrate the hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ gave judgment between two men.
When the one against whom the judgment was given turned away, he said, "Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs." The Prophet ﷺ said,
"Allah blames [one] for incapacity, but you should be shrewd. Then if a matter overcomes you, say: Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ with a debtor of mine, and he said to me, "Stay with him."
Then he said to me,
"O brother of Banū Tamīm, what do you want to do with your prisoner?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: That his brother or his uncle, and Muʾammal said: that he stood up before the Prophet ﷺ while he was delivering a sermon and said, "[Why have] my neighbors [been detained] for what they took?"
He turned away from him twice. Then he mentioned something, and the Prophet ﷺ said,
"Release his neighbors for him."
Muʾammal did not mention "while he was delivering a sermon."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I wanted to set out for Khaybar, so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, greeted him with peace, and told him that I wanted to set out for Khaybar. He said,
"When you come to my agent, take fifteen wasqs from him. If he asks you for a sign, put your hand on his collarbone."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to ʿAlī and Fāṭimah while they were under a khamīl of theirs—the khamīl being a white woolen blanket—with which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had equipped them, along with a pillow stuffed with idhkhir grass and a water skin.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The divorce according to the Sunnah is one pronouncement of divorce while she is in a state of purity, without intercourse. Then, when she menstruates and becomes pure, he divorces her again; then, when she menstruates and becomes pure, he divorces her again. After that she observes a waiting period of one menstrual cycle.
Al-Aʿmash said: I asked Ibrāhīm and he said the same.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The divorce according to the Sunnah is that he divorces her while she is in a state of purity, without intercourse.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Ibn ʿAbbās was asked about a slave who divorced
his wife with two pronouncements of divorce, and then both were freed: may he marry her? He said: Yes.
It was said to him: On whose authority? He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled thus.
ʿAbd al-Razzāq said: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak said: Abū al-Ḥasan has taken a great rock upon his neck with this.
label: machine translation

segments_en: She had a male slave and a female slave who were married to each other. She said: O Messenger of Allah, I wish to free them both.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
If you free them, begin with the man before the woman.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Praise be to Allah, whose hearing encompasses all voices. Khawlah came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining about her husband, and some of her words were hidden from me. Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: {Allah has certainly heard the speech of the one who disputes with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah, and Allah hears your discussion} — the verse.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to her: Tell me your story.

She said: I obtained a khulʿ divorce from my husband, then I went to ʿUthmān and asked him what waiting period was required of me. He said: You have no waiting period, unless you were recently with him, in which case you remain until you have had one menstrual cycle. He said: And in this I am following the ruling of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning Maryam al-Mughāliyyah, who was married to Thābit ibn Qays ibn Shammās and obtained a khulʿ divorce from him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ commanded Subayʿah to marry when she had come out of her postnatal bleeding.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: O Messenger of Allah, the hundred shares I have in Khaybar—I have never obtained any wealth more beloved to me than it, and I wish to give it in charity. The Prophet ﷺ said:
Hold its principal and let its fruit be devoted [to the cause of Allah].
Ibn Abī ʿUmar said: I found this hadith in another place in my book, from Sufyān, from ʿAbdullāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: ʿUmar said—and he mentioned something similar.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ addressed them while he was on his mount, and his mount was chewing its cud, and its saliva was running down between my shoulders. He said:

Allah has assigned to every heir his share of the inheritance, so there is no bequest for an heir. The child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone. Whoever claims a father other than his own, or takes as patrons someone other than his own patrons, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people; no obligatory or voluntary act will be accepted from him. Or he said:
no voluntary or obligatory act.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: O Messenger of Allah, my mother has died; may I give charity on her behalf? He said: Yes.
I said: Which charity is best? He said: Giving water to drink.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
No one may take back his gift, except a father from what he gave his child. The one who takes back his gift is like the one who returns to his vomit.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
Whoever is given something for his lifetime, it is his for his lifetime and after his death.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar had taken a vow to spend a night in iʿtikāf in the Sacred Mosque. He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that, and he commanded him to perform iʿtikāf.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with the delegation of Thaqīf, and I was with him in a tent. Everyone in the tent slept except me and him. Then a man came and spoke to him privately, and he said: Go and kill him. Then he said:
Does he not testify that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah? He said: He testifies [to it].
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Leave him. Then he said:
I have been commanded to fight people until they say: There is no god but Allah. When they say it, their blood and their wealth are made inviolable to me, except by its right.
Muḥammad said: I said to Shuʿbah: Is it not in the hadith:
Does he not testify that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah?
He said: I think it is with it, but I do not know.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
The disappearance of the world is lighter in the sight of Allah than the killing of a believer without right.
label: machine translation

segments_en: While he was on the pulpit, he said: "Fear Allah as much as you are able; there is no exception in it. And listen and obey; there is no exception in it, to the Commander of the Faithful, ʿAbd al-Malik. By Allah, if I were to order the people to go out through one of the doors of the mosque and they went out through another door, their blood and their wealth would become lawful for me. By Allah, if I seized Rabīʿah for [the crimes of] Muḍar, that would be lawful for me from Allah. And who will excuse me from the man of Hudhayl, who claims that his recitation is from Allah? By Allah, it is nothing but a verse of rajaz from the rajaz of the Bedouins; Allah did not send it down upon His Prophet, peace be upon him. And who will excuse me from these non-Arabs (al-Ḥamrāʾ), one of whom claims that he throws a stone and says: 'Until the stone lands, something new has happened.' By Allah, I will leave them like yesterday that has passed."
He said: I mentioned it to al-Aʿmash, and he said: By Allah, I heard it from him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: On the pulpit: "These non-Arabs (al-Ḥamrāʾ) are to be cut down, cut down! By Allah, I have struck stick against stick; I will scatter them like yesterday that has gone." He means the mawālī (freed slaves).
label: machine translation

segments_en: I performed Hajj with al-Ḥajjāj, and he gave a sermon, and he mentioned the hadith of Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh. He said in it: "So listen and obey the caliph of Allah and His chosen one, ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwān."
And he related the hadith. He said: "And if I seized Rabīʿah for [the crimes of] Muḍar," and he did not mention the story of al-Ḥamrāʾ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The caliphate of prophethood is thirty years; then Allah gives the kingdom—or His kingdom—to whomever He wills."
Saʿīd said: Safīnah said to me: Count for yourself: Abū Bakr two years, ʿUmar ten, ʿUthmān twelve, and ʿAlī so many.
Saʿīd said: I said to Safīnah: These people claim that ʿAlī, peace be upon him, was not a caliph.
He said: They lie, the backsides of the Banū al-Zarqāʾ! He means the Banū Marwān.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He was in the mosque when a man mentioned ʿAlī, peace be upon him. Saʿīd ibn Zayd stood up and said: I bear witness concerning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I heard him say:

"Ten are in Paradise: the Prophet is in Paradise, Abū Bakr is in Paradise, ʿUmar is in Paradise, ʿUthmān is in Paradise, ʿAlī is in Paradise, Ṭalḥah is in Paradise, al-Zubayr ibn al-ʿAwwām is in Paradise, Saʿd ibn Mālik is in Paradise, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf is in Paradise."
"And if I wished, I could name the tenth."
He said: They said, "Who is he?" But he was silent. He said: They said, "Who is he?" He said: He is Saʿīd ibn Zayd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was sitting with so-and-so in the mosque of Kūfah, and the people of Kūfah were with him. Then Saʿīd ibn Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl came, and he welcomed him, greeted him, and seated him by his feet on the couch. Then a man from the people of Kūfah called Qays ibn ʿAlqamah came and faced him, cursing and cursing. Saʿīd said: Whom is this man cursing? He said: He is cursing ʿAlī.

He said: Do I not see the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being cursed in your presence, and you neither object nor change it? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say—and I would never say about him what he did not say, for he would question me about it tomorrow when I meet him:
"Abū Bakr is in Paradise, ʿUmar is in Paradise."

And he related its meaning. Then he said: Indeed, the presence of a man among them with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, in which his face is covered with dust, is better than the deeds of any one of you for his whole life, even if he were granted the lifespan of Nūḥ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Jibrīl came to me, took me by the hand, and showed me the gate of Paradise through which my community will enter."
Abū Bakr said: O Messenger of Allah, I wish I had been with you so that I could look at it.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"As for you, O Abū Bakr, you are the first of my community to enter Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said—Mūsā said: "Perhaps Allah..."
And Ibn Sinān said:
"Allah looked upon the people of Badr and said: Do as you wish, for I have forgiven you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The muezzin of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: ʿUmar sent me to the bishop, and I summoned him. ʿUmar said to him: Do you find me in the Book? He said: Yes.
He said: How do you find me? He said: I find you a horn (qarn).
So he raised the whip over him and said: A horn? What do you mean? He said: A horn of iron, trustworthy and strong.
He said: How do you find the one who comes after me? He said: I find him a righteous caliph, except that he favors his relatives.

ʿUmar said: May Allah have mercy on ʿUthmān—three times. Then he said: How do you find the one after him? He said: I find him a rust-like iron barrier. ʿUmar put his hand on his head and said: Alas! Alas!
He said: O Commander of the Faithful, he is a righteous caliph, but he will take the caliphate when the sword is drawn and blood is spilled.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Fāṭimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, sent a message to Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq asking him for her inheritance from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from what Allah had granted him as spoils in Medina and Fadak, and what remained of the fifth of Khaybar. Abū Bakr said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
'We [prophets] are not inherited from; whatever we leave is charity. The family of Muḥammad ﷺ may only eat from this wealth.'

By Allah, I will not change anything of the charity of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the condition it was in during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I will act regarding it as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ acted." So Abū Bakr refused to hand anything over to Fāṭimah, and Fāṭimah became angry with Abū Bakr over that. She forsook him and did not speak to him until she died. She lived six months after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When she died, her husband ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib buried her at night and did not inform Abū Bakr, and ʿAlī led the prayer over her. ʿAlī had enjoyed the favor of the people during Fāṭimah's life, but when she died, ʿAlī noticed that the people's faces had turned away from him. So he sought reconciliation with Abū Bakr and to pledge allegiance to him, which he had not done during those months. He sent to Abū Bakr: "Come to us, and let no one come with you," disliking that ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb be present. ʿUmar said to Abū Bakr: "By Allah, do not go in to them alone."
Abū Bakr said: "What do you think they will do to me? By Allah, I will go to them."
So Abū Bakr went in to them.

ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib recited the testimony of faith and then said: "We know, Abū Bakr, your excellence and what Allah has given you, and we do not envy you any good that Allah has brought to you. But you took the matter [of leadership] for yourself alone, whereas we saw that we had a right to it because of our kinship to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."

He continued speaking to Abū Bakr until Abū Bakr's eyes overflowed with tears. When Abū Bakr spoke, he said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, the kinship of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is dearer to me to maintain than my own kinship. As for what has arisen between me and you regarding these properties, I have not fallen short in it of the truth, and I have not abandoned any matter that I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do with them, except that I did it."
ʿAlī said to Abū Bakr: "Your appointment is this afternoon for the pledge of allegiance."

When Abū Bakr had prayed the noon prayer, he ascended the pulpit, recited the testimony of faith, mentioned the matter of ʿAlī and his delay in giving the pledge, and the excuse he had offered, and then asked forgiveness. Then ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib recited the testimony of faith and magnified the right of Abū Bakr, and said that what he had done was not caused by envy of Abū Bakr, nor by denial of the merit Allah had granted him, but that "we had seen that we had a share in the matter, and he took it for himself alone, so we felt aggrieved." The Muslims were pleased with that and said: "You have done right."
And the Muslims drew close to ʿAlī when he returned to what was right and proper.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And this,

is the hadith of Ibn Abī Shaybah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us out in a military expedition, and we attacked the Ḥuraqāt of Juhaynah at dawn. I caught up with a man, and he said: "There is no god but Allah."
But I stabbed him, and it weighed on my mind, so I mentioned it to the Prophet ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"He said 'There is no god but Allah' and you killed him?"
I said: "O Messenger of Allah, he only said it out of fear of the weapon." He said:
"Did you split open his heart so that you would know whether he said it or not?"
He kept repeating it to me until I wished that I had become Muslim only that day.
Then Saʿd said: "By Allah, I will not kill a Muslim until the man with the big belly kills him,"

meaning Usāmah. A man said: "Did Allah not say: {Fight them until there is no more fitnah and the religion is entirely for Allah}?" Saʿd said: "We fought until there was no more fitnah, but you and your companions want to fight so that there will be fitnah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I went on seven military campaigns with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I went out on nine of the expeditions he dispatched, sometimes with Abū Bakr in command over us and sometimes with Usāmah ibn Zayd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ campaigned in the campaign of the Conquest, the conquest of Mecca. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out with the Muslims who were with him, and they fought at Ḥunayn, and Allah gave victory to His religion and to the Muslims. On that day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave Ṣafwān ibn Umayyah a hundred camels, then a hundred, then a hundred.
label: machine translation

segments_en: that he passed by some people with a roasted sheep set before them.
They invited him, but he refused to eat and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ departed from this world without ever having eaten his fill of barley bread.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Then I saw that the bad, hard date was the one that was toughest on my molar.
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with them both, who said: In Medina there was a Jew who used to lend me [money] against my dates until the harvest time.
Jābir had the land on the road to Rūmah, so I stayed away from it.
It went a year without yielding, and the Jew came to me at harvest time,
but I did not find anything from it.
So I began asking him to give me respite until the following year, but he refused.
The Prophet ﷺ was informed of that, and he said to his Companions:
"Come, let us ask the Jew to give Jābir more time."
They came to me in my palm grove, and the Prophet ﷺ began speaking to the Jew, who said: O Abū al-Qāsim, I will not give him more time.
When the Prophet ﷺ saw this, he got up and walked around among the palm trees,
then came to him and spoke to him, but he refused. So I got up and brought a small amount of fresh dates and placed them before the Prophet ﷺ, and he ate. Then he said:
"Where is your shelter, O Jābir?" I told him, and he said:
"Spread out [a bed] for me in it."
So I spread it out, and he entered and slept.
Then he woke up, and I brought him another handful, and he ate from it,
then he got up and spoke to the Jew, but he still refused. So he stood among the fresh dates in the palm trees a second time and then said:
"O Jābir, pick [your dates] and pay [the debt]."
He stood by during the harvest, and I picked from it enough to pay what I owed, and some was left over. Then I went out until I came to the Prophet ﷺ and gave him the good news, and he said:
"I bear witness that I am the Messenger of Allah."
ʿurūsh and ʿarīsh mean a structure. Ibn ʿAbbās said: maʿrūshāt are vines and the like that are trellised. It is said: ʿurūshuhā means their structures.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And he related the hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: With a boy there is an ʿaqīqah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he entered upon Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, and a boy from the family of Yaḥyā had tied up a hen and was throwing things at it.
So Ibn ʿUmar walked over to it until he untied it,
then he came back with it and the boy alongside him, and said: Restrain your boy from keeping this bird tied up to be killed,
for I heard the Prophet ﷺ forbid that an animal or anything else be held captive to be killed.

segments_en: ʿAmr said: I said to Jābir ibn Zayd: They claim that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the meat of domestic donkeys. He said: Al-Ḥakam ibn ʿAmr al-Ghifārī used to say that among us in Basra,
but the great scholar Ibn ʿAbbās refused that, and he recited: {Say: I do not find in what has been revealed to me anything forbidden...}
label: machine translation

segments_en: [Regarding a mouse] that dies in oil and clear butter, whether it is solid or not solid,
a mouse or something else. He said: It has reached us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a ruling about a mouse that died in clarified butter,
so he ordered that what was near it be removed and thrown away, and then [the rest] was eaten.
[This is] from the hadith of ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAbdullāh.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he disliked that the animal be marked on the face.
And Ibn ʿUmar said: The Prophet ﷺ forbade that it be struck [on the face].
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Whoever slaughters before the prayer has only slaughtered for himself,
and whoever slaughters after the prayer, his sacrifice is complete,
and he has met the Sunnah of the Muslims."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he came to ʿĀʾishah
and said to her: O Mother of the Believers, a man sends a sacrificial animal to the Kaʿbah
while he stays in his city,
and he instructs that his camel be garlanded,
so from that day he remains in a state of iḥrām until the people come out of it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: [Meat of] the sacrificial animal, we used to salt some of it
and bring it to the Prophet ﷺ in Medina, and he said:
"Do not eat [it] beyond three days." It was not a binding command,
but he wanted [them] to feed others from it, and Allah knows best.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū ʿUbayd said: Then I was present with ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, and that was on a Friday.
He prayed before the sermon and then delivered the sermon and said: O people, this is a day on which two ʿĪds have come together for you,
so whoever among the people of al-ʿAwālī wishes to wait for the Friday prayer, let him wait,
and whoever wishes to return, I have given him permission.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ [said]:
"Eat from the sacrificial animals for three days."
And ʿAbdullāh used to eat with oil when he left Minā,
because of the meat of the sacrificial animals.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Wine was certainly forbidden,
and at that time there was none of it in Medina.
label: machine translation

segments_en: On the night he was taken on the Night Journey, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought a cup of milk and a cup of wine.
label: machine translation

segments_en: There were kings after ʿĪsā ibn Maryam, peace be upon him, who altered the Torah and the Gospel. Among their people were believers who recited the Torah. It was said to their kings: "We find no greater insult than the way these people insult us: they recite {Those who do not judge by what Allah has revealed—it is they who are the disbelievers}, and these verses, together with what they criticize us for in our deeds, are in their recitation. So summon them, and let them recite as we recite and believe as we believe."

So he summoned them and gathered them, and he presented them with death, or else that they give up reciting the Torah and the Gospel except for what they had altered of it. They said: "What do you want with that? Leave us alone."
One group of them said: "Build us a pillar, then raise us up onto it, then give us something with which to hoist up our food and drink, and we will not answer you."
Another group of them said: "Leave us to wander the earth and roam, and drink as the wild animals drink. If you can overpower us in your land, then kill us."

Another group of them said: "Build us houses in the wilderness, and we will dig wells and cultivate vegetables. We will not answer you and will not pass by you." And there was no tribe except that it had a close relative among them.

He said: They did that, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed {And monasticism they invented—We did not prescribe it for them—only seeking the pleasure of Allah; but they did not observe it with due observance}. The others said: "We will worship as so-and-so worshipped, wander as so-and-so wandered, and take houses as so-and-so took."

And they were upon their polytheism, with no knowledge of the faith of those whom they imitated. Then when Allah sent the Prophet ﷺ, and only a few of them remained, a man came down from his hermitage, a wanderer came from his wandering, and the owner of a monastery came from his monastery, and they believed in him and affirmed his truth. So Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said {O you who believe, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will give you a double portion of His mercy}, meaning two rewards: for their belief in ʿĪsā, the Torah and the Gospel, and for their belief in Muhammad ﷺ and their affirming his truth. He said {and will make for you a light by which you walk}, meaning the Qur'an and their following of the Prophet ﷺ. He said {so that the People of the Book may know}, those who try to resemble you, {that they have no power over anything of the bounty of Allah}—the verse.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A woman who had committed adultery was brought to the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: "By whom?"
She said: "By the lame man who is in Saʿd's orchard."

He sent for him, and he was brought carried, and was placed before him. He confessed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for a palm-stalk with many branches and struck him with it, showing him mercy because of his disability, and lightened it for him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Two girls were stitching leather in Ṭāʾif. One of them came out with her hand bleeding, and she claimed that her companion had injured her, but the other denied it. So I wrote to Ibn ʿAbbās about that, and he wrote that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the oath is upon the defendant, and that if people were given according to their claims, some people would claim the wealth and the blood of others. [He said:] "Call her and recite to her this verse: {Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their oaths for a small price—those have no share in the Hereafter}" until he completed the verse. So I called her and recited it to her, and she confessed to that. This pleased him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were hit by a drizzle and darkness, so we waited for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to lead us in prayer. Then he mentioned words to the effect that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to lead us in prayer, and he said: "Say."
I said: "What should I say?" He said:
"{Say: He is Allah, the One} and the two seeking-refuge surahs, when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning, three times; it will suffice you against everything."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the road to Makkah, and I found him alone, so I drew near to him, and he said: "Say."
I said: "What should I say?" He said: "Say."
I said: "What should I say?" He said:
"{Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak}."
until he finished it. Then he said:
"{Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind}."
until he finished it. Then he said:
"People have not sought refuge with anything better than these two."
label: machine translation

segments_en: While I was leading,
for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his mount on a military expedition, he said:
"ʿUqbah, say."
So I listened. Then he said:
"ʿUqbah, say."
So I listened. He said it a third time, and I said: "What should I say?" He said:
"{Say: He is Allah, the One}."

So he recited the surah until he finished it, then he recited {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak}, and I recited with him until he finished it, then he recited {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind}, and I recited with him until he finished it. Then he said:
"No one has sought refuge with anything like them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAmmār entered upon ʿAlī, and he said, "Welcome to the good and purified one! I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
'ʿAmmār is filled with faith down to his bones.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with them both, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ [shaving part of a child's head and leaving other parts].
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Among the best of your kohl is ithmid, for it clears the eyesight and makes the hair grow."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Prophet ﷺ wearing a red cloak, with his hair neatly combed. I never saw anyone more beautiful than him, before or since.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, "How much of her hem may a woman let trail?" He said, "A span."
She said, "Then she would be exposed." He said:
"A forearm's length, and she should not add to that."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I prepared some food and invited the Prophet ﷺ. He came and entered, then saw a curtain with pictures on it, so he went out and said:
"The angels do not enter a house in which there are pictures."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The sandal of the Prophet ﷺ had two straps, with their thongs doubled over.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Seek refuge in Allah from poverty, from scarcity, and from humiliation, and from wronging others or being wronged."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making nabīdh in the naqīr, the muzaffat, the gourd, and the ḥantam [types of vessels], and he said:
"Every intoxicant is forbidden."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"I had forbidden you to use [certain] vessels, but now make nabīdh in whatever is available to you, and beware of every intoxicant."
label: machine translation

segments_en: [The Prophet ﷺ said:]
"Neither one who reminds others of his favors, nor one who is disobedient to his parents, nor one who is addicted to wine will enter Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned several hadith, among them: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Every wound that a Muslim receives in the cause of Allah will be, on the Day of Resurrection, as it was when it was inflicted, gushing blood: its color the color of blood, and its scent the scent of musk."
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, were it not that it would be hard on the believers, I would never stay behind any expedition fighting in the cause of Allah. But I do not find the means to carry them, and they do not find the means to follow me, and it does not please them to stay behind after me."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He was asked: "Will a menstruating woman serve me, or may a woman who is in a state of janābah come near me?" ʿUrwah said: "All of that is easy for me,
and all of that [kind of woman] serves me,
and there is no harm for anyone in that.
ʿĀʾishah informed me that she used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while she was menstruating,
while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was at that time secluded in the mosque [in iʿtikāf],
bringing his head close to her while she was in her room,
and she would comb his hair while she was menstruating."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever prays our prayer, faces our qiblah, and eats our slaughtered animal,
he is the Muslim who has the protection of Allah and the protection of His Messenger,
so do not betray Allah in His protection."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
of the Anṣār came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what if a man finds another man with his wife?" And he mentioned the hadith with its story.
He added in it: "So they performed liʿān in the mosque, while I was present."
And he said in the hadith: "Then he divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him.
So he separated from her in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ said:
'That is the separation between every couple who perform liʿān.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: Ibn ʿAbbās said to me and to his son ʿAlī: "Go to Abū Saʿīd and listen to his narration."
So we went, and he was in a garden, tending it.
He took up his cloak and sat wrapped in it,
then began to narrate to us until he reached the mention of the building of the mosque. He said: "We were carrying one brick at a time,
while ʿAmmār was carrying two bricks at a time.
The Prophet ﷺ saw him, and he wiped the dust off him and said:
'Alas for ʿAmmār! The rebellious group will kill him,
he calls them to Paradise,
and they call him to the Fire.'"
He said: ʿAmmār would say, "I seek refuge in Allah from trials."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That this verse
was revealed: {In it are men who love to purify themselves, and Allah loves those who purify themselves}. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"O company of the Ansar, Allah has praised you for your purification. What is your purification?"
They said: "We perform ablution for prayer, we wash after sexual impurity, and we clean ourselves with water after relieving ourselves." He said:
"That is it, so hold fast to it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Prophet ﷺ used to wash his posterior three times.
Ibn ʿUmar said: "We did it and found it to be a remedy and a purification."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ entered a thicket and relieved himself. Then Jarīr came to him with a small water container, and he cleaned himself with it and wiped his hand on the earth.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ commanded us to tie up our waterskins and to cover our vessels.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I used to place three covered vessels for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night: a vessel for his ablution, a vessel for his tooth-stick, and a vessel for his drink.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not entrust his ablution water to anyone, nor the charity he gave; he would be the one to see to it himself.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I used to perform ablution, I and the Messenger of Allah
ﷺ, from a single vessel from which a cat had drunk before that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The cat does not break the prayer, because it is among the household goods."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wife of the Prophet ﷺ [reported] that the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution with the water left over from her bath after sexual impurity.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ and his wives used to bathe from a single vessel, and neither of them would bathe with what the other had left over.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ: that the two of them used to perform ablution together for prayer.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ with a vessel for ablution, and he said: "Pour."
So I poured, and he washed his face and his forearms, then took fresh water and wiped his head with it, from the front to the back, and washed his feet three times each.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I poured water for the Prophet ﷺ for ablution, both when traveling and when at home.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And she was
a slave woman of Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She said: "I used to help the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution while I stood and he sat."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He called for water and washed his hands before putting them into the vessel, then said: "This is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution, he would run his fingers through his beard and between his fingers, twice.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the expedition of Tabūk perform ablution washing each part once.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution washing each part three times, and he wiped his head once.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution washing each part three times.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for water and performed ablution washing each part once, and said:
"This is the essential requirement of ablution," or he said:
"the ablution of one without which Allah does not accept his prayer."
Then he performed ablution washing each part twice, and then said:
"This is the ablution of one to whom Allah gives a double reward."
Then he performed ablution washing each part three times and said:
"This is my ablution and the ablution of the Messengers before me."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I spent the night at my maternal aunt Maymūnah's. The Prophet ﷺ got up and performed ablution from a hanging waterskin, using little water. Then I got up and did as he had done.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man performing ablution and said:
"Do not be wasteful, do not be wasteful."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by Saʿd while he was performing ablution and said:
"What is this wastefulness?"
He said: "Is there wastefulness in ablution?" He said:
"Yes, even if you are on a flowing river."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to perform ablution thoroughly.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution and ran his fingers through his beard.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution, he would rub his cheeks somewhat, then interlace his beard with his fingers from underneath.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped his head once.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution and wiped his head twice.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ sent two armies and appointed ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib over one of them and Khālid ibn al-Walīd over the other, and he said: "
If there is fighting, then ʿAlī [is in command]."
He said: ʿAlī conquered a fortress and took a slave girl from it, so Khālid wrote a letter with me to the Prophet ﷺ, denouncing him.
He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and he read the letter, and his face changed color. Then he said: "
What do you think of a man who loves Allah and His Messenger, and whom Allah and His Messenger love?"
He said: I said: I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and from the anger of His Messenger; I am only a messenger. So he fell silent.
label: machine translation

segments_en: On the day of Badr, when the captives were brought, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
What do you say about these captives?"
Then he mentioned an account in the hadith, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
None of them is to get away except by ransom or by having his neck struck."
ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd said: I said: O Messenger of Allah, except Suhayl ibn Bayḍāʾ, for I have heard him speak of Islam.
He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ fell silent. He said: I never saw myself on a day more afraid that stones would fall on me from the sky than on that day, until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Except Suhayl ibn Bayḍāʾ."
He said: And the Qurʾān was revealed in agreement with the statement of ʿUmar:
"It is not for a prophet to have captives until he has fought strenuously in the land," to the end of the verses.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The polytheists
wanted to buy
the body of a man from among the polytheists, but the Prophet ﷺ refused to sell it to them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ forbade me from wearing qasiyy [garments] and garments dyed with safflower.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ measured out a span of his waist wrapper for Fāṭimah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: On the day his Lord spoke to him, Mūsā was wearing a woolen cloak, a woolen tunic, a woolen cap and woolen trousers, and his sandals were made of the skin of a dead donkey."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ put on a turban, he would let its end hang down between his shoulders.
Nāfiʿ said: Ibn ʿUmar used to let his turban hang down between his shoulders.
ʿUbaydullāh said: And I saw al-Qāsim and Sālim doing that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn used to wear their rings on their left hands.
This is a ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade images in the house, and he forbade making them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of medium height, neither tall nor short, well-proportioned in body, and dark-complexioned. His hair was neither tightly curled nor completely straight. When he walked, he leaned slightly forward.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from riding on saddle cushions made of silk.
He said: And the hadith contains an account.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put on a shirt, he would begin with its right side.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah said: Dihyah al-Kalbī gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a pair of leather socks, and he wore them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: At times the Prophet ﷺ walked in a single sandal.
label: machine translation

segments_en: She walked in a single sandal. And this is more authentic.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "

If you want to join me, let what you have of the world suffice you like the provisions of a rider, and beware of sitting with the rich, and do not consider a garment worn out until you have patched it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He is ʿAbdullāh ibn Busr. He said: I heard Abū Kabshah al-Anmārī
say: The caps of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were flat.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the cooking pots of the Magians, and he said: "
Clean them by washing, and cook in them."
And he forbade every predatory animal with a fang.
label: machine translation

segments_en: O Messenger of Allah, we are in the land of the People of the Book; we cook in their pots and drink from their vessels.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
If you do not find others, then wash them with water."
Then he said: O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land of game; what should we do? He said: "

If you send out your trained dog and mention the name of Allah and it kills [the game], eat it. If it is not trained, but you slaughter [the animal] properly, eat it. And if you shoot with your arrow and mention the name of Allah and it kills [the game], eat it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
When one of you is eating food and a morsel falls, let him remove whatever is doubtful on it, then eat it, and not leave it for Satan."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
Blessing descends in the middle of the food, so eat from its edges and do not eat from its middle."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Except cooked [food].
label: machine translation

segments_en: They were commanded to glorify Allah (say subḥān Allāh)

after every prayer thirty-three times, to praise Him (say al-ḥamdu lillāh) thirty-three times, and to declare His greatness (say Allāhu akbar) thirty-four times. Then a man of the Ansar was visited in his sleep, and it was said to him: "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to glorify Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, to praise Him thirty-three times, and to declare His greatness thirty-four times?" He said: "Yes."

The one in the dream said: "Then make it twenty-five each, and include in it the declaration that there is no god but Allah (tahlīl)." When morning came, he went to the Prophet ﷺ and told him of that, and he ﷺ said: "Do it that way."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to Makkah and met my brother Sālim ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar, and he narrated to me from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Whoever enters the marketplace and says: 'There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things,' Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase from him a million evil deeds, and raise him a million degrees."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I bear witness concerning Abū Saʿīd and Abū Hurayrah that they both testified that the Prophet ﷺ said:
"Whoever says: 'There is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest,'
his Lord confirms him and says: 'There is no god but Me, and I am the Greatest.'
And when he says: 'There is no god but Allah alone,'
He says: Allah says: 'There is no god but Me, and I am alone.'
And when he says: 'There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner,'
Allah says: 'There is no god but Me, alone, I have no partner.'
And when he says: 'There is no god but Allah, to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise,'
Allah says: 'There is no god but Me, to Me belongs the dominion and to Me belongs all praise.'
And when he says: 'There is no god but Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah,'
Allah says: 'There is no god but Me, and there is no might and no power except with Me.'
And he used to say: Whoever says it during his illness and then dies, the Fire will not consume him."
He said: This is a ḥasan gharīb hadith.
Shuʿbah also narrated it from Abū Isḥāq,
from al-Agharr Abū Muslim,
from Abū Hurayrah and Abū
Saʿīd, with similar wording and the same meaning, but Shuʿbah did not trace it back to the Prophet ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Whoever sees a person afflicted with a trial and says: 'Praise be to Allah, who has spared me from what He has afflicted you with, and has favored me greatly over many of those whom He created,' he will be spared that affliction, whatever it may be, as long as he lives."
label: machine translation

segments_en: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting, a man entered and prayed, and then said: "O Allah, forgive me and have mercy on me."
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"You were hasty, O worshipper. When you have prayed and are sitting, praise Allah as He deserves, send blessings upon me, and then call upon Him."
He said: Then another man prayed after that, praised Allah, and sent blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him:
"O worshipper, make your supplication; it will be answered."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one. He is Witr (One) and loves the odd number. Whoever memorizes them will enter Paradise. They are: Allah, al-Wāḥid, aṣ-Ṣamad, al-Awwal, al-Ākhir, aẓ-Ẓāhir, al-Bāṭin, al-Khāliq, al-Bāriʾ, al-Muṣawwir, al-Malik, al-Ḥaqq, as-Salām, al-Muʾmin, al-Muhaymin, al-ʿAzīz, al-Jabbār, al-Mutakabbir, ar-Raḥmān, ar-Raḥīm, al-Laṭīf, al-Khabīr, as-Samīʿ, al-Baṣīr, al-ʿAlīm, al-ʿAẓīm, al-Barr, al-Mutaʿāl, al-Jalīl, al-Jamīl, al-Ḥayy, al-Qayyūm, al-Qādir, al-Qāhir, al-ʿAlī, al-Ḥakīm, al-Qarīb, al-Mujīb, al-Ghanī, al-Wahhāb, al-Wadūd, ash-Shakūr, al-Mājid, al-Wājid, al-Wālī, ar-Rāshid, al-ʿAfuww, al-Ghafūr, al-Ḥalīm, al-Karīm, at-Tawwāb, ar-Rabb, al-Majīd, al-Walī, ash-Shahīd, al-Mubīn, al-Burhān, ar-Raʾūf, ar-Raḥīm, al-Mubdiʾ, al-Muʿīd, al-Bāʿith, al-Wārith, al-Qawī, ash-Shadīd, aḍ-Ḍārr, an-Nāfiʿ, al-Bāqī, al-Wāqī, al-Khāfiḍ, ar-Rāfiʿ, al-Qābiḍ, al-Bāsiṭ, al-Muʿizz, al-Mudhill, al-Muqsiṭ, ar-Razzāq, Dhū al-Quwwah, al-Matīn, al-Qāʾim, ad-Dāʾim, al-Ḥāfiẓ, al-Wakīl, al-Fāṭir, as-Sāmiʿ, al-Muʿṭī, al-Muḥyī, al-Mumīt, al-Māniʿ, al-Jāmiʿ, al-Hādī, al-Kāfī, al-Abad, al-ʿĀlim, aṣ-Ṣādiq, an-Nūr, al-Munīr, at-Tāmm, al-Qadīm, al-Witr, al-Aḥad, aṣ-Ṣamad, the One who did not beget and was not begotten, and there is none comparable to Him."

Zuhayr said: It has reached us from more than one of the people of knowledge that the list begins with the words: "There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things. There is no god but Allah; to Him belong the most beautiful names."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent ten men, among them Khubayb al-Anṣārī.
ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿIyāḍ informed me that the daughter of al-Ḥārith told him that when they gathered [to kill him], he borrowed a razor from her to shave with.

Then, when they brought him out of the Sacred Precinct to kill him, Khubayb al-Anṣārī said: "I do not care, so long as I am killed as a Muslim, on which side my death may fall for Allah. That is for the sake of God, and if He wills, He will bless the severed parts of a torn body." Then the son of al-Ḥārith killed him, and the Prophet ﷺ informed his Companions of their news on the day they were struck down.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:

"Allah will gather the believers on the Day of Resurrection in this way, and they will say: 'If only we asked someone to intercede for us with our Lord, so that He would relieve us of this place of ours.'
So they will come to Adam and say: 'O Adam, do you not see the people? Allah created you with His hand, made His angels prostrate to you, and taught you the names of all things.
Intercede for us with our Lord so that He relieves us of this place of ours.'
He will say: 'I am not in a position for that,' and he will mention to them the mistake he committed, 'but go to Noah,
for he was the first messenger Allah sent to the people of the earth.'
So they will come to Noah, and he will say: 'I am not in a position for that,' and he will mention the mistake he committed, 'but go to Abraham, the intimate friend of the Most Merciful.'

So they will come to Abraham, and he will say: 'I am not in a position for that,' and he will mention to them the mistakes he committed, 'but go to Moses, a servant to whom Allah gave the Torah and whom He spoke to directly.' So they will come to Moses, and he will say: 'I am not in a position for that,' and he will mention to them the mistake he committed, 'but go to Jesus, the servant of Allah, His messenger, His word, and a spirit from Him.'
So they will come to Jesus, and he will say: 'I am not in a position for that, but go to Muhammad ﷺ, a servant whose past and future sins have been forgiven.'
So they will come to me, and I will set out and ask permission to approach my Lord, and I will be permitted.

When I see my Lord, I will fall down prostrate before Him, and He will leave me as long as Allah wills. Then it will be said to me: 'Raise your head, Muḥammad. Speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted.'
So I will praise my Lord with words of praise He has taught me,
then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them into Paradise.
Then I will return, and when I see my Lord, I will fall down prostrate.
He will leave me as long as Allah wills. Then it will be said: 'Raise your head, Muḥammad. Speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted.'
So I will praise my Lord with words of praise my Lord has taught me, then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them into Paradise.
Then I will return, and when I see my Lord, I will fall down prostrate.
He will leave me as long as Allah wills. Then it will be said: 'Raise your head, Muḥammad. Speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted.'
So I will praise my Lord with words of praise He has taught me,
then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them into Paradise.
Then I will return and say: 'My Lord, none remains in the Fire except those whom the Qur'an has held back and for whom eternity has become obligatory.'" The Prophet ﷺ said:
"There will be brought out of the Fire whoever said: There is no god but Allah,
and had in his heart goodness equal to the weight of a barley grain.
Then there will be brought out of the Fire whoever said: There is no god but Allah,
and had in his heart goodness equal to the weight of a wheat grain.
Then there will be brought out of the Fire whoever said: There is no god but Allah,
and had in his heart goodness equal to the weight of a speck."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Zayd ibn Ḥārithah came complaining, and the Prophet ﷺ kept saying: "Fear Allah,
and keep your wife."
ʿĀʾishah said: "If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were to conceal anything, he would have concealed this."
He said: Zaynab used to boast over the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, saying: "Your families gave you in marriage,
but Allah, the Exalted, gave me in marriage from above seven heavens."
And from Thābit: {And you concealed within yourself what Allah was to bring to light, and you feared the people} was revealed concerning Zaynab and Zayd ibn Ḥārithah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Regarding His saying {So you did not spur against it any horses or camels}: Ṣāliḥ said: The Prophet ﷺ made peace with the people of Fadak and [other] villages, which he named but I do not remember them, while he was besieging other people, and they sent word to him seeking peace. He said: {So you did not spur against it any horses or camels}, meaning without fighting. Az-Zuhrī said: The Banū an-Naḍīr belonged exclusively to the Prophet ﷺ; they did not conquer them by force, but conquered them by a peace settlement. So the Prophet ﷺ distributed it among the Emigrants and gave the Helpers nothing of it, except two men who were in need.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz was made caliph, he gathered the Banū Marwān and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had Fadak. He used to spend from it, give from it to the young among the Banū Hāshim, and marry off their unmarried from it. Fāṭimah asked him to give it to her, but he refused. It remained so during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until he passed away. When Abū Bakr took charge, may Allah be pleased with him, he dealt with it as the Prophet ﷺ had dealt with it during his lifetime, until he passed away. When ʿUmar took charge, he dealt with it just as the two had done, until he passed away. Then Marwān was granted it as an estate, and then it came to ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz. He said, meaning ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz: I considered that a matter the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had denied to Fāṭimah, peace be upon her, is not a right of mine. So I call you to witness that I have returned it to what it was, meaning in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Fāṭimah, may Allah be pleased with her, came to Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, asking for her inheritance from the Prophet ﷺ. Abū Bakr said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"When Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, grants a prophet a source of food, it is for the one who takes charge after him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: [I heard it] from a man and it impressed me, so I said: Write it down for me. He brought it written down. ʿAbbās and ʿAlī entered upon ʿUmar, and with him were Ṭalḥah, az-Zubayr, ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān and Saʿd, while the two were disputing. ʿUmar said to Ṭalḥah, az-Zubayr, ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān and Saʿd: Do you not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"All the property of the Prophet ﷺ is charity (ṣadaqah), except what he gave his family to eat and to wear. We are not inherited from." They said: Yes.

He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to spend from his wealth on his family and give the surplus in charity. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, and Abū Bakr took charge of it for two years, doing what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do.
Then he mentioned something from the hadith of Mālik ibn Aws.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Concerning the near relatives, he said: They are the Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ put me in charge of the fifth of the fifth, and I disbursed it where it belonged during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the lifetime of Abū Bakr, and the lifetime of ʿUmar. Then wealth was brought and he called me and said: Take it.
I said: I do not want it.
He said: Take it, for you are more entitled to it.
I said: We have become independent of it. So he put it in the public treasury.
label: machine translation

segments_en: [ʿAlī], peace be upon him, said: I, al-ʿAbbās, and Fāṭimah gathered,
along with Zayd ibn Ḥārithah,

with the Prophet ﷺ, and I said: O Messenger of Allah, if you see fit to entrust me with our right in this fifth mentioned in the Book of Allah, so that I may distribute it during your lifetime and no one disputes with me after you, then please do so.

He said: So he did that. He said: I distributed it during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, entrusted it to me, until in the last year of ʿUmar's years, may Allah be pleased with him, a great deal of wealth came to him. He set aside our share, then sent for me. I said: This year we are free of need of it, while the Muslims have need of it, so return it to them. He returned it to them. After ʿUmar, no one called me to it. I met al-ʿAbbās after I left ʿUmar, and he said: O ʿAlī, you have deprived us this morning of something that will never be returned to us. And he was a shrewd man.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Salamah bore witness that he heard Abū Usayd al-Anṣārī testify that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
The best of the households of the Anṣār are Banū an-Najjār, then Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal, then Banū al-Ḥārith ibn al-Khazraj, then Banū Sāʿidah; and in all the households of the Anṣār there is goodness."
Abū Salamah said: Abū Usayd said, "Would I lie about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? Had I been lying, I would have started with my own people, Banū Sāʿidah."

That reached Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah, and he felt resentment in himself and said, "We have been left behind, so we became the last of the four! Saddle my donkey for me; I am going to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
His nephew Sahl spoke to him and said, "Are you going to contradict the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ knows best? Is it not enough for you to be the fourth of four?"
So he turned back and said, "Allah and His Messenger know best," and he ordered that his donkey be unsaddled.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Salamah and ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn ʿUtbah ibn Masʿūd heard Abū Hurayrah
say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, while he was in a large gathering of the Muslims: "
Shall I tell you of the best of the households of the Anṣār?"
They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal."
They said, "Then who, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "
Then Banū an-Najjār."
They said, "Then who, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "
Then Banū al-Ḥārith ibn al-Khazraj."
They said, "Then who, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "
Then Banū Sāʿidah."
They said, "Then who, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "
Then in all the households of the Anṣār there is goodness."

Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah stood up angrily and said, "Are we the last of the four, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has named their households?" He wanted to speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but men from his people said to him, "Sit down! Are you not pleased that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ named your household among the four households he named? Those he left out and did not name are more than those he named."
So Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah refrained from speaking to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "
Go to your people and say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Aslam, may Allah keep them safe, and Ghifār, may Allah forgive them.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: With this chain of narration.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Bishr, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd and Ibn Abī ʿUmar said: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ath-Thaqafī narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Muḥammad,
from Abū Hurayrah;
and (another chain) ʿUbaydullāh ibn Muʿādh narrated to us,
my father narrated to us; and (another chain)
Muḥammad ibn al-Muthannā narrated to us, ʿAbd
ar-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us; both said: Shuʿbah narrated to us,
from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād,
from Abū Hurayrah;
and (another chain) Muḥammad ibn Rāfiʿ narrated to me, Shabābah narrated to us, Warqāʾ narrated to me,
from Abū az-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj,
from Abū Hurayrah;
and (another chain) Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabīb narrated to us,
Rawḥ ibn ʿUbādah narrated to us;
and (another chain) Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh
ibn Numayr and ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Abū ʿĀṣim,
both from Ibn Jurayj,
from Abū az-Zubayr, from Jābir;
and (another chain) Salamah ibn Shabīb narrated to me,
al-Ḥasan ibn Aʿyan narrated to us, Maʿqil narrated to us,
from Abū az-Zubayr, from Jābir;
all of them said, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: "
Aslam, may Allah keep them safe, and Ghifār, may Allah forgive them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: and al-Ḥulwānī,
and ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd,
from Yaʿqūb ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd, my father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ,
all of them from Nāfiʿ,
from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ,
the same; and in the report of Ṣāliḥ and Usāmah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that from the pulpit.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Like the reports of these narrators from Ibn ʿUmar.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: "
Aslam, Ghifār, Muzaynah, and those of Juhaynah (or Juhaynah) are better than Banū Tamīm, Banū ʿĀmir, and their two allies, Asad and Ghaṭafān."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, and he said to me, "The first charity that brightened the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the faces of his Companions was the charity of Ṭayyiʾ, which I brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ established brotherhood between Abū ʿUbaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ and Abū Ṭalḥah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We set out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Makkah, heading for Madīnah. When we were near ʿAzwarā, he dismounted, raised his hands and supplicated to Allah for a while, then fell down in prostration and remained so for a long time. Then he stood, raised his hands and supplicated to Allah for a while, then fell down in prostration and remained so for a long time. Then he stood and raised his hands for a while, then fell down in prostration. Aḥmad mentioned this three times. He said:

"I asked my Lord and interceded for my community, and He gave me a third of my community. So I fell down in prostration in gratitude to my Lord. Then I raised my head and asked my Lord for my community, and He gave me a third of my community. So I fell down in prostration to my Lord in gratitude. Then I raised my head and asked my Lord for my community, and He gave me the other third. So I fell down in prostration to my Lord."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The best time for a man to come in to his family when he returns from a journey is at the beginning of the night."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from his Hajj, he entered Madīnah and made his camel kneel at the door of his mosque. Then he entered it, prayed two rakʿahs in it, and then went to his house.
Nāfiʿ said: Ibn ʿUmar used to do the same.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Beware of al-qasāmah."
He said: We asked, "What is al-qasāmah?" He said:
"Something that is shared among people, and then someone comes and takes a portion of it for himself."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When we conquered Khaybar, they brought out their spoils of goods and captives, and the people began to trade their spoils with one another. Then a man came, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had prayed, and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have made a profit today such as no one else in this valley has made." He said:
"Woe to you! What have you earned?"
He said, "I kept buying and selling until I made a profit of three hundred ūqiyahs." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Shall I tell you about the man who has made the best profit?"
He said, "What is it, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"Two rakʿahs after the prayer."
label: machine translation

segments_en: After he had finished with the people of Badr, I came to the Prophet ﷺ with the foal of a mare of mine called al-Qarḥāʾ. I said, "O Muḥammad, I have brought you the foal of al-Qarḥāʾ for you to take." He said:
"I have no need of it, but if you wish, I will give you in exchange for it the choicest of the coats of mail from Badr."
I said, "I would not exchange it today for a [mere] blaze." He said:
"Then I have no need of it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: To proceed: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever associates with a polytheist and lives with him is like him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw ʿAlī sacrificing two rams. I said, "What is this?" He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ charged me to offer a sacrifice on his behalf, so I am sacrificing on his behalf."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Dhū Miṣr said: I came to ʿUtbah ibn ʿAbd al-Sulamī and said, "O Abū al-Walīd, I went out looking for animals to sacrifice and found nothing that pleased me except a tharmāʾ, which I disliked. What do you say?" He said, "Why did you not bring it to me?"

I said, "Glory be to Allah! It would be acceptable from you but not from me?" He said, "Yes, because you doubt and I do not doubt.
