label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"The believer is the one whom people trust with their wealth and their lives, and the emigrant is the one who abandons wrongdoings and sins."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We seized some sheep belonging to the enemy and plundered them, and we set up our cooking pots. The Prophet ﷺ passed by the pots and ordered that they be overturned, and they were overturned. Then he said:
"Plundering is not permissible."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The believer is more honored in the sight of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, than some of His angels."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, saying: "O Messenger of Allah, is it tribalism for a man to love his people?" He said:
"No, but tribalism is for a man to help his people in wrongdoing."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Indeed my nation will never agree upon misguidance. So if you see disagreement, then stay with the great majority."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There will be trials in which a man will wake up a believer and end the evening a disbeliever, except for those whom Allah keeps alive through knowledge."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"How will you be, Abū Dharr, when death afflicts the people so that a house is worth a slave boy?"
— meaning the grave. I said: "Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me" — or he said: "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said: "Be patient." Then he said:
"How will you be when hunger afflicts the people so that you come to your mosque and cannot return to your bed, and cannot get up from your bed to go to your mosque?"
He said: I said: "Allah and His Messenger know best" — or: "Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me." He said: "Keep to chastity." Then he said:
"How will you be when killing afflicts the people so that the stones of az-Zayt are drowned in blood?"
I said: "Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me." He said:
"Join those you belong to."
He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, should I not take up my sword and strike whoever does that?" He said:
"Then you would be a partner with the people. Rather, enter your house."
I said: "O Messenger of Allah, what if he enters my house?" He said:
"If you fear that the gleam of the sword will dazzle you, then throw the edge of your garment over your face, so that he bears his sin and yours and becomes one of the people of the Fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told us:
"Before the Hour there will be harj."
He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, what is harj?" He said: "Killing."
Some of the Muslims said: "O Messenger of Allah, we now kill so many of the polytheists in a single year."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"It is not the killing of the polytheists, but that some of you will kill others, until a man kills his neighbor, his cousin, and his relative."
Some of the people said: "O Messenger of Allah, will we have our minds with us on that day?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The minds of most people of that time will be removed, and there will remain worthless dregs of people who have no minds."

Then al-Ashʿarī said: "By Allah, I think it will overtake me and you. By Allah, if it overtakes us, I have no way out for myself or for you in what our Prophet ﷺ instructed us, except that we come out of it as we entered it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I entered upon Muḥammad ibn Maslamah, and he said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There will be a trial, division, and disagreement. When that happens, take your sword to a rock and strike it until it breaks, then sit in your house until a sinful hand or a decisive death comes to you."
And it has indeed occurred, and I have done what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Among the worst of people in standing with Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a servant who has sold his Hereafter for the worldly gain of another."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Beware of trials, for in them the tongue is like the striking of the sword."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went on the expedition to Khaybar. [Anas] said: We prayed the dawn prayer near it while it was still dark. Then the Prophet of Allah ﷺ mounted, and Abū Ṭalḥah mounted, and I was riding behind Abū Ṭalḥah. The Prophet of Allah ﷺ urged his mount along the lane of Khaybar, and my knee was touching the thigh of the Prophet of Allah ﷺ. The waist-wrapper slipped back from the thigh of the Prophet of Allah ﷺ, and I could see the whiteness of the thigh of the Prophet of Allah ﷺ. When he entered the town, he said:
"Allahu akbar! Khaybar is ruined! When we descend upon the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned."

He said it three times. [Anas] said: The people had gone out to their work, and they said, "Muhammad!" ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz said: Some of our companions said, "And the army!" [Anas] said: And we took it by force.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Khaybar, he said:
"When we descend upon the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It is reported from the Prophet ﷺ that a man came to him and admitted before him that he had committed unlawful intercourse with a woman whom he named. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for the woman and asked her about it, but she denied having committed unlawful intercourse. So he flogged the man with the prescribed punishment and left her.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man

committed unlawful intercourse with a woman. The Prophet ﷺ gave an order concerning him, and he was flogged with the prescribed punishment. Then it was reported that he was married, so he gave an order concerning him, and he was stoned.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A woman,
meaning from Ghāmid, came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I have committed adultery." He said, "Go back."
So she went back. The next day she came to him and said, "Perhaps you intend to send me away as you sent away Māʿiz ibn Mālik. By Allah, I am pregnant." He said to her, "Go back."
So she went back. The next day she came to him, and he said to her,
"Go back until you give birth."
So she went back, and when she had given birth she came to him with the child and said, "This is the one I have given birth to." He said to her,
"Go back and nurse him until you wean him."

Then she came with him after she had weaned him, and in his hand was something he was eating. He ordered that the child be given to one of the Muslims, and he gave the order concerning her, so a pit was dug for her, and he ordered that she be stoned, and she was stoned. Khālid was among those stoning her, and he struck her with a stone, and a drop of her blood spattered on his cheek, so he cursed her. The Prophet ﷺ said to him,
"Gently, Khālid! By the One in whose hand is my soul, she has repented with a repentance that, if a tax collector had repented with it, he would have been forgiven."
Then he gave the order concerning her, and the funeral prayer was offered for her, and she was buried.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ stoned a woman, and a pit was dug for her up to her breast.
label: machine translation

segments_en: They passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a Jewish man whose face had been blackened, and he was being paraded around. He adjured them [to tell him], "What is the punishment for the adulterer in your book?" They referred him to one of their men, so the Prophet ﷺ adjured him:
"What is the punishment for the adulterer in your book?"
He said, "Stoning. But adultery became widespread among our nobles, and we disliked that the noble be left alone while the punishment was carried out on those beneath him, so we did away with it."
So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the order concerning him, and he was stoned. Then he said,
"O Allah, I am the first to revive what they had put to death of Your Book."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A group of Jews came and invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to the Quff. So he went to them at the house of study, and they said, "O Abū al-Qāsim, a man of ours committed adultery with a woman, so judge between them." They placed a cushion for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he sat on it. Then he said, "Bring me the Torah."
It was brought, and he removed the cushion from beneath him and placed the Torah on it. Then he said,
"I believe in you and in the One who revealed you." Then he said, "Bring me the most knowledgeable of you."
So a young man was brought. Then he mentioned the story of the stoning, similar to the hadith of Mālik from Nāfiʿ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man and a woman of the Jews, both of whom were married, committed adultery when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Medina. Stoning had been prescribed for them in the Torah, but they abandoned it and adopted the tajbiyah: the offender would be struck a hundred times with a rope coated in tar and carried on a donkey with his face towards the donkey's rear. Some of their rabbis gathered and sent other people to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, saying, "Ask him about the punishment for the adulterer."

And he related the hadith. He said in it: They were not of his religion, so he would not necessarily judge between them, and he was given the choice in that. He said: {If they come to you, then judge between them or turn away from them.}
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Jews brought a man and a woman of theirs who had committed adultery. He said, "Bring me two of the most knowledgeable men among you." So they brought him the two sons of Ṣūriyā, and he adjured them:
"How do you find the ruling for these two in the Torah?"
They said, "We find in the Torah that if four witnesses testify that they saw his organ in her private part like the kohl stick in the kohl container, [the penalty is] stoning." He said,
"Then what prevents you from stoning them?"

They said, "Our authority has gone, and we disliked killing." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for the witnesses, and they brought four, who testified that they saw his organ in her private part like the kohl stick in the kohl container. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the order for them to be stoned.
label: machine translation

segments_en: With something similar to it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: While I was going around searching

for some camels of mine that had gone astray, a group of riders, or horsemen, with a banner came up. The Bedouins began gathering around me because of my standing with the Prophet ﷺ. Then they came to a tent and brought a man out of it and struck off his neck. I asked about him, and they said that he had married his father's wife.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Regarding an unmarried person who is found committing the act of the people of Lūṭ, he said: He is to be stoned.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Sharīk, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ, and Abū
Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to them from ʿĀṣim,
from Abū Razīn,
from Ibn ʿAbbās,
who said: There is no prescribed punishment for the one who has intercourse with an animal.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed with Abū Ayyūb. Whenever he ate food, he would send the leftovers to him. One day he sent him some food, but the Prophet ﷺ did not eat any of it. When Abū Ayyūb came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him, he said, "It has garlic in it."
He said, "O Messenger of Allah, is it forbidden?" He said,
"No, but I dislike it because of its smell."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The food of one person is enough for two, the food of two is enough for four, and the food of four is enough for eight."
In the narration of Isḥāq, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
He did not mention "I heard."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with ʿUtbah ibn Farqad when a letter from ʿUmar came to us, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"None wears silk except one who will have no share of it in the Hereafter, except this much."
Abū ʿUthmān said, indicating with his two fingers next to the thumb:
And I saw them as the buttons of the cloaks when I saw the cloaks.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he delivered a sermon at al-Jābiyah and said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ forbade silk, except for the space of two fingers, or three, or four.
label: machine translation

segments_en: One day the Prophet ﷺ wore a brocade coat that had been given to him as a gift, and soon afterward he took it off and sent it to ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb. It was said to him, "How quickly you have taken it off, O Messenger of Allah!" He said,
"Jibrīl forbade me from it."
Then ʿUmar came to him weeping and said, "O Messenger of Allah, you disliked something and yet gave it to me; what is [the ruling] for me?" He said,
"I did not give it to you to wear; I gave it to you so that you would sell it."
So he sold it for two thousand dirhams.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw me wearing two garments dyed with safflower, and he said,
"These are among the clothes of the disbelievers, so do not wear them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: They asked Anas about the ring of
the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said, "It is as if I can see the gleam of his silver ring."
And he raised his left little finger.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAlī said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade me from wearing a ring on this finger or this one.
He said: And he pointed to the middle finger and the one next to it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey, and he said,
"Get plenty of sandals, for a man continues to be like a rider as long as he is wearing sandals."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said,
"When any of you puts on sandals, let him begin with the right; and when he takes them off, let him begin with the left. Let him wear both or take off both."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image."
He said, "Come with us to the Mother of the Believers, ʿĀʾishah, so we may ask her about that."

So we went and said, "O Mother of the Believers, Abū Ṭalḥah narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ such and such. Did you hear the Prophet ﷺ mention that?" She said, "No, but I will tell you what I saw him do. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out on one of his military expeditions, and I was waiting for his return. I took a woven cover we had and hung it across the width [of the room]. When he came, I met him and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Praise be to Allah who has given you honor and dignity.' He looked at the house and saw the cover, and he did not respond to me at all, and I saw dislike in his face. He went to the cover and tore it down, then said,
"Allah has not commanded us, in what He has provided us, to clothe stones and clay."
She said: So I cut it up and made two cushions from it and stuffed them with palm fiber, and he did not object to that."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wife of the Prophet ﷺ said: We had a curtain with the image of a bird on it, facing whoever entered the house. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said,
"O ʿĀʾishah, remove it, for whenever I enter and see it, I remember the world."
She said: We also had a velvet cloth with a pattern on it, which we used to wear, and we did not cut it up.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I had a cloth in my house with images on it, so I placed it over a shelf in the house, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pray toward it. Then he said,
"O ʿĀʾishah, take it away from me."
So I took it down and made it into cushions.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wife of the Prophet ﷺ [said] that she hung a curtain with images on it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered and took it down. She said: So I cut it into two cushions.

Then a man in the gathering at that time, called Rabīʿah ibn ʿAṭāʾ, a freed slave of Banū Zuhrah, said, "Did you not hear Abū Muḥammad mention that ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to lean on them?" Ibn al-Qāsim said, "No."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Jadīlah of Qays: The governor of Makkah delivered a sermon and then said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made a covenant with us that we should perform the rites [of Hajj] upon sighting [the crescent]; and if we do not see it, but two just witnesses testify, we perform the rites on their testimony." So I asked al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥārith, "Who is the governor of Makkah?" He said, "I do not know."

Then he met me afterwards and said, "He is al-Ḥārith ibn Ḥāṭib, the brother of Muḥammad ibn Ḥāṭib." Then the governor said, "Among you is one who knows Allah and His Messenger better than I, and he witnessed this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ,"
and he gestured with his hand toward a man. Al-Ḥusayn said: I asked an old man beside me, "Who is this man the governor gestured to?" He said, "This is ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar."
And he spoke truly; he was more knowledgeable about Allah than he was. [Ibn ʿUmar] said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to do this."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The people were trying to sight the crescent, and I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I had seen it. So he fasted it and commanded the people to fast it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: What an excellent pre-dawn meal for the believer is dates."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When any of you hears the call to prayer while the vessel is in his hand, let him not put it down until he has fulfilled his need from it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Al-Muqaffaʿ said: I saw Ibn ʿUmar take hold of his beard and cut off what exceeded a handful. He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ broke his fast, he would say:
"The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It reached him that the Prophet ﷺ, when he broke his fast, would say:
"O Allah, for You I have fasted, and with Your provision I have broken my fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ, who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, on his journey in the year of the Conquest, command the people to break their fast, and he said, "Strengthen yourselves against your enemy."
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ [himself] fasted.
Abū Bakr said: The one who narrated to me said, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-ʿArj pouring water over his head while he was fasting, because of thirst or because of heat."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The one who performs cupping and the one who has it performed have both broken their fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came upon a man at al-Baqīʿ who was having himself cupped, while he was holding my hand, on the eighteenth night of Ramadan that had passed, and he said:
"The one who performs cupping and the one who has it performed have both broken their fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"The one who performs cupping and the one who has it performed have both broken their fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The one who performs cupping and the one who has it performed have both broken their fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had himself cupped while he was fasting.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade cupping and continuous fasting, without making them unlawful, out of mercy for his Companions. It was said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, you fast continuously until the pre-dawn." He said:
"I fast continuously until the pre-dawn, [but] my Lord feeds me and gives me drink."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Anas said: We only used to avoid cupping for the fasting person because of the dislike of the exhaustion.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The fast is not broken by one who vomits, nor by one who has a wet dream, nor by one who is cupped."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ: He commanded the use of perfumed antimony at bedtime, and said, "Let the fasting person guard against it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I did not see any of our companions dislike kohl for the fasting person, and Ibrāhīm would permit the fasting person to apply kohl made with aloe.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: I became passionate and kissed [my wife] while I was fasting,
so I said, "O Messenger of Allah, today I did something serious: I kissed while I was fasting." He said:
"What do you think if you were to rinse your mouth with water while you are fasting?"
ʿĪsā ibn Ḥammād said in his narration: I said, "There is no harm in it."
Then the two [narrators] agreed; he said, "Then what [is the issue]?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, having broken his fast in Ramadan, with this hadith.
He said: Then a large basket containing about fifteen ṣāʿ of dates was brought, and he said in it:
"Eat it, you and your family, and fast one day and seek forgiveness from Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With this account, he said: Then a large basket containing twenty ṣāʿ was brought.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said [something] like the hadith of Ibn Kathīr and Sulaymān.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I ate and drank forgetfully while I was fasting." He said:
"Allah fed you and gave you drink."
label: machine translation

segments_en: If a man falls ill in Ramadan and then dies without having fasted, food is given on his behalf and no make-up is required of him; but if he had a vow [of fasting] upon him, his guardian makes it up on his behalf.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us leaning on a staff, and when we saw him, we stood up. He said:
"Do not do as the Persians do with their great men."
We said, "O Messenger of Allah, if only you would supplicate to Allah for us." He said:
"O Allah, forgive us, have mercy on us, be pleased with us, accept from us, admit us into Paradise, save us from the Fire, and set right all our affairs."
He said: It was as if we wanted him to say more, so he said:
"Have I not gathered the whole matter for you?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Ask Allah for beneficial knowledge, and seek refuge in Allah from knowledge that does not benefit."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught her this supplication:

"O Allah, I ask You for all good, its immediate and its delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil, its immediate and its delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your servant and Prophet asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what Your servant and Prophet sought refuge from. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it, of word or deed, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings one closer to it, of word or deed. And I ask You to make every decree You have decreed for me good."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ passed away, [Abū Bakr] said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood in this place of mine last year, then Abū Bakr wept, and then he said:

"Hold fast to truthfulness, for it goes with righteousness, and both are in Paradise. Beware of lying, for it goes with wickedness, and both are in the Fire. Ask Allah for well-being, for after certainty no one has been given anything better than well-being. Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not sever ties with one another, and do not turn your backs on one another. And be, O servants of Allah, brothers."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There is no supplication a servant can make better than: 'O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"May Allah have mercy on us and on the brother of ʿĀd."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Greatest Name of Allah, by which, when He is called upon, He answers, is in three sūrahs: al-Baqarah, Āl ʿImrān, and Ṭā Hā.
label: machine translation

segments_en: O Allah, I ask You by Your name, the Pure, the Good, the Blessed, the most beloved to You, that when You are called upon by it You answer, when You are asked by it You give, when mercy is sought by it You show mercy, and when relief is sought by it You grant relief."
She said: And one day he said:
"O ʿĀʾishah, do you know that Allah has guided me to the name by which, when He is called upon, He answers?"
She said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be ransomed for you, teach it to me." He said:
"It is not appropriate for you, O ʿĀʾishah."
She said: So I withdrew and sat for a while, then I got up, kissed his head, and said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach it to me." He said:
"It is not appropriate for you, O ʿĀʾishah, that I teach it to you, because it is not appropriate for you to ask anything of this world by it."

She said: So I got up, performed ablution, then prayed two rak‘ahs, then said: "O Allah, I call upon You as Allah, I call upon You as the Most Merciful, I call upon You as the Kind, the Compassionate, and I call upon You by all Your Most Beautiful Names, what I know of them and what I do not know, to forgive me and have mercy on me."
She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ laughed, then said:
"It is among the names by which you have called."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A father's supplication reaches past the veil."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There is no servant who spends the night in a state of purity, then wakes during the night and asks Allah for something of the affairs of this world or the Hereafter, except that He gives it to him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ went out of his house, he would say:
"In the name of Allah; there is no power and no strength except with Allah; my reliance is upon Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ saw a cloud approaching from any horizon, he would leave whatever he was doing, even if he was in prayer, until he faced it, and he would say:
"O Allah, we seek refuge in You from the evil of what it has been sent with."
If it rained, he would say:
"O Allah, a beneficial downpour."
[He would say it] twice or three times. And if Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, cleared it away and it did not rain, he would praise Allah for that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"The horizons will be opened up to you, and a city called Qazwīn will be opened up to you. Whoever stations himself there on guard for forty days or forty nights will have in Paradise a pillar of gold, upon which is a green chrysolite, over which is a dome of red ruby, which has seventy thousand gold doors, and at each door is a wife from among the wide-eyed maidens of Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I wanted to go out for jihad with you, seeking thereby the Face of Allah and the Hereafter." He said:
"Woe to you! Is your mother alive?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Go back and be dutiful to her."
Then I came to him from the other side and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I wanted to go out for jihad with you, seeking thereby the Face of Allah and the Hereafter." He said:
"Woe to you! Is your mother alive?"
I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said:
"Then go back to her and be dutiful to her."
Then I came to him from in front of him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I wanted to go out for jihad with you, seeking thereby the Face of Allah and the Hereafter." He said:
"Woe to you! Is your mother alive?"
I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said:
"Woe to you! Stay at her feet, for there is Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever keeps a horse tethered in the cause of Allah, then tends its fodder with his own hand, will have a good deed for every grain."
label: machine translation

segments_en: War was at hand, and ʿAbdullāh ibn Rawāḥah said, "O soul, I see that you dislike Paradise. I swear by Allah, you will enter it willingly or you will be made to enter it unwillingly."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which jihad is best?" He said:
"The one whose blood is spilled and whose horse is hamstrung."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The martyrs were mentioned in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, and he said:

"The earth does not dry from the blood of the martyr before his two wives hasten to him, like two gazelles that have lost their fawns in an open stretch of land. In the hand of each of them is a garment better than the world and all that is in it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He fell ill, and the Prophet ﷺ came to visit him. One of his family said, "We had hoped that his death would be by being killed as a martyr in the cause of Allah."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Then the martyrs of my Ummah would be few indeed! Being killed in the cause of Allah is martyrdom, one who dies of plague is a martyr, a woman who dies in childbirth is a martyr—meaning a pregnant woman—and one who drowns, one who burns, and one who dies of pleurisy—meaning pleurisy—is a martyr."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took as a special share his sword Dhū al-Faqār on the day of Badr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah went on a military expedition with the Prophet ﷺ, he would carry a spear with him, and when he returned he would throw down his spear until it was carried for him.
ʿAlī said to him, "I will certainly mention that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So he said:
"Do not do that, for if you do, no lost item will be picked up."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had an Arabian bow in his hand, and he saw a man with a Persian bow in his hand, and he said:
"What is this? Throw it away, and take to this one and the like of it, and to spears of cane, for by them Allah strengthens the religion and establishes you firmly in the land."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever shoots an arrow at the enemy and his arrow reaches the enemy, whether it hits or misses, it equals the freeing of a slave."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever learns archery and then abandons it has disobeyed me."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to Madinah and saw the Prophet ﷺ standing on the pulpit, with Bilāl standing in front of him wearing a sword, and there was a black banner. I said, "Who is this?" They said, "This is ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ, who has come back from a military expedition."
label: machine translation

segments_en: She brought out a jubbah buttoned with brocade and said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to wear this when he met the enemy."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He used to forbid silk and brocade,
except what was like this—then he pointed with his finger, then a second, then a third, then a fourth—and he said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid us from it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw a man ask my father about a man

who goes out on a military expedition and buys, sells and trades during his expedition. My father said to him, "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Tabūk, buying and selling, and he saw us and did not forbid us."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"That I should see off a fighter in the cause of Allah and take care of his baggage for a morning or an evening is dearer to me than the world and all that is in it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bade me farewell and said:
"I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Companion of the Prophet ﷺ used to say, "Beware of the detachment that, if it meets the enemy, flees, and if it takes spoils, steals from them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Were it not for a statement I heard from
ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥamiq al-Khuzāʿī, I would walk between the head of al-Mukhtār and his body. I heard him say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever grants a man security for his life and then kills him will carry the banner of treachery on the Day of Resurrection."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I entered upon al-Mukhtār in his palace, and he said: "Jibrāʾīl has just now left me."
What kept me from striking his neck was only a hadith I heard from Sulaymān ibn Ṣurad from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
"If a man trusts you with his life, do not kill him."
That is what kept me from him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"A woman who kills intentionally is not to be executed until she gives birth to what is in her womb, if she is pregnant, and until she secures care for her child. And if she commits adultery, she is not to be stoned until she gives birth to what is in her womb and until she secures care for her child."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The deprived one is the one who is deprived of his will."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever dies leaving a will dies upon the right path and the Sunnah, dies in a state of piety and martyrdom, and dies forgiven."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever flees from giving his heir his inheritance, Allah will cut off his inheritance from Paradise on the Day of Resurrection."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"A man may do the deeds of the people of goodness for seventy years, but when he makes a will he acts unjustly in his will, so his life is sealed with the worst of his deeds and he enters the Fire. And a man may do the deeds of the people of evil for seventy years, but he is just in his will, so his life is sealed with the best of his deeds and he enters Paradise."
Abū Hurayrah said: "Recite, if you wish: {These are the limits set by Allah} up to His saying {a humiliating punishment}."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever is approaching death and makes a will in accordance with the Book of Allah, it will be an expiation for the zakāh he neglected during his life."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, tell me who is most deserving of my good companionship." He said:
"Yes, by your father, I will tell you: your mother."
He said: "Then who?" He said: "Then your mother."
He said: "Then who?" He said: "Then your mother."
He said: "Then who?" He said: "Then your father."
He said: "Tell me, O Messenger of Allah, about my wealth, how should I give charity from it?" He said:

"Yes, by Allah, I will tell you: that you give charity while you are healthy and miserly, hoping for a long life and fearing poverty, and not delay until, when your soul reaches here, you say: 'My wealth is for so-and-so, and my wealth is for so-and-so,' and it is theirs even if you dislike it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ spat in his palm, then placed his index finger on it and said:

"Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: 'O son of Adam, how can you escape Me when I created you from the like of this? Then when your soul reaches this' — and he pointed to his throat — 'you say: I will give charity.' But how can there be a time for charity then?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Indeed Allah has given you in charity, at the time of your death, a third of your wealth, as an increase for you in your deeds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"O son of Adam, there are two things you had no part in: I made for you a share of your wealth when I seized you by the throat, to purify you and cleanse you by it, and the prayer of My servants for you after the end of your life term."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"O Abū Hurayrah, learn the laws of inheritance and teach them, for they are half of knowledge. They are forgotten, and they are the first thing to be taken away from my Ummah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I heard the Prophet ﷺ was brought a case of inheritance in which there was a grandfather, and he gave him a third or a sixth.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that a grandfather who was among us receives a sixth.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a grandmother a sixth of the inheritance.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: "There are three matters which, had the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made them clear to us, would be dearer to me than the world and all that is in it: the kalālah, usury, and the caliphate."
label: machine translation

segments_en: My freed master died and left a daughter, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided his estate between me and his daughter, giving me half and her half.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said:
"The killer does not inherit."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to accept the pledge of allegiance from women by speech, with this verse: "that they will not associate anything with Allah." She said: And the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never touched the hand of a woman,
except a woman whom he possessed [by marriage].
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar [spoke] a second time when he sat on the pulpit,

and that was the day after the Prophet ﷺ died. He recited the testimony of faith while Abū Bakr was silent and did not speak. He said, "I had hoped that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would live until he had managed our affairs," meaning until he would be the last of them. "Now if Muhammad ﷺ has died,
Allah the Exalted has placed among you a light by which you are guided, with that by which Allah guided Muhammad ﷺ. And Abū Bakr is the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the second of the two,
and he is the most deserving of the Muslims to take charge of your affairs. So rise and pledge allegiance to him."
A group of them had already pledged allegiance to him before that in the courtyard of Banū Sāʿidah,
and the general pledge of allegiance took place at the pulpit.
Al-Zuhrī reported from Anas ibn Mālik: I heard ʿUmar say to Abū Bakr that day, "Ascend the pulpit."
He kept urging him until he ascended the pulpit,
and the people all pledged allegiance to him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: [Abū Bakr said] to the delegation of Buzākhah: "You will follow the tails of camels until Allah shows the successor of His Prophet ﷺ and the Muhājirūn some matter by which they will excuse you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do not wish to meet the enemy,
and ask Allah for well-being."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There was a man from the Anṣār who, whenever he was absent from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I was present, would come to me with what had happened with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and whenever I was absent from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he was present, he would come to me with what had happened with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in an upper room of his,
and a black servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was at the top of the steps. I said, "Say: this is ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb," and he permitted me [to enter].
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Muslims pledged allegiance to Abū Bakr,

and he took his seat on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, ʿUmar recited the testimony of faith before Abū Bakr and said, "To proceed: Allah chose for His Messenger ﷺ what is with Him over what is with you,
and this is the Book by which Allah guided your Messenger, so hold to it and you will be guided, for Allah only guided His Messenger by it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Allah will enrich you, or [he said] will make you content, through Islam and through Muhammad ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I sat with Shaybah in this mosque. He said: ʿUmar sat with me in this place of yours and said, "I intended not to leave in it [the Kaʿbah] any yellow [gold] or white [silver] without dividing it among the Muslims."
I said, "You will not do that." He said, "Why?"
I said, "Your two companions did not do it." He said, "They are the two men to be followed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: [He was] their freed slave, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Ghāfiqī; both of them heard Ibn ʿUmar
say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Allah has cursed wine, the one who drinks it, the one who serves it, the one who sells it, the one who buys it, the one who presses it, the one for whom it is pressed, the one who carries it, and the one to whom it is carried."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Indeed, from grapes comes wine, from dates comes wine, from honey comes wine, from wheat comes wine, and from barley comes wine."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ghanm came to us and we discussed ṭilāʾ (boiled grape juice). He said: Abū Mālik al-Ashʿarī narrated to me
that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"Some people of my nation will drink wine, calling it by a name other than its own."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from the chipped part of a cup and blowing into a drink.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"The one who serves the people drink should be the last of them to drink."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ held a wedding feast for Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy with barley meal and dates.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out of the toilet and food was brought to him. They said: Shall we not bring you water for ablution? He said:
"I was only commanded to perform ablution when I stand for prayer."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating the jallālah and drinking its milk.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating the meat of horses, mules and donkeys. Ḥaywah added: and every predatory animal with fangs.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey and we stopped at a stopping place. The people caught some lizards, and I took a lizard and grilled it, then brought it to the Prophet ﷺ. He took a stick and began counting his fingers with it, then said:
"A nation from the Children of Israel was transformed into creatures that crawl on the earth, and I do not know which creatures they are."
I said: Messenger of Allah, the people have eaten from them. He said: So he neither commanded eating them nor forbade it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, he said: When the Prophet ﷺ ate or drank, he would say:
"Praise be to Allah, who fed us and gave us drink and made us Muslims."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Fāṭimah bint al-Ḥusayn, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, from his mother,
Fāṭimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Beware! Let no one blame anyone but himself if he spends the night with the smell of greasy food on his hand."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was present when the Bedouins were asking the Prophet ﷺ: Is there any blame on us in such-and-such? Is there any blame on us in such-and-such? He said to them:
"Servants of Allah, Allah has removed blame, except for the one who wrongs his brother's honor; that is the one who is blameworthy."
They said: Messenger of Allah, is there any sin upon us if we seek medical treatment? He said:
"Seek treatment, servants of Allah, for Allah, glorified is He, has not placed a disease except that He placed with it a cure, except old age."
They said: Messenger of Allah, what is the best thing a servant is given? He said: "Good character."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon me, and with him was ʿAlī, may peace be upon him, who was recovering from an illness. We had bunches of ripe dates hanging up. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood and began eating from them, and ʿAlī stood to eat too, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept saying to ʿAlī:
"Stop! You are still recovering."
until ʿAlī, peace be upon him, held back.
She said: I prepared barley and beet greens and brought it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"ʿAlī, take some of this, for it is more beneficial for you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade cauterization.
He said: We were tested, so we cauterized ourselves, but we neither prospered nor succeeded.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade harmful medicine, meaning poison.
label: machine translation

segments_en: "Superstitious omen-taking is shirk, superstitious omen-taking is shirk," three times,
and there is none among us [who is free of it], but Allah removes it through reliance [upon Him]."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the hand of a man with leprosy and put it with him in the bowl, then said:
"Eat, in the name of Allah, with trust in Allah and reliance upon Him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:

"Any slave who makes a contract of emancipation for one hundred ūqiyyahs and pays it except for ten ūqiyyahs remains a slave, and any slave who makes a contract of emancipation for one hundred dinars and pays it except for ten dinars remains a slave."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Fāṭimah, may Allah be pleased with her, and found a curtain over her door, so he did not enter. [The narrator] said: He rarely entered [a house] without beginning with her. Then ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, came and saw her distressed, and said, "What is the matter with you?" She said, "The Prophet ﷺ came to me but did not enter." So ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, went to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, it distressed Fāṭimah greatly that you came to her and did not enter." He said, "
What have I to do with the world, and what have I to do with decorated fabrics?"
So [ʿAlī] went to Fāṭimah and told her what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had said. She said, "Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ what he commands me to do with it." He said, "
Tell her to send it to the family of so-and-so."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A garment of fine silk brocade was given as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ,
and he used to forbid silk,
so the people marveled at it. He said, "
By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the handkerchiefs of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh in Paradise are better than this."
Saʿīd said, from Qatādah, from Anas:
that Ukaydir of Dūmah gave it as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar saw a luxurious garment being sold on a man, and he said to the Prophet ﷺ, "Buy this garment, so that you may wear it on Friday and when delegations come to you." He said, "
Only one who has no share in the Hereafter wears this."
Then some garments of that kind were brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he sent one of them to ʿUmar.
ʿUmar said, "How can I wear it when you said about it what you said?" He said, "
I did not give it to you for you to wear it;
rather, you may sell it or give it as clothing to someone."
So ʿUmar sent it to a brother of his from the people of Makkah before he had accepted Islam.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Emigrants came from Makkah to Madinah, they came with nothing in their hands, and the Anṣār were the people of land and property. The Anṣār shared with them on the basis that they would give them half of the fruits of their properties every year, and would spare them the work and the expense. The mother of Anas ibn Mālik, who was called Umm Sulaym, was also the mother of ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, who was Anas's maternal brother. Umm Anas had given the Messenger of Allah ﷺ some date palms of hers, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave them to Umm Ayman, his freed slave woman, the mother of Usāmah ibn Zayd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There are three things that it is not lawful for anyone to do: a man must not lead people in prayer and single himself out for supplication to the exclusion of them; if he does so, he has betrayed them. Nor may he look into the inside of a house before asking permission; if he does so, he has [in effect] entered. Nor may he pray while holding back urine or stool, until he has relieved himself."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There is no prayer for the one who has no wudūʾ, and no wudūʾ for the one who does not mention the name of Allah over it, and no prayer for the one who does not send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, and no prayer for the one who does not love the Anṣār."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Water for wudūʾ was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he performed wudūʾ: he washed his hands three times, then rinsed his mouth and sniffed water into his nose three times, and washed his face three times, then washed his forearms three times each, then wiped his head and his ears, both the outside and the inside of them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Indeed al-Najāshī
gave the Prophet ﷺ a pair of plain black leather socks. He wore them, then performed wudūʾ and wiped over them.
He said: This hadith is hasan. We know it only from the narration of Dalham, and Muḥammad ibn Rabīʿah has also narrated it from Dalham.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The scribe of al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah reported from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped over the top of the leather sock and its bottom.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We went out as a delegation until we came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We pledged allegiance to him and prayed with him. When he had finished the prayer, a man who seemed to be a Bedouin came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what do you say about a man who touches his private part during prayer?" He said:
"Is it anything but a morsel of flesh from you, or a piece of flesh from you?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: I entered upon ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, along with two men, one of us and one from Banū Asad, I think. ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, sent the two of them on a mission and said, "You are both strong men, so strive on behalf of your religion."

Then he got up and went into the toilet, then came out and called for water. He took a handful of it and wiped himself with it, then began reciting the Qurʾān. They disapproved of that, so he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would come out of the toilet and recite the Qurʾān to us and eat meat with us, and nothing would keep him from the Qurʾān, or he said, hold him back from it, except janābah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was a servant of the Prophet ﷺ. Al-Ḥasan or al-Ḥusayn was brought, and he urinated on his chest. They wanted to wash it, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Sprinkle it, for the urine of a girl is washed and the urine of a boy is sprinkled."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and Mūsā said in his narration, as ʿAmr thought, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
"The whole earth is a place of prayer, except the bathhouse and the graveyard."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was present with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the Conquest. He prayed facing the Kaʿbah, took off his sandals and placed them on his left. He began with Sūrat al-Muʾminūn, and when the mention of Mūsā or ʿĪsā, peace be upon them both, came, a cough overtook him, so he bowed.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked Sulaymān al-Aʿmash about Jābir ibn Samurah
regarding the front rows, and he narrated to us from al-Musayyab ibn Rāfiʿ,
from Tamīm ibn Ṭarafah,
from Jābir ibn Samurah,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Will you not form rows as the angels form rows before their Lord, the Mighty and Majestic?"
We said, "How do the angels form rows before their Lord?" He said:
"They complete the front rows and stand close together in the row."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said, "I will surely watch the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, how he prays." So I watched him. He stood and said the takbīr and raised his hands until they were level with his ears. Then he placed his right hand on the back of his left palm, wrist and forearm. When he wanted to bow, he raised his hands in the same way. He said: and he placed his hands on his knees. Then when he raised his head, he raised his hands in the same way. Then he prostrated and placed his palms level with his ears. Then he sat, spreading out his left foot, and placed his left palm on his left thigh and knee, and set the edge of his right elbow on his right thigh. Then he closed two of his fingers and formed a circle, then raised his finger, and I saw him moving it as he supplicated with it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When Allah created the earth, it began to shake, so He created the mountains and set them upon it, and it became firm. The angels marveled at the strength of the mountains and said, "O Lord, is there anything in Your creation stronger than the mountains?" He said, "Yes, iron."
They said, "O Lord, is there anything in Your creation stronger than iron?" He said, "Yes, fire."
They said, "O Lord, is there anything in Your creation stronger than fire?" He said, "Yes, water."

They said, "O Lord, is there anything in Your creation stronger than water?" He said, "Yes, the wind." They said, "O Lord, is there anything in Your creation stronger than the wind?" He said, "Yes, the son of Adam who gives charity (ṣadaqah) with his right hand, concealing it from his left."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Supplication is the essence of worship."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever does not ask Allah, He becomes angry with him."

He said: Wakīʿ and more than one narrator reported this hadith from Abū al-Malīḥ, and we do not know it except through this route. Abū al-Malīḥ's name is Ṣubayḥ. I heard Muḥammad say this, and he said that he is called al-Fārisī.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked which of the servants is highest in rank with Allah on the Day of Resurrection. He said:
"Those men and women who remember Allah often."
I said, "O Messenger of Allah, and what about the one who fights in the cause of Allah?" He said:
"Even if he struck the disbelievers and polytheists with his sword until it broke and he was stained with blood, those who remember Allah often would still be higher than him in rank."
label: machine translation

segments_en: No people sit in a gathering in which they do not remember Allah and do not send blessings upon their Prophet, except that it will be a source of regret for them. If He wills, He will punish them, and if He wills, He will forgive them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There is no Muslim on the earth who calls upon Allah with a supplication except that Allah gives it to him, or turns away from him an evil equal to it, so long as he does not pray for something sinful or for the severing of family ties."
A man among the people said, "Then we will make a great many supplications." He said, "Allah is more abundant [in giving]."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever is pleased that Allah should answer him in times of hardship and distress, let him make plentiful supplication in times of ease."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned someone and made supplication for him, he would begin with himself.
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, who said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his hands in supplication, he would not lower them until he had wiped his face with them.
Muḥammad ibn al-Muthannā said in his narration: He would not return them until he had wiped his face with them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever says when he goes to his bed: "I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I repent to Him,"

three times, Allah will forgive his sins, even if they are like the foam of the sea, even if they are as many as the leaves of the trees, even if they are as many as the grains of sand of ʿĀlij, and even if they are as many as the days of the world."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, who said: Fāṭimah came to the Prophet ﷺ complaining of blisters on her hands, so he instructed her to say tasbīḥ, takbīr and taḥmīd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmayr ibn Hāniʾ used to perform a thousand prostrations every day and glorify Allah a hundred thousand times.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I used to spend the night at the door of the Prophet ﷺ, and I would bring him his water for ablution. I would hear him for a good part of the night saying:
"Allah hears whoever praises Him."
And I would hear him for a good part of the night saying:
"Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Sūrah Ṣād while on the pulpit. When he reached the verse of prostration, he came down and prostrated, and the people prostrated with him. On another day he recited it, and when he reached the verse of prostration, the people prepared themselves to prostrate. The Prophet ﷺ said:
"It is only the repentance of a prophet, but I saw you getting ready to prostrate."
Then he came down and prostrated, and they prostrated.
label: machine translation

segments_en: In the year of the Conquest, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited a verse of prostration and all the people prostrated, among them the rider and the one prostrating on the ground, so that the rider would prostrate on his hand.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite the Qur'an to us, and when he passed a verse of prostration, he would say the takbīr and prostrate, and we would prostrate.
ʿAbd al-Razzāq said: Al-Thawrī was pleased with this hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When we were sent off as the riders' party (Abū Dāwūd said: meaning to Medina), he said: I used to give talks after the dawn prayer and would prostrate. Ibn ʿUmar forbade me, but I did not stop, three times. Then he came back and said: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and with Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān, may Allah be pleased with them, and they would not prostrate until the sun had risen.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Witr is a right. Whoever does not pray Witr is not one of us. The Witr is a right. Whoever does not pray Witr is not one of us. The Witr is a right. Whoever does not pray Witr is not one of us."
label: machine translation

segments_en: His Companions [said] that Ubayy ibn Kaʿb
led them in prayer, meaning in Ramadan, and he used to recite the Qunūt in the second half of Ramadan.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb

gathered the people behind Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, who led them in prayer for twenty nights and did not recite the Qunūt with them except in the remaining half. When the last ten nights came, he stayed behind and prayed in his house, and they would say: Ubayy has run away.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished the Witr with the salām, he would say:
"Glory be to the King, the Most Holy."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abū Bakr: "When do you pray Witr?"
He said: I pray Witr at the beginning of the night. And he said to ʿUmar: "When do you pray Witr?"
He said: At the end of the night.
So he said to Abū Bakr:
"This one took the cautious course." And he said to ʿUmar:
"This one took the course of strength."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Hasten to pray Witr before the morning comes."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Whoever recites the Qur'an and acts upon what is in it, his parents will be clothed on the Day of Resurrection with a crown whose light is better than the light of the sun in the houses of this world, if it were among you. So what do you think of the one who acts upon this?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: No people gather in one of the houses of Allah, the Exalted, reciting the Book of Allah and studying it among themselves, except that tranquility descends upon them, mercy covers them, the angels surround them, and Allah mentions them to those who are with Him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: While I was walking

with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ between al-Juḥfah and al-Abwāʾ, a wind and intense darkness overtook us. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ began seeking refuge with "I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak" and "I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind," and he said:
"O ʿUqbah, seek refuge with these two, for no one seeking refuge has sought refuge with anything like them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Beautify the Qur'an with your voices."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUbaydullāh ibn Abī Yazīd said: Abū Lubābah passed by us and we followed him until he entered his house. We went in to him and found a man of simple house and simple appearance. I heard him say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"He is not one of us who does not chant the Qur'an."
He said: I said to Ibn Abī Mulaykah: O Abū Muḥammad, what if he does not have a good voice? He said: He should beautify it as much as he can.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Wakīʿ and Ibn ʿUyaynah said: It means he is made self-sufficient by it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There is no man who reads the Qur'an and then forgets it, except that he will meet Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Resurrection with a leprous, amputated hand."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Al-Zuhrī said: These modes of recitation concern one and the same matter; they do not differ regarding what is lawful or unlawful.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"O Ubayy, I was made to recite the Qur'an, and I was asked: In one mode or two? The angel who was with me said: Say, in two modes.
I said: In two modes.
Then I was asked: In two modes or three? The angel who was with me said:
Say, in three.
I said: In three.

until it reached seven modes. Then he said: There is none of them but is sufficient and complete. Whether you say 'All-Hearing, All-Knowing,' or 'Almighty, All-Wise,' so long as you do not conclude a verse of punishment with mercy, or a verse of mercy with punishment."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he performed Hajj with Ibn Masʿūd (may Allah be pleased with him), and saw him throw seven pebbles at the greatest Jamrah,
placing the House on his left
and Minā on his right.
Then he said, "This is the standing place of the one upon whom Sūrat al-Baqarah was revealed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: from the pulpit: the sūrah in which al-Baqarah is mentioned,
and the sūrah in which Āl ʿImrān is mentioned,
and the sūrah in which an-Nisāʾ is mentioned.
He said: I mentioned that to Ibrāhīm,
and he said: ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Yazīd told me that he was with Ibn Masʿūd (may Allah be pleased with him) when he threw the Jamrat al-ʿAqabah, and he went down into the middle of the valley,
until, when he was level with the tree, he faced it,
and threw seven pebbles,
saying the takbīr with each pebble.
Then he said, "By the One besides Whom there is no god, from this very place stood the one upon whom Sūrat al-Baqarah was revealed ﷺ."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to ʿĀʾishah (may Allah be pleased with her), the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and I was young at the time: "What do you think of the saying of Allah, the Blessed and Exalted: {Indeed, Aṣ-Ṣafā and Al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah; so whoever performs Hajj to the House or performs ʿUmrah, there is no blame upon him for walking between them}? I do not see any blame on anyone who does not walk between them."
ʿĀʾishah said: "Not at all!
If it were as you say, it would have read: 'there is no blame upon him if he does not walk between them.'
This verse was revealed only about the Anṣār, who used to enter the sacred state for Manāt,
and Manāt was situated opposite Qudayd,
and they felt reluctant to walk between Aṣ-Ṣafā and Al-Marwah.
When Islam came, they asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that,

so Allah the Exalted revealed: {Indeed, Aṣ-Ṣafā and Al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah; so whoever performs Hajj to the House or performs ʿUmrah, there is no blame upon him for walking between them}."
Sufyān and Abū Muʿāwiyah added from Hishām: "Allah does not complete the Hajj or the ʿUmrah of any person who does not walk between Aṣ-Ṣafā and Al-Marwah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Prophet ﷺ returned from Hajj or ʿUmrah — and I only know that he said, from a military expedition — whenever he ascended a hill or high ground he would say the takbīr three times, then say:
"There is no god but Allah,
alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise,
and He has power over all things.
We return, repenting, worshipping, prostrating, praising our Lord.
Allah has fulfilled His promise, and given victory to His servant,
and He alone defeated the confederates."
Ṣāliḥ said: I said to him, "Did ʿAbdullāh not say 'if Allah wills'?" He said, "No."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That a wild donkey was given as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was at al-Abwāʾ or Waddān, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned it to him. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw what was on my face, he said:
"We did not return it to you for any reason except that we are in the sacred state of iḥrām."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAmr said: The first thing I heard from ʿAṭāʾ,
he said: I heard Ibn ʿAbbās (may Allah be pleased with them both) say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had himself cupped while in iḥrām.
Then I heard him say: Ṭāwūs told me from Ibn ʿAbbās. So I said: Perhaps he heard it from both of them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man in iḥrām was thrown by his camel, and it killed him.
He was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: "Wash him and shroud him,
but do not cover his head,
and do not bring perfume near him,
for he will be raised reciting the talbiyah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That a man

bit another man's hand, so he pulled his hand away and the biter's front tooth fell out, or he said his front teeth. He sought redress against him from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him:

"What do you want me to order? Do you want me to order him to leave his hand in your mouth for you to chew it as a stallion chews? If you wish, give him your hand so that he may chew it, then pull it away, if you wish."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came upon a man being supported between his two sons, and said:
"What is the matter with this man?"
It was said: "He vowed to walk to the Kaʿbah." He said:
"Allah has no need of this man's torturing himself."
So he ordered him to ride.
label: machine translation

segments_en: My sister vowed to walk
to the House of Allah,
and she told me to ask the Prophet ﷺ for a ruling for her. So I asked him, and he, peace be upon him, said: "Let her walk and let her ride."
He said: And Abū al-Khayr would never part from ʿUqbah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
asked the Prophet ﷺ, saying, "O Messenger of Allah, are there horses in Paradise?" He said:
"If Allah admits you into Paradise, you will not wish to be carried on a horse of red ruby, flying with you in Paradise wherever you please, except that you will have it."
He said: Another man asked him, saying, "O Messenger of Allah, are there camels in Paradise?" He did not say to him the same as he had said to his companion. He said:
"If Allah admits you into Paradise, you will have in it whatever your soul desires and whatever delights your eyes."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I love horses. Are there horses in Paradise?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"If you are admitted into Paradise, you will be brought a horse of ruby with two wings; you will be mounted upon it, and then it will fly with you wherever you please."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"The people of Paradise will enter Paradise hairless [of body], beardless, with kohl-adorned eyes, thirty or thirty-three years of age."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"The gate of my Ummah through which they will enter Paradise is as wide as the distance a rider on a swift horse travels in three days. Yet they will crowd against it until their shoulders almost give way."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Indeed, in Paradise there is a marketplace in which there is no buying or selling, except for forms of men and women. When a man desires a form, he enters into it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Indeed, the lowest of the people of Paradise in rank is the one who looks upon his gardens, his spouses, his blessings, his servants and his couches across a distance of a thousand years; and the most honored of them with Allah is the one who looks upon His Face morning and evening."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited:
"[Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant, looking at their Lord."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Allah will gather the people on the Day of Resurrection on a single plain. Then the Lord of the worlds will appear to them and say, 'Let every person follow what they used to worship.'

So the one who worshipped the cross will be shown his cross, the one who worshipped images his images, and the one who worshipped fire his fire, and they will follow what they used to worship. The Muslims will remain, and the Lord of the worlds will appear to them and say, 'Will you not follow the people?' They will say, 'We seek refuge in Allah from You, we seek refuge in Allah from You. Allah is our Lord. This is our place until we see our Lord.'

He will command them and make them steadfast. Then He will withdraw, and then appear and say, 'Will you not follow the people?' They will say, 'We seek refuge in Allah from You, we seek refuge in Allah from You. Allah is our Lord, and this is our place until we see our Lord.'
He will command them and make them steadfast."
They said, "And shall we see Him, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on the night of the full moon?"
They said, "No, O Messenger of Allah." He said:
"Then you will have no difficulty in seeing Him at that time. Then He will withdraw, and then appear and make Himself known to them, and then say, 'I am your Lord, so follow Me.'
The Muslims will rise, and the Sirāṭ will be set up, and they will pass over it like the finest horses and riding animals, and their words upon it will be, 'Save, save!'
The people of the Fire will remain, and a group of them will be cast into it. Then it will be asked, 'Are you full?' and it will say, 'Is there more?'
Then another group will be cast into it, and it will be asked, 'Are you full?'
And it will say, 'Is there more?'

Until, when they have all been put into it, the Most Merciful will place His foot in it, and its parts will be drawn together, and He will say, 'Enough!' It will say, 'Enough, enough!' Then when Allah has admitted the people of Paradise into Paradise and the people of the Fire into the Fire, death will be brought, bound, and made to stand on the wall between the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire. Then it will be said, 'O people of Paradise!'
They will look out, fearful. Then it will be said, 'O people of the Fire!'

They will look out, rejoicing, hoping for intercession. Then it will be said to the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire, 'Do you recognize this?' Both will say, 'We recognize it. It is death, which was appointed over us.'

Then it will be laid down and slaughtered on the wall between Paradise and the Fire. Then it will be said, 'O people of Paradise, eternity without death! And O people of the Fire, eternity without death!'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Day of Resurrection comes, death will be brought like a white-grey ram and made to stand between Paradise and the Fire, and it will be slaughtered while they look on. If anyone were to die of joy, the people of Paradise would die; and if anyone were to die of grief, the people of the Fire would die."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With the same chain of transmission from Hammām, except that the hadith of Shuʿbah ends at his words: "
the daughter of my brother by nursing."
And in the hadith of Saʿīd: "
Indeed, what is made unlawful by nursing is what is made unlawful by blood relation."
And in the narration of Bishr ibn ʿUmar: I heard Jābir ibn Zayd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which people are best?" He said: "My generation,
then those who come after them,
then those who come after them,
then there will come a people, the testimony of one of whom will precede his oath, and his oath his testimony."
Ibrāhīm said: Our companions used to forbid us, while we were boys, from swearing by testimony and by covenant.
label: machine translation

segments_en: It is narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that a man was mentioned in his presence, and another man said, "O Messenger of Allah, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ there is no man better than him in such and such." The Prophet ﷺ said: "
Woe to you! You have cut the neck of your companion."
He said that several times. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
If any of you must praise his brother, let him say: 'I consider so-and-so to be so, if he sees that he is so, and I do not vouch for anyone before Allah.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad about a man
who had three dwellings and bequeathed a third of each of them. He said, "All of that is combined into one dwelling." Then he said: ʿĀʾishah informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Whoever does a deed that is not in accordance with our affair, it is rejected."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon Saʿd in Makkah to visit him, and he wept. He said, "What makes you weep?"
He said, "I fear that I will die in the land from which I emigrated, as Saʿd ibn Khawlah died." The Prophet ﷺ said: "
O Allah, heal Saʿd. O Allah, heal Saʿd." Three times.
He said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have much wealth, and only my daughter will inherit from me. Shall I bequeath all my wealth?" He said, "No."
He said, "Then two-thirds?" He said, "No."
He said, "Then half?" He said, "No."
He said, "Then a third?" He said: "

A third, and a third is much. Your charity from your wealth is charity (ṣadaqah), what you spend on your dependants is charity, and what your wife eats from your wealth is charity. And if you leave your family well off—or he said, in comfortable living—that is better than leaving them begging from people." And he gestured with his hand.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah, may Allah be pleased with them, the brother of Banū Sāʿidah, his mother died while he was absent.
He came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, my mother has died while I was absent from her.
Will anything benefit her if I give charity (ṣadaqah) on her behalf?" He said, "Yes."
He said, "Then I make you a witness that my orchard of al-Mikhrāf is charity on her behalf."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Avoid the seven destructive sins."
They said, "O Messenger of Allah,
what are they?" He said: "Associating partners with Allah, sorcery,
killing the soul that Allah has forbidden except by right, consuming usury,
consuming the wealth of the orphan,
turning away on the day of battle,
and slandering chaste, believing, unsuspecting women."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There is no servant who dies and has something good with Allah
who would be pleased to return to the world
even if he were given the world and all that is in it, except the martyr,
because of what he sees of the excellence of martyrdom,
for he would be pleased to return to the world and be killed once again."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ was mentioned, and [Anas] said: He was the best of people, the most generous of people, and the bravest of people. One night the people of Madinah were alarmed and set out toward the sound, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ met them, having already reached the sound before them, on a bareback horse of Abū Ṭalḥah with no saddle, with a sword around his neck, saying: "
O people, do not be afraid."
He was turning them back. Then he said of the horse: "We found it to be like a sea," or "It is indeed a sea."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wording is
from the hadith of ʿUbaydullāh, from Abū Isḥāq al-Hamdānī,
from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib,
from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
"The maternal aunt is in the position of the mother."
There is a long story in the hadith.
And this is an authentic hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed a grave sin. Is there repentance for me?" He said:
"Do you have a mother?" He said, "No." He said:
"Do you have a maternal aunt?" He said, "Yes." He said, "Then be dutiful to her."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū al-Raddād al-Laythī fell ill, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf visited him and said, "The best of them and the one who keeps the ties of kinship most, as far as I know, is Abū Muḥammad."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The righteous woman Khawlah bint Ḥakīm claimed, saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out one day holding one of his daughter's two sons in his arms, and he was saying:
