and said, "Your wives adjure you by Allah to be just regarding the daughter of Ibn Abī Quḥāfah." She raised her voice,
until she went at ʿĀʾishah, who was sitting,
and insulted her, so much so that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept looking at ʿĀʾishah to see whether she would speak. [The narrator] said: ʿĀʾishah spoke, replying to Zaynab, until she silenced her.
She said: The Prophet ﷺ looked at ʿĀʾishah and said: "
She is indeed the daughter of Abū Bakr."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUrwah mentioned that al-Miswar ibn Makhramah,
may Allah be pleased with them both, and Marwān informed him that when the delegation of Hawāzin came to the Prophet ﷺ, he stood among the people,
praised Allah as He deserves, and then said: "To proceed:
Your brothers have come to us repenting,
and I have decided to return their captives to them,
so whoever among you wishes to do that willingly, let him do so,
and whoever wishes to keep his share until we give it to him from the first spoils that Allah grants us, [let him do so]."
The people said, "We willingly agree for your sake."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned several hadith, among them: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Indeed Allah said: When My servant approaches Me by a hand's span, I approach him by an arm's length; when he approaches Me by an arm's length, I approach him by a fathom; and when he approaches Me by a fathom, I come to him faster."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was travelling on the road to Makkah and passed by a mountain called Jumdān. He said:
"Keep going! This is Jumdān. The mufarridūn have gone ahead."
They said: "Who are the mufarridūn, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"Those men and women who remember Allah much."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned several hadith, among them: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"None of you should wish for death or pray for it before it comes to him. For when one of you dies, his deeds come to an end, and a believer's life only increases him in good."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ... that the Prophet ﷺ visited a man among his Companions to see how he was, and he had become like a fledgling.
[This is] similar in meaning to the hadith of Ḥumayd, except that he said:
"You have no strength to bear the punishment of Allah."
And he did not mention: "So he supplicated to Allah for him, and He cured him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "Teach me some words that I may say." He said:

"Say: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. Allah is the Greatest, greatly so. Praise be to Allah, abundantly. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise."
He said: "These are for my Lord. What is there for me?" He said:
"Say: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me."
Mūsā said: As for "and grant me well-being," I am unsure, and I do not know [whether he said it].
Ibn Abī Shaybah did not mention Mūsā's statement in his narration.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times each day."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With this chain of narration.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah will accept his repentance."
label: machine translation

segments_en: They were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as they were climbing a mountain pass. He said: Every time a man reached the top of a pass, he called out, "There is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest." He said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said:
"You are not calling out to one who is deaf or absent." He said:
"O Abū Mūsā" — or "O ʿAbdullāh ibn Qays — shall I not guide you to a phrase that is from a treasure of Paradise?"
I said: "What is it, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"There is no power and no strength except with Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey.
Then he mentioned [a hadith] similar to the hadith of ʿĀṣim.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a military expedition.
Then he mentioned the hadith and said in it:
"And the One you call upon is nearer to any of you than the neck of his riding animal."
And in his narration there is no mention of "There is no power and no strength except with Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ: that he sought refuge [with Allah] from several things which he mentioned, and [from] miserliness.
label: machine translation

segments_en: It was mentioned to him that Abū Ṣāliḥ,
the freed slave of Ghaṭafān, informed him that he
heard Abū Hurayrah
say: A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, a scorpion stung me."
Similar to the hadith of Ibn Wahb.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ... ʿĀzib said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man:
"O so-and-so, when you go to your bed..."
Similar to the hadith of ʿAmr ibn Murrah, except that he said:
"And in Your Prophet whom You sent.
If you die that night, you will die upon the fiṭrah, and if you wake in the morning, you will have gained good."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He commanded a man that when he lay down in his bed he should say:
"O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back; to You belong its death and its life. If You give it life, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being."
A man said to him: "Did you hear this from ʿUmar?" He said: "[Someone] better than ʿUmar: from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
Ibn Nāfiʿ said in his narration, from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥārith:
And he did not mention "I heard."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us, when we lay down in our beds, to say:
Similar to the hadith of Jarīr, and he said:
"From the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With this chain of narration.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When her waiting period had ended, Abū Bakr sent word to her proposing marriage, but she did not marry him. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb to propose to her on his behalf. She said, "Tell the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I am a woman who is very jealous, that I am a woman with young children, and that none of my guardians is present."
So he went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and he said:

"Go back to her and say to her: As for your saying that you are a very jealous woman, I will supplicate to Allah for you, and He will remove your jealousy. As for your saying that you are a woman with young children, your children will be taken care of. And as for your saying that none of your guardians is present, none of your guardians, present or absent, would dislike that."
So she said to her son, "ʿUmar, get up and marry me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," and he married her to him. [Abridged]
label: machine translation

segments_en: Her paternal uncle by breastfeeding, called Aflaḥ, asked permission to enter upon her, but she kept herself veiled from him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was told of this, and he said:
"Do not veil yourself from him, for what is forbidden through breastfeeding is what is forbidden through lineage."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The daughter of Ḥamzah was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said:
"She is my brother's daughter through breastfeeding."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We wrote to Ibrāhīm ibn Yazīd al-Nakhaʿī asking him about breastfeeding,
and he wrote that Shurayḥ
had told us that ʿAlī and Ibn Masʿūd used to say that breastfeeding makes marriage forbidden, whether little or much.
And in his letter was that Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ al-Muḥāribī told us that ʿĀʾishah told him that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ used to say:
"One suckle or two suckles do not make marriage forbidden."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about withdrawal, saying, "My wife is nursing, and I dislike that she become pregnant." The Prophet ﷺ said:
"What has been decreed for the womb will come to be."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shighār.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Ṭalḥah married Umm Sulaym, and the dowry between them was Islam. Umm Sulaym had accepted Islam before Abū Ṭalḥah, and he proposed to her. She said, "I have become Muslim; if you become Muslim, I will marry you."
So he became Muslim, and that was the dowry between them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Ṭalḥah proposed to Umm Sulaym. She said, "By Allah, someone like you, Abū Ṭalḥah, is not turned away, but you are a disbeliever and I am a Muslim woman, and it is not lawful for me to marry you. If you become Muslim, that will be my dowry, and I ask you for nothing else."

So he became Muslim, and that was her dowry. Thābit said: I have never heard of a woman whose dowry was more honorable than Umm Sulaym's: Islam. Then he consummated the marriage with her, and she bore him a child.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among us, the dowry was ten ūqiyyahs.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
had relations with his wife's slave girl, and the matter was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said:

"If he forced her, she is free, and he must provide from his own property a slave like her for her mistress. If she consented, she belongs to her mistress, and he must provide the like of her from his own property."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I entered upon Qaraẓah ibn Kaʿb and Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī at a wedding, and there were girls singing. I said, "You are two Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and of the people of Badr, and this is done in your presence?"
They said, "Sit if you wish and listen with us, or go if you wish. We have been granted a concession for entertainment at a wedding."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Regarding the saying of the Almighty: {O Prophet, when you divorce women, divorce them for their waiting period}, Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with him, said: before their waiting period.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He divorced his wife while she was menstruating, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made him take her back, until he divorced her while she was pure.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed about a man
who had divorced his wife with three divorces at once. He stood up angry and then said:
"Is the Book of Allah being played with while I am still among you?"
Until a man stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall I not kill him?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I am the daughter of the family of Khālid, and my husband, so-and-so, sent me my divorce. I asked his family for maintenance and lodging, but they refused me."
They said, "O Messenger of Allah, he sent her three divorces."
She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Maintenance and lodging are only for the woman whose husband has the right to take her back."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Some of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ from the Anṣār reported that while they were sitting one night with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a star was shot and it lit up the sky. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them:
"What did you used to say in the Time of Ignorance when something like this was shot?"
They said: "Allah and His Messenger know best. We used to say: A great man was born tonight, and a great man died." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"It is not shot for the death of anyone, nor for his life. Rather, when our Lord, Blessed and Exalted is His Name, decrees a matter, the bearers of the Throne glorify Him, then the inhabitants of the heaven nearest to them glorify Him, until the glorification reaches the inhabitants of this lowest heaven. Then those who are near the bearers of the Throne ask the bearers of the Throne: What did your Lord say? So they inform them of what He said. Then the inhabitants of the heavens ask one another until the news reaches this lowest heaven. The jinn snatch some of what is heard and throw it to their allies, and are struck with it. What they bring just as it was is true, but they add to it and falsify it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Lubābah ibn ʿAbd al-Mundhir al-Anṣārī,

who used to live in Qubāʾ and then moved to Madinah, [reported that] while ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar was sitting with him as he was opening a small door of his, they came upon a snake of the kind that lives in houses. They wanted to kill it, but Abū Lubābah said: "Killing them has been forbidden", meaning the snakes that live in houses, "and [the Prophet ﷺ] commanded the killing of the tailless snake and the one with two stripes." It was said that these are the two that damage eyesight and cause pregnant women to miscarry.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
"In the first strike there are seventy good deeds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"None of you should say: 'My slave.'
For all of you are slaves of Allah. Rather, let him say: 'My young man.'
And the slave should not say: 'My lord,'
but let him say: 'My master.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: There was a short woman among the Children of Israel who used to walk with two tall women. She made herself two wooden stilts and a gold ring, closed and sealed, and filled it with musk, which is the best of perfumes. She passed between the two women and they did not recognize her, so she gestured with her hand like this."
And Shuʿbah shook his hand.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When Ibn ʿUmar used incense, he used raw aloeswood without anything added, and camphor which he would put in with the aloeswood. Then he said: "This is how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to use incense."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I rode behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ one day, and he said:
"Do you have anything of the poetry of Umayyah ibn Abī al-Ṣalt with you?"
I said: "Yes." He said: "Go on."
So I recited a verse to him, and he said: "Go on."
Then I recited another verse to him, and he said: "Go on."
until I had recited a hundred verses to him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I saw in a dream as if my head had been cut off."
He said: The Prophet ﷺ laughed and said:
"When Satan plays with one of you in his sleep, he should not tell people about it."
And in the narration of Abū Bakr:
"When [he] plays with one of you."
and he did not mention Satan.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"One night I saw, as a sleeper sees in a dream, that we were in the house of ʿUqbah ibn Rāfiʿ, and we were brought fresh dates of the Ibn Ṭāb variety. I interpreted it as: elevation for us in this world, and a good outcome in the Hereafter, and that our religion has become good."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Indeed Allah chose Ismāʿīl from the children of Ibrāhīm, and chose Banū Kinānah from the children of Ismāʿīl, and chose Quraysh from Banū Kinānah, and chose Banū Hāshim from Quraysh, and chose me from Banū Hāshim."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Indeed in Makkah there is a stone that used to greet me with salām during the nights when I was sent [as a Prophet]. I recognize it even now."
He said: This is a ḥasan gharīb hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the vessels of the Basin like?" He said:

"By the One in whose Hand is the soul of Muḥammad, its vessels are more numerous than the stars and planets of the sky, on a dark, clear night. They are the vessels of Paradise. Whoever drinks from it will never be thirsty afterward. Two spouts from Paradise pour into it. Whoever drinks from it will never be thirsty. Its width is like its length, [as far] as between ʿAmmān and Aylah. Its water is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar found a silk brocade garment being sold in the market, so he brought it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah,
buy this garment and adorn yourself with it for the festival and for receiving delegations."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said,
"This is only the clothing of one who has no share [in the Hereafter],
or: "Only one who has no share [in the Hereafter] wears this."
Then he waited as long as Allah willed, and the Prophet ﷺ sent him a silk brocade cloak.
ʿUmar came with it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, you said,
'This is only the clothing of one who has no share [in the Hereafter],' or 'Only one who has no share wears this,'
and then you sent this to me?" He said, "Sell it,
or use it to meet some of your needs."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ addressed us on the Day of Sacrifice and said,
"The first thing we begin with on this day of ours is to pray, then return and sacrifice.
Whoever does that has acted in accordance with our Sunnah.
But whoever slaughters before praying, it is only meat he has hastened to provide for his family,
and it is not part of the rite of sacrifice in any way."
Then my maternal uncle, Abū Burdah ibn Niyār, stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah,
I slaughtered before I prayed, but I have a young goat that is better than a full-grown one." He said,
"Make it [the sacrifice] in its place," or he said, "Slaughter it. But a young goat will not suffice for anyone after you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Bakr entered upon me while two girls from the girls of the Anṣār were with me, singing what the Anṣār had recited to one another on the day of Buʿāth. She said: they were not [professional] singers.
Abū Bakr said, "Musical instruments of Satan in the house of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" And that was on a day of Eid.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said,
"O Abū Bakr, every people has a festival, and this is our festival."
label: machine translation

segments_en: And ʿAmr al-Nāqid,
and Zuhayr ibn Ḥarb,
both from Ibn ʿUlayyah,
and the wording is ʿAmr's. He said: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Muḥammad, from Anas,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the Day of Sacrifice,
"Whoever slaughtered before the prayer should repeat it."
Then a man stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, this is a day on which meat is desired."

And he mentioned some need of his neighbors, and it seemed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted his word. He said, "I have a young goat that I like more than two sheep for meat; may I slaughter it?" He [Anas] said: So he allowed him. He said: I do not know whether that permission extended to anyone else or not. He said: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to two rams and slaughtered them, and the people went to a small flock and divided it among themselves.
Or he said: and they portioned it out.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ addressed us on the Day of Aḍḥā after the prayer and said,
"Whoever prays our prayer and sacrifices as we sacrifice has performed the sacrifice correctly.
Whoever sacrificed before the prayer, that is before the prayer,
and he has no sacrifice."
Abū Burdah ibn Niyār, the maternal uncle of al-Barāʾ, said, "O Messenger of Allah,
I sacrificed my sheep before the prayer,
and I knew that today is a day of eating and drinking,
and I wanted my sheep to be the first thing slaughtered in my house,
so I slaughtered my sheep and ate lunch before coming to the prayer." He said,
"Your sheep is [merely] a sheep for meat."
He said, "O Messenger of Allah,
we have a young female goat, a jadhaʿah, that I like more than two sheep.
Will it suffice for me?" He said, "Yes,
but it will not suffice for anyone after you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ went out on a day of Eid and prayed two rakʿahs, without praying before or after them,
then he went toward the women, with Bilāl accompanying him,
and he admonished them and commanded them to give charity,
and the women began to throw their bracelets and earrings.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I recited to Mālik, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Thaqafī,

that he asked Anas ibn Mālik, as they were going in the morning from Minā to ʿArafah, "How did you act on this day with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "One of us would recite the talbiyah and it would not be objected to, and one of us would say the takbīr and it would not be objected to."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were commanded to go out on the day of Eid,
even to bring out the virgin girl from her private chamber,
and to bring out the menstruating women, so that they would be behind the people, saying the takbīr along with their takbīr,
and making supplication along with their supplication, hoping for the blessing of that day and its purification.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb

was asked about this verse: "And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam, from their loins, their descendants and made them testify concerning themselves, [saying], 'Am I not your Lord?' They said, 'Yes, we have testified.' [This] lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, 'Indeed, we were unaware of this.'" ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Allah created Adam, then wiped his back with His right hand and brought forth from it offspring, and said: 'I created these for Paradise, and they will do the deeds of the people of Paradise.' Then He wiped his back and brought forth from it offspring, and said: 'I created these for the Fire, and they will do the deeds of the people of the Fire.'"
A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, then what is the point of doing deeds?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"When Allah creates a servant for Paradise, He employs him in the deeds of the people of Paradise until he dies doing one of the deeds of the people of Paradise, and Allah then admits him into Paradise. And when He creates a servant for the Fire, He employs him in the deeds of the people of the Fire until he dies doing one of the deeds of the people of the Fire, and Allah then admits him into the Fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, will each of us see his Lord?" Ibn Muʿādh said: "[Alone] with Him on the Day of Resurrection? And what is the sign of that in His creation?" He said:
"O Abū Razīn, does not each of you see the moon?"
Ibn Muʿādh said:
"On the night of the full moon, [each] alone with it?"
Then they agreed [on the rest]. I said: "Yes." He said: "Then Allah is greater."
Ibn Muʿādh said: He said:
"For it is only one of the creations of Allah, and Allah is more majestic and greater."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There was no prophet after Nūḥ except that he warned his people about the Dajjāl, and I warn you about him."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ described him to us and said:
"Perhaps some of those who saw me or heard my words will reach him."
They said: "O Messenger of Allah, how will our hearts be on that day?" He said:
"Like they are today, or better."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We used to sit with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque, and when he stood up, we would stand. One day he stood up and we stood with him, until, when he reached the middle of the mosque, a man caught up with him and pulled him by his cloak from behind—and his cloak was coarse—so that it reddened his neck. He said: "O Muḥammad, load these two camels of mine for me, for you are not loading from your own wealth or from the wealth of your father."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"No, and I seek Allah's forgiveness. I will not load anything for you until you allow retaliation against you for what you did by pulling my neck."
The Bedouin said: "No, by Allah, I will not allow retaliation against myself."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that three times, and each time he said: "No, by Allah, I will not allow retaliation against myself."
When we heard the Bedouin's words, we hurried toward him, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to us and said:
"I insist that whoever hears my words not leave his place until he is permitted."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man among the people:
"O so-and-so, load one camel for him with barley and one camel with dates."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Go on your way."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said:
"Good conduct, good demeanor, and moderation are one part of twenty-five parts of prophethood."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Both of them traced it back to the Prophet, saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The believer is trusting and generous, while the wicked person is deceitful and ignoble."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah."
He said: This hadith is ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever is given a gift and has the means, let him repay it; and whoever does not have the means, let him praise [the giver], for whoever praises has indeed thanked, and whoever conceals [it] has been ungrateful. And whoever adorns himself with what he has not been given is like one who wears two garments of falsehood."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When we came to the Prophet ﷺ, each of us would sit where the gathering ended.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
sat in the middle of a circle, so Ḥudhayfah said: "Cursed on the tongue of Muḥammad," or: "Allah has cursed, on the tongue of Muḥammad ﷺ, whoever sits in the middle of the circle."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"A man is upon the religion of his close friend, so let each of you look at whom he takes as a close friend."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Every sermon that has no tashahhud in it is like a hand that is cut off."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It is not permissible for a man to separate two people [sitting together] except with their permission."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up at night [for prayer], he would say the takbīr, then say: "
Glory and praise be to You, O Allah; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You." Then he would say: "
There is no god but Allah,"
three times. Then he would say: "
Allah is the Greatest, greatly so," three times. [Then he would say:] "
I seek refuge with Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan, from his prompting, his blowing, and his spitting." Then he would recite.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAlī ibn Shaybān, who was one of the delegation, said: We set out until we came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We pledged allegiance to him and prayed behind him. Out of the corner of his eye he noticed a man who was not keeping his back straight, meaning in bowing and prostration. When the Prophet ﷺ finished the prayer, he said: "
O assembly of Muslims, there is no prayer for one who does not keep his back straight in bowing and prostration."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū az-Zubayr said: Jābir said: The Prophet ﷺ moved on from ʿArafah during the Farewell Hajj with calmness upon him, and he commanded the people to be calm. He commanded them to throw pebbles the size of those used for flicking, and he hastened through the valley of Muḥassir. And he said: "
Let my community take its rites [of Hajj] from me, for I do not know; perhaps I will not meet them after this year of mine."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him. Ismāʿīl said: I think he traced it back to the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: "
Allah has cursed the one who marries a divorced woman to make her lawful [for her former husband], and the one for whom it is done."
label: machine translation

segments_en: And he mentioned
another, that ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Bakr ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥazm
narrated to them both from Ibn Shihāb,
from Sālim ibn ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Ḥafṣah,
from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "
Whoever does not resolve to fast before dawn, let him not fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It goes back to Makḥūl, to Mālik ibn Yakhāmir, that Muʿādh ibn Jabal narrated to them that he
heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "
Whoever fights in the cause of Allah for the time it takes to milk a she-camel, Paradise becomes obligatory for him.
And whoever sincerely asks Allah for death [in His cause] from himself, then dies or is killed, he will have the reward of a martyr."
Ibn al-Muṣaffā added from here: "
And whoever is wounded with a wound in the cause of Allah, or suffers an injury, it will come on the Day of Resurrection as abundant as it ever was,
its color the color of saffron,
and its scent the scent of musk.
And whoever develops a boil in the cause of Allah, upon him is the seal of the martyrs."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the ʿaqīqah, and he said: "
Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, does not like disobedience (ʿuqūq)."
It was as if he disliked the name. They said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: We only ask about when one of us has a child born to him. He said: "
Whoever wishes to offer a sacrifice for his child, let him do so: for a boy two equivalent sheep, and for a girl one sheep."
Dāwūd said: I asked Zayd ibn Aslam about "mukāfiʾatān," and he said: Two similar sheep, slaughtered together.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And his brother al-Mughīrah,
both from Ziyād ibn Jubayr,
from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
The rider goes behind the funeral procession, the one on foot may go wherever he wishes near it, and the funeral prayer is to be performed for a child."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over a funeral, he would say: "

O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whomever among us You keep alive, keep him alive upon Islam, and whomever among us You cause to die, cause him to die upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not lead us astray after him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, may Allah be pleased with him, passed by ʿUthmān, with similar meaning.
He said: Do you not remember that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
The pen is lifted from three: from the insane person whose mind is overcome until he recovers, from the sleeper until he wakes, and from the child until he reaches puberty?"
He said: You have spoken truly. He said: So he let her go free.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He said to me: I see that you love sheep and keep them,
so take good care of them and clean up their pens,
for I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "
A time will come upon the people when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep,
which he follows to the peaks of the mountains or the mountain valleys, where the rain falls,
fleeing with his religion from trials."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Bedouin
came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "I live in a rough land full of dabb lizards, and they are the main food of my family." He said: He did not answer him, so we said, "Ask him again."
So he asked him again, but he did not answer him, three times. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called to him the third time and said:

"O Bedouin, Allah cursed, or was angry with, a tribe of the Children of Israel, and He transformed them into creatures crawling on the earth. I do not know, perhaps this is one of them. So I do not eat them, and I do not forbid them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With the chain of the hadith of Ibn ʿUlayyah and with the meaning of his hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us on the Day of Sacrifice and said:
"None of you should offer the sacrifice until he has prayed."
A man said, "I have a young female goat that is better than two sheep for meat." He said:
"Sacrifice it, but a jadhaʿah will not suffice for anyone after you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ led us in prayer on the Day of Sacrifice in Madinah. Some men went ahead and slaughtered, thinking that the Prophet ﷺ had already slaughtered. So the Prophet ﷺ commanded whoever had slaughtered before him to repeat the sacrifice with another animal, and not to slaughter until the Prophet ﷺ had slaughtered.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Allah; that ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir al-Juhanī,
informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed sacrificial animals among his Companions, with similar meaning.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two horned rams, black and white in color. He said: I saw him slaughter them with his own hand, and I saw him placing his foot on their sides. He said: and he said the name of Allah and declared His greatness.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we will meet the enemy tomorrow and we have no knives; may we slaughter with bamboo splinters?" And he mentioned the hadith with its story, and said: One of the camels among them ran away from us, so we shot it with arrows until we brought it down.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We used not to keep the meat of the sacrificial animals for more than three days, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to take provisions from it and eat from it.
He means: beyond three days.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"O people of Madinah, do not eat the meat of the sacrificial animals beyond three days."
And Ibn al-Muthannā said: three days.
They complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that they had dependants, retinue and servants, so he said:
"Eat, feed others, and keep, or store."
Ibn al-Muthannā said: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā was unsure [of the wording].
label: machine translation

segments_en: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I had forbidden you."
Then he mentioned it with the meaning of the hadith of Abū Sinān.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were in the bathhouse shortly before al-Aḍḥā, and some people applied depilatory paste there. One of the people of the bathhouse said, "Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab dislikes this, or forbids it." So I met Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab and mentioned that to him. He said, "O son of my brother, this is a hadith that has been forgotten and abandoned. Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, narrated to me, saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said..." with the meaning of the hadith of Muʿādh from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mixing dates with half-ripe dates and then drinking it, and that was the main part of their intoxicants on the day intoxicants were prohibited.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Allah revealed the verse in which He prohibited intoxicants, and in Madinah there was no drink consumed except that made from dates.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Wāʾil al-Ḥaḍramī,
that Ṭāriq ibn Suwayd al-Juʿfī
asked the Prophet ﷺ about wine; he forbade it, or disliked that he make it. He said, "I only make it as medicine." He said:
"It is not a medicine, but rather a disease."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With these two chains, except that he said:
"Fresh dates, half-ripe dates, dried dates and raisins."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, with the like of this hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ that he forbade the muzaffat, the ḥantam and the naqīr.
He said: Abū Hurayrah was asked, "What is the ḥantam?" He said, "The green jars."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to Ibn ʿUmar, "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbid nabīdh in jars?" He said, "They claim that."
I said, "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbid it?" He said, "They claim that."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade [nabīdh in] jars, gourds and pitch-coated vessels, and said:
"Make nabīdh in waterskins."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to Ibn ʿUmar, "Tell me what
the Prophet ﷺ forbade of drinks, in your own language, and explain it to me in our language, for you have a language other than ours."

He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the ḥantam, which is the jar; the dubbāʾ, which is the gourd; the muzaffat, which is the pitch-coated vessel; and the naqīr, which is a palm trunk that is scraped out and hollowed out. And he commanded that nabīdh be made in waterskins."
label: machine translation

segments_en: With this chain.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
"A person in iḥrām may kill the snake, the scorpion, the attacking predator, the biting dog, and the mouse, the little wrongdoer."
He was asked, "Why is it called the little wrongdoer?" He replied, "Because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ woke up to find that it had taken a wick to burn the house down with it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ was brought the meat of game while he was in iḥrām, and he did not eat it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ gave him a wild donkey and commanded him to distribute it among the companions on the journey, while they were in iḥrām.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ gave as a gift among his sacrificial camels a camel that had belonged to Abū Jahl, with a silver nose-ring.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, as did Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, and the dwellings of Makkah were considered nothing but free, ownerless property: whoever needed [a place] lived in it, and whoever no longer needed it let another live in it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"This nation will continue to be in goodness as long as they honor this sanctity as it deserves to be honored. But when they neglect that, they will be destroyed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever among you is able to die in Madīnah, let him do so, for I will bear witness for whoever dies there."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever reaches Ramaḍān in Makkah, fasts, and stands in prayer during it as much as is easy for him, Allah will record for him [the reward of] a hundred thousand Ramaḍāns elsewhere.

And Allah will record for him for every day the freeing of a slave, and for every night the freeing of a slave, and for every day the provision of a horse for the cause of Allah, and a good deed for every day and a good deed for every night."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We performed ṭawāf with Abū ʿIqāl in the rain. When we finished our ṭawāf, we came behind the Maqām, and he said: I performed ṭawāf with Anas ibn Mālik in the rain, and when we finished the ṭawāf we came to the Maqām and prayed two rakʿahs. Then Anas said to us:
"Start your deeds anew, for you have been forgiven."
This is what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us, and we performed ṭawāf with him in the rain.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ and his Companions performed Hajj on foot from Madīnah to Makkah, and he said:
"Tie your waists with your waist-wrappers."
And he walked with a pace mixed with a hurried trot.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wished to offer a sacrifice, he would buy two large, fat, horned rams, white with some black, and castrated. He would slaughter one of them on behalf of his nation, for those who testified to Allah's oneness and testified that he had conveyed the message, and he would slaughter the other on behalf of Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever has the means and does not offer a sacrifice, let him not approach our place of prayer."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Messenger of Allah, what are these sacrificial animals?" He said:
"The way of your father Ibrāhīm."
They said, "What do we get from them, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"A good deed for every hair."
They said, "And the wool, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"A good deed for every strand of wool."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We went out with Abū Saʿīd al-Zurqī, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, to buy sacrificial animals.
Yūnus said: Abū Saʿīd pointed to a dark ram, neither tall nor low in its body, and said to me, "Buy this one for me."
It was as if he likened it to the ram of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: [There were] camels in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he commanded them to slaughter cattle.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī said, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I owe a camel [for sacrifice], and I am well-off, but I cannot find one to buy."
So the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to buy seven sheep and slaughter them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"A young sheep (jadhaʿ) is acceptable as a sacrifice."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We bought a ram to sacrifice, and a wolf damaged part of its tail or its ear. We asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he commanded us to sacrifice it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: My family drove me to harshness after I had known the Sunnah: the people of a household used to sacrifice one sheep or two sheep, and now our neighbors make us seem stingy.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
slaughtered on the day of sacrifice before the prayer, so the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to repeat it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I went out one night, and behold, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was walking alone, with no one with him. I thought that he disliked anyone walking with him. So I began to walk in the shade of the moon. He turned and saw me, and said, "Who is this?"
I said, "Abū Dharr; may Allah make me your ransom." He said,
"O Abū Dharr, come."
So I walked with him for a while, and he said,

"Indeed, those who have much are those who have little on the Day of Resurrection, except the one to whom Allah has given wealth and who gives it away to his right and his left, in front of him and behind him, and does good with it."
Then I walked with him for a while, and he said,
"Sit here."
He said: So he sat me down in a low, flat place surrounded by stones, and said to me,
"Sit here until I return to you."
He said: Then he went off into the lava field until I could no longer see him. He stayed away from me for a long time. Then I heard him as he was coming back, saying,
"Even if he steals and even if he commits adultery."

He said: When he came, I could not restrain myself, so I said, "O Prophet of Allah, may Allah make me your ransom, who were you speaking to at the edge of the lava field? I did not hear anyone replying to you." He said,
"That was Jibrīl, who appeared to me at the edge of the lava field and said: Give glad tidings to your Ummah that whoever dies without associating anything with Allah will enter Paradise.
I said: O Jibrīl, even if he steals and even if he commits adultery? He said: Yes.
I said: Even if he steals and even if he commits adultery? He said: Yes.
I said: Even if he steals and even if he commits adultery? He said: Yes, even if he drinks wine."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Be right and moderate,
and know that none of you will enter Paradise by his deeds,
and that the most beloved of deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if they are small."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?" He said,
"The most consistent of them, even if small." And he said,
"Take on only those deeds that you are able to do."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said:
"Seventy thousand of my Ummah will enter Paradise without reckoning."
They said, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He said,
"They are those who do not seek cauterization, do not seek ruqyah, and put their trust in their Lord."
Then ʿUkkāshah stood up and said, "Supplicate to Allah that He make me one of them." He said, "You are one of them."
Then another man stood up and said, "O Prophet of Allah, supplicate to Allah that He make me one of them." He said,
"ʿUkkāshah has beaten you to it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever guarantees to me what is between his two jaws and what is between his two legs, I guarantee Paradise for him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Indeed, a servant may speak a word without realizing what it contains, and by it he falls into the Fire farther than the distance between the east and the west."
label: machine translation

segments_en: There was a man among those before you who had a poor opinion of his own deeds. When death approached him, he said to his family: When I die, burn me, then grind me up, then scatter me in the sea, for if Allah gets hold of me, He will not forgive me.
He said: Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, commanded the angels, and they received his soul. He said to him: What made you do what you did? He said: My Lord, I did it only out of fear of You.
So Allah forgave him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Indeed, the example of me and of what Allah has sent me with is like a man who came to a people and said: O my people, I have seen the army with my own eyes,
and I am the naked warner, so flee to safety!
A group of his people obeyed him and set out at night,
and they went at an easy pace and were saved.
But a group of them denied him and stayed where they were in the morning, and the army came upon them at dawn, destroyed them and wiped them out.
That is the example of the one who obeys me
and follows what I have brought,
and the example of the one who disobeys me and denies the truth that I have brought."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When one of you looks at someone who has been favored over him in wealth and physique, let him look at someone who is below him, from among those over whom he has been favored."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, relating from his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, who said:
"Indeed, Allah has written down the good deeds and the bad deeds,
then He made that clear: whoever intends a good deed but does not do it, Allah writes it with Him as one complete good deed;
and if he intends it and does it, Allah writes it with Him as ten good deeds, up to seven hundred times, up to many multiples.
And whoever intends a bad deed but does not do it, Allah writes it with Him as one complete good deed;
and if he intends it and does it, Allah writes it as one bad deed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said to a man: "
Would you be pleased if I married you to so-and-so?" He said, "Yes." And he said to the woman: "
Would you be pleased if I married you to so-and-so?" She said, "Yes."

So he married one to the other, and the man consummated the marriage with her without having set a dowry for her or given her anything. He was one of those who had been present at al-Ḥudaybiyyah, and whoever was present at al-Ḥudaybiyyah had a share in Khaybar. When death approached him, he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married me to so-and-so, and I did not set a dowry for her or give her anything. I call you to witness that I have given her, as her dowry, my share in Khaybar." So she took the share and sold it for one hundred thousand.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man from Banū Sulaym said: I proposed to the Prophet ﷺ for Umāmah bint ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, and he married me to her without reciting the tashahhud.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took Ṣafiyyah, he stayed with her for three days.
ʿUthmān added: She was previously married.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to bring a woman in to her husband before he had given her anything.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man from the Anṣār—Ibn Abī al-Sarī said: from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, and he did not say "from the Anṣār"; then they agreed—called Baṣrah, said: I married a virgin woman in her seclusion, and when I went in to her, she was pregnant. The Prophet ﷺ said: "
She is entitled to the dowry for what you made lawful of her private part, and the child is a slave belonging to you. When she gives birth"—al-Ḥasan said: "then flog her."
And Ibn Abī al-Sarī said: "Then flog her"—or he said: "Then apply the prescribed punishment to her."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
called Baṣrah ibn Aktham married a woman—then he mentioned the same meaning.
He added: And he separated them.
And the narration of Ibn Jurayj is more complete.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿĀʾishah said: O son of my sister, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not favor some of us over others in the division of his time with us. Rarely was there a day when he did not go around to all of us, drawing near to each wife without touching, until he reached the one whose day it was, and he would spend the night with her. And when Sawdah bint Zamʿah grew old and feared that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would divorce her, she said: "O Messenger of Allah, my day is for ʿĀʾishah."

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted that from her. She said: We used to say that concerning this, and similar cases, Allah the Exalted revealed—I think she said—: {And if a woman fears from her husband ill-treatment or desertion}.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for his wives—she means during his illness—and they gathered. He said: "
I am not able to go around among you. If you see fit to permit me to stay at ʿĀʾishah's, do so." So they permitted him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I went to al-Ḥīrah and saw them prostrating to their marzubān (governor). I said: The Messenger of Allah is more deserving that prostration be made to him. He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: I went to al-Ḥīrah and saw them prostrating to their marzubān, so you, O Messenger of Allah, are more deserving that we prostrate to you. He said: "
Tell me, if you passed by my grave, would you prostrate to it?"
He said: I said, "No." He said: "
Then do not do so. If I were to command anyone to prostrate to another, I would command women to prostrate to their husbands, because of the right Allah has given the husbands over them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the right of the wife of one of us over him? He said: "
That you feed her when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself—or earn—and do not strike the face, do not revile her, and do not forsake her except within the house."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said: O Messenger of Allah, regarding our women, what may we approach of them and what should we leave? He said: "
Come to your tilth however you wish, feed her when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, and do not revile the face and do not strike."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Muʿāwiyah al-Qushayrī said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: What do you say about our women? He said: "
Feed them from what you eat, clothe them from what you wear, and do not strike them and do not revile them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
If you fear their ill-conduct, then forsake them in the beds."
Ḥammād said: That is, in marital relations.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
Every son of Adam has his share of zinā."
In this account he said: "
The two hands commit zinā, and their zinā is grasping; the two feet commit zinā, and their zinā is walking; and the mouth commits zinā, and its zinā is kissing."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ in this account, he said: "
And the ear's zinā is listening."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Concerning the captive women of Awṭās: "
A pregnant woman is not to be had relations with until she gives birth, nor a woman who is not pregnant until she has had one menstrual period."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ with some dates and said, "O Messenger of Allah, supplicate to Allah to bless them."
He gathered them together, then supplicated for blessing in them for me, and said to me:
"Take them and put them in this bag of yours, or in this bag. Whenever you want to take something from it, put your hand in and take it out, and do not scatter it about."
I carried so many wasqs of those dates in the cause of Allah. We used to eat from them and feed others, and the bag never left my waist until the day ʿUthmān was killed, when it was lost.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to Abū Hurayrah, "Why were you given the epithet Abū Hurayrah?" He said, "Are you not afraid of me?" I said, "Yes, by Allah, I do hold you in awe."
He said, "I used to tend my family's sheep, and I had a small kitten. At night I would put it in a tree, and in the daytime I would take it with me and play with it. So they called me Abū Hurayrah."
This ḥadīth is ḥasan gharīb.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And he was
one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, [who reported] from the Prophet ﷺ that he said to Muʿāwiyah:
"O Allah, make him a guide, rightly guided, and guide others through him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb removed ʿUmayr ibn Saʿīd from Ḥimṣ,
he appointed Muʿāwiyah. The people said, "He removed ʿUmayr and appointed Muʿāwiyah."
ʿUmayr said, "Mention Muʿāwiyah only with good, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
'O Allah, guide others through him.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The people have accepted Islam, and ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ has believed."
This ḥadīth is gharīb. We do not know it except from the narration of Ibn Lahīʿah from Mishraḥ ibn Hāʿān, and its chain is not strong.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Ṭalḥah ibn ʿUbaydullāh said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"Indeed ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ is among the righteous of Quraysh."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We stopped at a halting place with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the people began to pass by. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say:
"Who is this, Abū Hurayrah?" I would say, "So-and-so." He would say:
"What an excellent servant of Allah this is." And he would say, "Who is this?" I would say, "So-and-so." He would say:
"What an evil servant of Allah this is."
Then Khālid ibn al-Walīd passed by, and he said, "Who is this?"
I said, "This is Khālid ibn al-Walīd." He said:
"What an excellent servant of Allah Khālid ibn al-Walīd is, a sword among the swords of Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the funeral bier of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh was carried, the hypocrites said, "How light his bier is!"
That was because of his judgment concerning Banū Qurayẓah. This reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said:
"Indeed the angels were carrying him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked forgiveness for me twenty-five times on the night of the camel.
This ḥadīth is ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ gharīb.

The meaning of his saying "the night of the camel" is what has been narrated from Jābir through more than one route: that he was with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey and sold his camel to the Prophet ﷺ, stipulating that he could ride it to Madinah. Jābir says: On the night I sold the camel to the Prophet ﷺ, he asked forgiveness for me twenty-five times. Jābir's father, ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām, had been killed on the day of Uḥud and had left daughters, so Jābir used to support them and spend on them, and the Prophet ﷺ would treat Jābir kindly and show him mercy for that reason. It has been narrated in a ḥadīth from Jābir something like this.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"How many a person, disheveled and dusty, wearing two worn-out garments, to whom no one pays attention, would, if he swore an oath by Allah, have it fulfilled by Him. Among them is al-Barāʾ ibn Mālik."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Fire will not touch a Muslim who saw me, or who saw someone who saw me."
Ṭalḥah said: I saw Jābir ibn ʿAbdullāh.
Mūsā said: And I saw Ṭalḥah.
Yaḥyā said: Mūsā said to me, "And you have seen me, and we hope for Allah's mercy."
This ḥadīth is ḥasan gharīb. We do not know it except from the narration of Mūsā ibn Ibrāhīm al-Anṣārī.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī and more than one of the people of ḥadīth narrated this ḥadīth from Mūsā.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Allah, Allah, concerning my Companions! Allah, Allah, concerning my Companions! Do not make them targets after me. Whoever loves them, loves them out of love for me; and whoever hates them, hates them out of hatred for me. Whoever harms them has harmed me, and whoever harms me has harmed Allah, and whoever harms Allah, it is near that He will seize him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Everyone who pledged allegiance under the tree will enter Paradise, except the owner of the red camel."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Three men from among those before you set out until they took shelter for the night in a cave, and they entered it.
Then a boulder rolled down from the mountain and blocked the cave on them. They said, "Nothing will save you from this rock except that you call upon Allah by means of your righteous deeds."
One of them said, "O Allah, I had two elderly parents,
and I would not give the evening milk to my family or my servants before them.
One day I was drawn far away in search of something,
and I did not return to them until they had fallen asleep.
I milked their evening drink for them and found them sleeping, and I disliked to give the evening milk to my family or my servants before them.
So I waited with the bowl in my hand, expecting them to wake, until the dawn broke.
Then they woke up and drank their evening milk.
O Allah, if I did that seeking Your countenance, then relieve us from this rock in which we are trapped."
The rock moved a little, but they could not get out." The Prophet ﷺ said:
"And the other said, 'O Allah, I had a cousin, and she was the most beloved of people to me.
I desired her for myself,
but she refused me, until she suffered one of the years of hardship.
Then she came to me, and I gave her one hundred and twenty dinars on the condition that she leave me alone with her.
I did so, until when I had power over her, she said, "It is not lawful for you to break the seal except by right."
So I felt afraid of sinning by touching her,
and I left her, though she was the most beloved of people to me, and I left the gold that I had given her.
O Allah, if I did that seeking Your countenance, then relieve us from what we are in.' So the rock moved,
but they still could not get out of it.
The Prophet ﷺ said: "And the third said, 'O Allah, I hired some workers and gave them their wages,
except for one man who left what was due to him and went away. I invested his wages until wealth grew abundant from it.
Some time later he came to me and said, 'O servant of Allah, pay me my wages.'
I said to him, 'Everything you see of your wages, the camels, cattle, sheep, and slaves, is yours.'
He said, 'O servant of Allah, do not mock me.'
I said, 'I am not mocking you.'
So he took all of it and drove it away, leaving nothing of it.
O Allah, if I did that seeking Your countenance, then relieve us from what we are in.'
Then the rock moved away, and they went out walking."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Prophet ﷺ, one hundred and thirty of us, and the Prophet ﷺ said:
"Does anyone among you have food?"
There was a man who had a ṣāʿ of food or about that, and it was kneaded into dough. Then a tall polytheist with disheveled hair came driving sheep, and the Prophet ﷺ said:
"Is it a sale, or a gift?" – or he said – "or a donation?"
He said, "No, a sale."
So he bought a sheep from him, and it was prepared, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered that the innards of the belly be roasted.

He said, "By Allah, there was not one of the hundred and thirty except that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut for him a piece from the innards of its belly: if he was present, he gave it to him, and if he was absent, he set it aside for him." He said, "He put out two bowls, and all of us ate from them and were satisfied, and some was left over in the two bowls, so I loaded it onto the camel."
Or as he said.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There are three whose opponent I will be on the Day of Resurrection, and whoever I am opposed to, I will prevail against on the Day of Resurrection: a man who gave a pledge in My name and then betrayed it; a man who sold a free person and consumed his price; and a man who hired a worker, received full work from him, and did not pay him his wages."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ arrived [in Madinah] while they were paying in advance for dates for two and three years, and he said:
"Whoever pays in advance for dates, let him do so for a known measure and a known weight, for a known term."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād and Abū Burdah sent me to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā, may Allah be pleased with them both, and they said, "Ask him whether the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ used to make advance-payment sales for wheat during the time of the Prophet ﷺ." ʿAbd Allāh said, "We used to make advance-payment sales with the Nabaṭ of Syria for wheat, barley, and olive oil,
for a known measure,
for a known term."
I said, "With one who owned the original produce?" He said, "We did not ask them about that."

Then the two sent me to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā, and I asked him. He said, "The Companions of the Prophet ﷺ used to make advance-payment sales during the time of the Prophet ﷺ, and we did not ask them whether they had a crop or not."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I taught some of the People of the Ṣuffah the Book and the Qur'an, and one of them gave me a bow as a gift. I said, "It is not property, and I can shoot with it in the way of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. I will go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and ask him." So I came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, a man whom I used to teach the Book and the Qur'an gave me a bow as a gift. It is not property, and I can shoot with it in the way of Allah." He said:
"If you would like to be encircled with a collar of fire, then accept it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"O people, whoever sells a muḥaffalah [an animal whose milk has been held back in the udder] has the choice for three days. If he returns it, he must return with it twice its milk—or he said, the like of its milk—in wheat."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade breaking the Muslims' currency coin that is in circulation among them, unless there is a valid reason.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man who was selling food, and he asked him, "How are you selling it?"
The man told him, and it was revealed to him, "Put your hand into it." So he put his hand into it, and it was wet. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"He is not one of us who cheats."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever cancels a sale for a Muslim [who regrets it], Allah will overlook his slip on the Day of Resurrection."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever makes a advance-payment sale for something, let him not turn it to something else."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection: a man who withheld from a traveler the surplus water he had; a man who swore an oath about merchandise after the afternoon prayer—meaning falsely; and a man who pledged allegiance to a leader: if he gave him [what he wanted], he was loyal to him, and if he did not give him, he was not loyal to him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man from the Emigrants among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ said: I fought three expeditions with the Prophet ﷺ, and I heard him say:
"Muslims are partners in three things: pasture, water, and fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: If Allah wills, from Samurah ibn Jundub,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The guarantee period for a slave is three days."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd
sold some slaves from the slaves of the governorate to al-Ashʿath ibn Qays, and they disagreed about the price.
Ibn Masʿūd said, "I sold them to you for twenty thousand."
Al-Ashʿath ibn Qays said, "I only bought them from you for ten thousand."
ʿAbd Allāh said, "If you wish, I will tell you a hadith that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." He said, "Tell it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The neighbor of a house has more right to the neighbor's house or land."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Any man who sells merchandise and then finds his very merchandise with a man who has gone bankrupt, and he had not received any of its price, it is his.
But if he had received some of its price, then he is like the other creditors."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have wealth and children, and my father wants to take all my wealth." He said:
"You and your wealth belong to your father. Your children are among the best of what you earn, so eat from the earnings of your children."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever finds the very item of his property with a man, he has more right to it, and the buyer may seek recourse against whoever sold it to him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: [He heard him] giving a sermon, saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Be fair among your children; be fair among your children."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"It is not permissible for a woman to give a gift from her wealth once her husband has taken possession of her marital bond." The wording is Muhammad's.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Do not grant ruqbā and do not grant ʿumrā; whoever grants ruqbā or ʿumrā on something, it belongs to his heirs."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was sitting with Abū ad-Dardāʾ in the mosque of Damascus when a man came to him and said, "O Abū ad-Dardāʾ, I have come to you from Medina, the city of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, for a hadith that has reached me that you narrate from the Prophet ﷺ."
He said, "Did trade bring you?" He said, "No."
He said, "And nothing else brought you?" He said, "No."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There is no man who travels a path seeking knowledge on it, except that Allah makes easy for him by it the path to Paradise. And whoever is slowed by his deeds will not be hastened by his lineage."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me:

"I seek refuge for you with Allah, O Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, from rulers who will come after me. Whoever frequents their doors, believes their lies, and helps them in their injustice is not from me and I am not from him, and he will not come to me at the Pool. And whoever frequents their doors or does not, but does not believe their lies and does not help them in their injustice, he is from me and I am from him, and he will come to me at the Pool. O Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, prayer is a proof, fasting is a strong shield, and charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire.
O Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, no flesh that has grown from unlawful earnings will thrive except that the Fire is more deserving of it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him to Yemen, he commanded him to take from every thirty cattle a tabīʿ or tabīʿah (a one-year-old calf), from every forty a musinnah (a two-year-old), and from every adult male a dinar or its equivalent in maʿāfir cloth.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"When the zakāh collector comes to you, he should not leave you except satisfied."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say in his sermon in the year of the Farewell Hajj:
"A woman should not spend anything from her husband's house except with her husband's permission."
It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, not even food?" He said:
"That is the best of our property."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When the first night of the month of Ramadan comes, the devils and the rebellious jinn are chained, the gates of the Fire are closed and not a single one of them is opened,

and the gates of Paradise are opened and not a single one of them is closed. A caller calls out: 'O seeker of good, come forward! O seeker of evil, hold back!' And Allah has those whom He frees from the Fire, and that happens every night."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do not anticipate the month of Ramadan by fasting a day or two before it, unless it is a man who was accustomed to keeping a certain fast; then let him fast it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do not fast before Ramadan. Fast when you see the crescent and break the fast when you see it. If clouds come between you and it, complete thirty days."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"The fast is on the day you fast, the breaking of the fast is on the day you break the fast, and the Day of Sacrifice is on the day you sacrifice."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Ḥamzah ibn ʿAmr al-Aslamī
asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about fasting while traveling, and he used to fast continuously. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"If you wish, fast, and if you wish, break the fast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever dies owing a month of fasting, then a poor person should be fed on his behalf for every day."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿĀʾishah bint Ṭalḥah, from ʿĀʾishah, the Mother of the Believers,
said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to me one day and said:
"Do you have anything?"
She said: I said, "No." He said, "Then I am fasting."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When it is the middle of Shaʿbān, there is no fasting until Ramadan comes."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I missed the Prophet ﷺ one night, so I went out looking for him, and there he was at al-Baqīʿ, with his head raised to the sky. He said:
"O ʿĀʾishah, were you afraid that Allah and His Messenger would wrong you?"
She said: I said that, though it was not what was in my heart, but I thought that you had gone to one of your wives. He said:
"Indeed Allah, the Exalted, descends on the night of the middle of Shaʿbān to the lowest heaven and forgives more than the number of the hairs of the sheep of Kalb."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said:
"As for fasting the day of ʿArafah, I hope from Allah that it will expiate the year before it and the year after it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ prayed inside the Kaʿbah.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: He did not pray, but he said the takbīr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer at Minā in the Ẓuhr, ʿAṣr, Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ and Fajr prayers, then he set out in the morning to ʿArafāt.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to throw the pebbles when the sun had passed its zenith, for a length of time such that when he finished his throwing, he prayed Ẓuhr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ marked the sacrificial animal on the right side of the hump and wiped the blood from it.
And ʿAlī said in his narration: at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, and he garlanded it with two sandals.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ bought his sacrificial animal from Qudayd.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the refuse dump of a people and urinated standing.
Shuʿbah said: ʿĀṣim said that day, "And this is al-Aʿmash, who narrates it from Abū Wāʾil from Ḥudhayfah, but he did not memorize it."
So I asked Manṣūr about it, and he narrated it to me from Abū Wāʾil from Ḥudhayfah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the refuse dump of a people and urinated standing.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And ʿAmr an-Nāqid,
and Ibn Abī ʿUmar,
—the wording is that of Ibn Abī Shaybah—they said: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us,
from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid,
from Abū Maʿmar,
from ʿAbdullāh,
who said: The Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah, and around the Kaʿbah there were three hundred and sixty idols. He began to poke them with a stick he had in his hand, saying:

"Truth has come, and falsehood has vanished; indeed, falsehood is bound to vanish." "Truth has come, and falsehood neither originates anything nor restores it." Ibn Abī ʿUmar added: on the day of the Conquest.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, which deeds are best?" He said:
"Faith in Allah and striving in His cause."
I said, "Which slaves are best to free?" He said:
"The most precious to their owners and the highest in price."
I said, "And if I cannot do that?" He said:
"Help a craftsman, or do work for someone who cannot do it himself."
I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what if I am too weak to do some of these deeds?" He said:
"Refrain from harming people, for that is a charity from you upon yourself."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I wrote to Nāfiʿ asking him about calling [people] to Islam

before fighting. He wrote back to me: That was only in the early days of Islam. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ raided Banū al-Muṣṭaliq while they were unaware, and their livestock were being watered. He killed their fighters and took their women and children captive, and on that day he took—Yaḥyā said: I think he said—Juwayriyah, or he said, without doubt, the daughter of al-Ḥārith. ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar narrated this ḥadīth to me, and he was in that army.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I read to Mālik, from Nāfiʿ,
from Ibn ʿUmar,
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When a servant is sincere to his master and worships Allah well, he will have his reward twice."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said—and in the narration of Ibn Ḥātim, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said:
"When one of you fights his brother, let him avoid the face, for Allah created Ādam in His image."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I read to Mālik, from Ibn Shihāb,
from Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd
ar-Raḥmān and from Muḥammad ibn an-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr,
both narrating from an-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr,
that he said: His father brought him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "I have given this son of mine a slave that I owned."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Have you given each of your children a gift like this?" He said, "No."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then take it back."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That she
freed a slave girl without asking the permission of the Prophet ﷺ.
When it was her day, the day he would visit her, she said, "Did you know, O Messenger of Allah, that I have freed my slave girl?" He said, "Did you do so?" She said, "Yes." He said:
"If you had given her to your maternal uncles, it would have been greater for your reward."
And Bakr ibn Muḍar said, from ʿAmr, from Bukayr, from Kurayb, that Maymūnah freed [a slave girl].
label: machine translation

segments_en: That a Jewish woman
came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a poisoned sheep, and he ate from it. She was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he asked her about it. She said, "I wanted to kill you." He said:
"Allah would not have given you power over that."
[The narrator] said, or he said, "over me."
They said, "Should we not kill her?" He said, "No."
[Anas] said: I continued to notice [the effect of the poison] on the palate of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The place of a whip in Paradise is better than the world and all that is in it. Recite, if you wish:
'Whoever is drawn away from the Fire and admitted into Paradise has indeed succeeded, and the life of this world is nothing but the enjoyment of delusion.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When the call to prayer is made, Satan turns his back and runs off passing wind so that he does not hear the call.
When the caller falls silent, he comes back.
When the iqāmah is called, he turns his back again, and when it ends, he comes back again,
and he keeps on coming to a person, saying to him: 'Remember such-and-such,' things he had not been remembering, until the man does not know how much he has prayed."
Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: If one of you experiences that, let him perform two prostrations while sitting.
Abū Salamah heard it from Abū Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him).
label: machine translation

segments_en: Bakr ibn Muḍar said, from ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥārith, from Bukayr, that Kurayb,

the freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās, told him that Ibn ʿAbbās, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Azhar and al-Miswar ibn Makhramah sent him to ʿĀʾishah (may Allah be pleased with her) and said: Convey our greetings of peace to her all together,
and ask her about the two rakʿahs after the ʿAṣr prayer,
and say: We have been told that you pray them,
yet it has reached us that the Prophet ﷺ forbade them.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: I used to join ʿUmar in striking people to stop them from praying them.
Kurayb said: So I went in to her
and delivered what they had sent me with.
She said: Ask Umm Salamah. So I informed them,
and they sent me back to Umm Salamah with the same message with which they had sent me to ʿĀʾishah.
Umm Salamah said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ forbid them,
and then he prayed ʿAṣr, and came in to me while I had with me some women of Banū Ḥarām from the Anṣār, and he prayed them.
So I sent the maidservant to him and said: Stand beside him and say, 'Umm Salamah says: O Messenger of Allah, did I not hear you forbidding these two rakʿahs, yet I see you praying them?'
If he gestures with his hand, then step back. The girl did so, and he gestured with his hand, so she stepped back from him.
When he finished, he said:
"O daughter of Abū Umayyah,
you asked about the two rakʿahs after ʿAṣr.
Some people from ʿAbd al-Qays came to me, having accepted Islam, from their people,
and they kept me busy from the two rakʿahs after Ẓuhr; these are those two."
label: machine translation
