So he sent his son to the Prophet ﷺ and said to him: Go to the Prophet ﷺ and say to him: My father conveys greetings of peace to you, and he gave his people a hundred camels on condition that they accept Islam, and they accepted Islam, and he distributed the camels among them, but he has now decided to take them back from them. Is he more entitled to them, or are they? If he says yes or no, then say to him: My father is a very old man and he is the chief of the water, and he asks you to make the chieftainship mine after him.
He came to him and said: My father conveys greetings of peace to you. He said:
"And upon you and upon your father be peace."

He said: My father gave his people a hundred camels on condition that they accept Islam, and they accepted Islam and their Islam was good, then he decided to take them back from them. Is he more entitled to them, or are they? He said:

"If he decides to leave them with them, let him leave them; and if he decides to take them back, he is more entitled to them than they are. If they have embraced Islam, then their Islam is theirs; and if they do not accept Islam, they will be fought for the sake of Islam."
He said: My father is a very old man and he is the chief of the water, and he asks you to make the chieftainship mine after him. He said:
"Chieftainship is a reality, and people must have chiefs; but the chiefs are in the Fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: As-Sijill was a scribe of the Prophet ﷺ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He is the one who takes a tenth from people, meaning the collector of customs duty.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ sent me as a collector of charity, then said:
"Go, Abū Masʿūd, and do not let me find you on the Day of Resurrection coming with a camel from the charity camels on your back, groaning, which you have misappropriated."
He said: Then I will not go. He said:
"Then I will not force you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
The protected area around a well is the length of its drawing rope."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled, regarding a man who owns one, two, or three palm trees among other people's palm trees, and they disagree over their rights in that, that for each of those palm trees the land as far as the reach of its fronds is its protected area.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Whoever sells a house and does not put its price into something similar, no blessing will be granted to him in it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever has land and wishes to sell it, let him first offer it to his neighbor."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
The neighbor has the greater right to what is close to him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
The partner has the greater right to what is close to him, whatever it may be."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Preemption is like the untying of a hobble."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
There is no right of preemption for one partner against another partner if he has preceded him in the purchase, nor for a minor, nor for one who is absent."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
A stray animal belonging to a Muslim is a burning of the Fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The maternal uncle of al-Mundhir ibn Jarīr, from al-Mundhir ibn Jarīr, who said:
I was with my father at al-Bawāzīj when the cattle came back in the evening, and he saw a cow that he did not recognize. He said, "What is this?" They said, "A cow that has joined the cattle."
He said: So he ordered that it be driven away until it was out of sight. Then he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "
None gives shelter to a stray animal except one who is astray."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
On buried treasure, one-fifth is due."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
On buried treasure, one-fifth is due."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sold a mudabbar slave.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
The mudabbar slave is [freed] from the one-third."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Any man whose slave woman bears him a child, she is freed after his death."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Umm Ibrāhīm was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: "Her child has set her free."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We used to sell our concubines and the mothers of our children while the Prophet ﷺ was alive among us, and we saw no harm in that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And ʿUbaydullāh ibn al-Jahm al-Anmāṭī,
both said: Ḍamrah ibn Rabīʿah narrated to us, from Sufyān,
from ʿAbdullāh ibn Dīnār,
from Ibn ʿUmar,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Whoever comes to own a relative within the prohibited degrees of marriage, he is free."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmayr, who was a freed slave of Ibn Masʿūd, [reported] that ʿAbdullāh
said to him: "O ʿUmayr, I am freeing you, a pleasant freeing, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "
Any man who frees a slave and does not specify his property, the property belongs to the slave."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about a child born of fornication, and he said: "
Two sandals in which I strive in jihad are better than freeing a child born of fornication."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "

Whoever denies a verse of the Qurʾān, it becomes lawful to strike his neck. And whoever says, 'There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,' no one has any way against him, unless he commits an offense for which a prescribed punishment is due, and it is then carried out on him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Carry out the prescribed punishments of Allah on those near and far, and do not let the blame of any blamer stop you in the matter of Allah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Ward off the prescribed punishments as long as you find a way to ward them off."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever conceals the faults of his Muslim brother, Allah will conceal his faults on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever exposes the faults of his Muslim brother, Allah will expose his faults until He disgraces him by them in his own house."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I entered with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, together with Khālid ibn al-Walīd, upon Maymūnah. She brought us a vessel of milk, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drank while I was on his right and Khālid on his left. He said to me: "
The drink is yours; but if you wish, you may give preference to Khālid with it."
I said: "I would not give anyone preference over myself for what you leave over."
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Whoever Allah has fed food, let him say: 'O Allah, bless us in it and feed us better than it.'
And whoever Allah has given milk to drink, let him say: 'O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.'"
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Nothing takes the place of food and drink except milk."
He said: This is a ḥasan hadith.
Some of them narrated this hadith from ʿAlī ibn Zayd and said: from ʿUmar ibn Ḥarmalah.
And some of them said: ʿAmr ibn Ḥarmalah, and that is not correct.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
There is no one on earth who says: 'There is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah,'
except that his sins are expiated, even if they were like the foam of the sea."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "

I met Ibrāhīm on the night I was taken on the Night Journey, and he said: 'O Muḥammad, convey my greetings of peace to your Ummah, and inform them that Paradise has pleasant soil and sweet water, and that it is a flat plain, and that its plants are: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever says: 'Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His praise,'
a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said one day to his Companions: "

Say 'Glory be to Allah and with His praise' a hundred times. Whoever says it once, ten are recorded for him; whoever says it ten times, a hundred are recorded for him; whoever says it a hundred times, a thousand are recorded for him; and whoever adds more, Allah will give him more; and whoever seeks forgiveness, Allah will forgive him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He is Saʿīd ibn Yaḥyā al-Wāsiṭī, from al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Ḥumrah,
from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather,
who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "

Whoever glorifies Allah a hundred times in the morning and a hundred times in the evening is like one who performed Hajj a hundred times. Whoever praises Allah a hundred times in the morning and a hundred times in the evening is like one who mounted a hundred horses in the cause of Allah — or he said: who fought a hundred battles. Whoever declares Allah's oneness a hundred times in the morning and a hundred times in the evening is like one who freed a hundred slaves from the descendants of Ismāʿīl. And whoever declares Allah's greatness a hundred times in the morning and a hundred times in the evening, no one will come on that day with more than what he has brought, except one who says the like of what he said or adds to what he said."
label: machine translation

segments_en: One glorification in Ramadan is better than a thousand glorifications in other than it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: "

Whoever says: 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner, one God, the One, the Eternal Refuge, who has taken neither a consort nor a child, and there is none comparable to Him,' ten times, Allah will record for him forty million good deeds."
He said: This is a gharīb hadith; we do not know it except through this route.
And al-Khalīl ibn Murrah is not strong according to the scholars of hadith.
Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl said: He is munkar in hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "

Whoever says after the Fajr prayer, while still sitting with his legs folded and before speaking: 'There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise; He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things,' ten times, ten good deeds are recorded for him, ten evil deeds are erased from him, and he is raised ten degrees; and that day of his will be in protection from everything disliked and in guard against Satan; and no sin will be able to overtake him that day except associating partners with Allah."
He said: This is a ḥasan gharīb ṣaḥīḥ hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Call upon Allah while you are certain of being answered, and know that Allah does not answer the supplication of a heedless, distracted heart."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "

O Allah, grant me well-being in my body, grant me well-being in my sight, and make it the inheritor from me. There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "
Abū Thaʿlabah, eat whatever your bow and your dog bring back to you."
Ibn Ḥarb added: "
[a dog] that is trained, and [whatever is caught] by your hand; eat it, whether it was properly slaughtered or not."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Fāṭimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, sent a message to Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq, may Allah be pleased with him, asking him for her inheritance from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from what Allah had granted him as spoils in Medina and Fadak, and what remained of the fifth of Khaybar.
Abū Bakr said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
We [the prophets] are not inherited from; whatever we leave is charity. The family of Muḥammad only eat from this wealth."

And by Allah, I will not change anything of the charity of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the state it was in during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I will act with it as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ acted. So Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, refused to hand over anything of it to Fāṭimah, peace be upon her.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Two qiblahs are not fitting in one land, and there is no jizyah upon the Muslims."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We asked our Prophet ﷺ about walking with the funeral procession, and he said: "

[It should be] less than a trot. If the deceased was good, you are hastening him to it; and if it is otherwise, then away with the people of the Fire. The funeral is to be followed and does not follow; whoever goes ahead of it is not with it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He claimed that Ibn ʿUmar

prayed over nine funerals together. The men were placed nearest the imam and the women nearest the qiblah, and he arranged them in a single row. The funeral of Umm Kulthūm, daughter of ʿAlī and wife of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, was set down together with that of her son, who was called Zayd. The imam that day was Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ, and among the people were Ibn ʿUmar, Abū Hurayrah, Abū Saʿīd and Abū Qatādah. The boy was placed nearest the imam. A man said: I disapproved of that, so I looked at Ibn ʿAbbās, Abū Hurayrah, Abū Saʿīd and Abū Qatādah and said: What is this? They said: It is the Sunnah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling spoils of war before they are divided, selling date palms [fruit] until they are safe from every affliction, and a man praying without a waist wrapper.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar: May I make a salam (advance-payment) sale on date palms before they bear fruit? He said: No.

I said: Why? He said: A man made an advance sale on an orchard of date palms in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before the palms bore fruit, and the palms yielded nothing that year. The buyer said: It is mine until it bears fruit.
The seller said: I only sold you the palms for this year.
So they brought their dispute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said to the seller: "
Did you take anything from your palms?" He said: No. He said: "
Then by what right do you consider his wealth lawful? Return to him what you took from him. And do not make advance sales on date palms until their fruit is clearly good."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I read to Mālik ibn Anas that it had reached him from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather,
that he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of ʿurbān (a down payment).

Mālik said: That is, as we see it, and Allah knows best, that a man buys a slave or hires an animal and then says: I give you a dinar, on the condition that if I abandon the goods or the hire, what I gave you is yours.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I used to write the expenditures for orphans for a certain man who was their guardian. They tricked him out of a thousand dirhams, and he paid it to them. Later I found twice that amount of their property.
I said: Shall I take back the thousand that they took from you? He said: No. My father narrated to me that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "
Deliver the trust to the one who entrusted you, and do not betray the one who betrayed you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said in a sermon he delivered: "
It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth except with her husband's permission, once he has taken possession of her marital bond."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When Makkah was conquered, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and said: "
Whoever has a relative killed has the better of two options: either blood money is paid, or retaliation is carried out."
Then a man from the people of Yemen, called Abū Shāh, stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, write it down for me. Al-ʿAbbās said: Write for us. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Write it down for Abū Shāh."
This is the wording of the narration of Aḥmad.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUtbah ibn Ghazwān addressed us. He praised Allah and extolled Him, then said: "To proceed: the world has announced its end and is rapidly turning away, and nothing remains of it except a little, like the dregs left in a vessel that its owner sips up. You are moving from it to an abode that has no end, so move there with the best of what you have at hand. For it has been mentioned to us that a stone would be thrown from the edge of Hell and would fall into it for seventy years without reaching its bottom. By Allah, it will be filled! Do you find that astonishing? And it has been mentioned to us that the distance between the two panels of the gates of Paradise is a journey of forty years, and a day will come upon it when it is crowded and packed with people. I have seen myself as the seventh of seven with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; we had no food except the leaves of trees, until our mouths became sore. I found a cloak and tore it in two between myself and Saʿd ibn Mālik; I wrapped half of it around my waist, and Saʿd wrapped the other half. Today there is none of us who has not become governor of one of the cities. I seek refuge in Allah from being great in my own eyes and small in the sight of Allah. There has never been a prophethood except that it passed away, until its final outcome is kingship. You will come to know and experience the rulers after us."
label: machine translation

segments_en: She was Umm ʿUmārah bint Kaʿb: the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution, and water was brought to him in a vessel holding about two-thirds of a mudd.
Shuʿbah said: I remember that he washed his forearms and rubbed them, and wiped his ears, the inside of them, but I do not remember that he wiped the outside of them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to us, and she narrated to us that he said:
"Pour out ablution water for me."

Then she described the ablution of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She said in it: He washed his hands three times, washed his face three times, rinsed his mouth and sniffed water into his nose once, washed his arms three times each, and wiped his head twice, beginning with the back of his head and then the front, and wiped both his ears, the outsides and the insides, and washed his feet three times each.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He mentioned the ablution of the Prophet
ﷺ. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wipe the corners of the eyes. He said, and he said:
"The two ears are part of the head."
Sulaymān ibn Ḥarb said: Abū Umāmah used to say it.
Qutaybah said: Ḥammād said: I do not know whether it is from the words of the Prophet ﷺ or from Abū Umāmah.
He means the account of the two ears.
Qutaybah said, from Sinān Abū Rabīʿah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: And Jarīr, and Ibn
Idrīs, from al-Aʿmash, from Shaqīq,
who said: ʿAbdullāh said: We did not perform ablution because of walking on a place of treading, and we did not hold back hair or clothing [in prayer].
label: machine translation

segments_en: Read to him while I was listening,
from Ibn Wahb, from Yūnus and al-Layth,
from Ibn Shihāb, from Ḥabīb,
the freed slave of ʿUrwah, from Budayyah

(and al-Layth used to say Nudbah), the freed slave woman of Maymūnah, from Maymūnah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have physical contact with one of his wives while she was menstruating, if she was wearing a wrapper reaching to the middle of the thighs or the knees.
In the narration of al-Layth: "wrapped with it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That a woman

used to bleed continuously, and she was married to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to bathe at every prayer and pray. And he informed me that Umm Bakr informed him that ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said about a woman who sees something that causes her doubt after purity:
"It is only a vein," or he said, "veins."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Fāṭimah bint Abī Ḥubaysh came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who has continuous bleeding and I do not become pure. Should I leave the prayer? He said:
"No. That is only a vein and it is not menstruation. Refrain from prayer during the days of your period, then bathe and perform ablution for every prayer, even if the blood drips onto the mat."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about tayammum, and he commanded me to do one strike for the face and the hands.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Supplication is not rejected between the adhān and the iqāmah."
They said: Then what should we say, O Messenger of Allah? He said:
"Ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter."
label: machine translation

segments_en: That Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah
met him as he was heading to the mosque; each of them caught up with the other. He said: He found me with my fingers interlaced, so he forbade me from that and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When one of you performs ablution and does it well, then heads out intending the mosque, let him not interlace his fingers, for he is in prayer."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Badr:
"Whoever does such and such will have such and such as an additional reward."

He said: The young men went forward, while the elders stayed with the standards and did not leave them. When Allah gave them victory, the elders said, "We were a support for you; had you been routed, you would have retreated to us, so do not take the spoils and leave us with nothing." But the young men refused and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made it for us." So Allah revealed: {They ask you about the spoils of war. Say: The spoils belong to Allah...} up to His saying: {Just as your Lord brought you out of your house with the truth, though a party of the believers were averse to it.} He said: That was better for them; so likewise, obey me, for I know better than you the outcome of this matter.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Badr:
"Whoever kills an enemy fighter will have such and such, and whoever captures a prisoner will have such and such."
Then he narrated something similar, and the hadith of Khālid is more complete.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out on the day of Badr with three hundred and fifteen men, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"O Allah, they are barefoot, so provide them with mounts. O Allah, they are unclothed, so clothe them. O Allah, they are hungry, so feed them."
Then Allah granted him victory on the day of Badr, and when they returned, there was not a man among them but he came back with a camel or two camels, and they were clothed and fed.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was a slave in Egypt belonging to a woman of Banū Hudhayl, and she freed me. I did not leave Egypt while any knowledge was there but I had gathered it, as far as I could tell. Then I came to the Hijaz, and I did not leave it while any knowledge was there but I had gathered it, as far as I could tell. Then I came to Iraq, and I did not leave it while any knowledge was there but I had gathered it, as far as I could tell. Then I came to Syria and sifted through it. In all of this I was asking about the additional share of spoils (nafl), but I found no one who could tell me anything about it, until I came to an elder called Ziyād ibn Jāriyah at-Tamīmī. I said to him, "Have you heard anything about the nafl?" He said, "Yes. I heard Ḥabīb ibn Maslamah al-Fihrī say: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ grant a quarter as additional share on the outward journey and a third on the return."
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn ʿUyaynah raided the camels of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, killed their herdsman, and set off driving them away, he and some men with him on horses. I turned my face toward Medina, then called out three times, "Yā ṣabāḥāh!"

Then I followed the people, shooting arrows and hamstringing their mounts. Whenever a horseman turned back toward me, I sat at the base of a tree, until there was nothing Allah had created of the Prophet's ﷺ riding animals but I had put it behind my back, and until they threw down more than thirty spears and thirty cloaks to lighten themselves. Then ʿUyaynah came to them with reinforcements and said, "Let a group of you go up to him."

Four of them came toward me and climbed the mountain. When I could make them hear me, I said, "Do you know me?" They said, "Who are you?" I said, "I am the son of al-Akwaʿ, and by the One who honored the face of Muḥammad ﷺ, none of you can chase me and catch me, and I cannot chase any of you without him failing to escape me."

I did not leave that place until I saw the horsemen of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ moving through the trees, the first of them al-Akhram al-Asadī. He caught up with ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn ʿUyaynah, and ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān turned on him; they exchanged two thrusts. Al-Akhram hamstrung ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān's horse, and ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān stabbed him and killed him. Then ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān switched to al-Akhram's horse. Abū Qatādah caught up with ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān and they exchanged two thrusts; Abū Qatādah's horse was hamstrung, and Abū Qatādah killed him. Then Abū Qatādah took al-Akhram's horse. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who was at the water from which I had driven them away, Dhū Qarad. The Prophet of Allah ﷺ was there with five hundred men, and he gave me the share of both the horseman and the foot soldier.
label: machine translation

segments_en: During the governorship of Muʿāwiyah, I found a red jar in the land of the Romans containing dinars. We were under a man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ of Banū Sulaym called Maʿn ibn Yazīd. I brought it to him, and he distributed it among the Muslims and gave me from it the same as he gave one of them. Then he said, "Had I not heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
'There is no additional share except after the fifth,'
I would have given you more." Then he began offering me some of his own share, but I refused.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with the delegation of Kindah, and they did not regard me as the best of them. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, are you not from us?" He said:
"We are the descendants of an-Naḍr ibn Kinānah; we do not slander our mother, and we do not disown our father."
He said: Al-Ashʿath ibn Qays used to say, "No man will be brought to me who has disowned a man of Quraysh from an-Naḍr ibn Kinānah except that I will flog him with the prescribed punishment."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when ʿAmr ibn Qurrah came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah has decreed wretchedness for me, and I do not see myself being provided for except by what I earn with the palm of my hand. So permit me to sing, without any indecency."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"I do not permit you, and there is no honor and no delight for you. You have lied, O enemy of Allah! Allah has provided you with good, lawful sustenance, yet you chose what Allah has forbidden you of His provision in place of what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made lawful for you.

Had I warned you beforehand, I would have done such and such to you. Get up, leave me, and repent to Allah. But if you do it after this warning, I will beat you painfully, shave your head as a disgrace, banish you from your family, and make your belongings lawful plunder for the young men of Madinah."
So ʿAmr got up, with such evil and disgrace upon him as only Allah knows. When he turned away, the Prophet ﷺ said:

"These are the disobedient. Whoever among them dies without repentance, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will gather him on the Day of Resurrection as he was in the world: effeminate and naked, not covered from the people even by a thread, and every time he stands up he is thrown down."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever meets Allah without associating anything with Him, and has not been stained by forbidden blood, will enter Paradise."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever helps in the killing of a believer, even with half a word, will meet Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with it written between his eyes: 'Despairing of the mercy of Allah.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the blood money is to be paid by the ʿāqilah (the paternal kin).
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"I am the heir of one who has no heir; I pay the blood money for him and inherit from him. And the maternal uncle is the heir of one who has no heir; he pays the blood money for him and inherits from him."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man

struck another man on his forearm with a sword and cut it off, not at the joint. The injured man appealed to the Prophet ﷺ against him, and he ordered the blood money for him. The man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I want retaliation." He said:
"Take the blood money; may Allah bless you in it."
And he did not rule retaliation for him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There is no retaliation for a wound to the head reaching the brain membrane, nor for a wound penetrating the body cavity, nor for a wound that dislodges the bone."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ ruled in favor of Ḥamal ibn Mālik al-Hudhalī al-Liḥyānī regarding his inheritance from his wife, whom his other wife had killed.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The killer does not inherit."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Qatādah,
a man from Banū Mudlij, killed his son, and ʿUmar took from him one hundred camels: thirty ḥiqqah, thirty jadhaʿah, and forty pregnant she-camels.
He said, "Where is the brother of the slain? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
'The killer has no inheritance.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the blood money for a woman is to be paid by her paternal relatives, whoever they may be, and that they do not inherit anything from her except what remains after her heirs; and if she is killed, her blood money is shared among her heirs, and they are the ones who put her killer to death.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ: He ruled that for a tooth the compensation is five camels.
label: machine translation

segments_en: "The fingers are equal."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A believer is not to be killed for a disbeliever, nor one who has a covenant while his covenant holds."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man killed his slave deliberately and intentionally, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ flogged him one hundred lashes, banished him for a year, and struck his share from among the Muslims.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A Jewish man
crushed a woman's head between two stones and killed her, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had his head crushed between two stones.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There is no retaliation except by the sword."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Fire is without liability, and a well is without liability."
label: machine translation

segments_en: He came to the Prophet ﷺ after having castrated a slave of his, so the Prophet ﷺ freed the slave on account of the mutilation.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"The Muslims are one hand against all others; their blood is equal in value; the lowest of them can grant protection on behalf of the Muslims; and the farthest of them can return [plunder] on behalf of the Muslims."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do not prevent the female servants of Allah from the mosques of Allah, but let them go out without perfume."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The wife of ʿAbdullāh [reported] that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her not to touch perfume when she went out to the late evening prayer.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked ʿAlqamah whether Ibn Masʿūd had been present with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the night of the jinn. He said: ʿAlqamah said: I asked Ibn Masʿūd, "Was any of you present with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the night of the jinn?" He said: "No, but we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ one night and we missed him. We searched for him in the valleys and mountain passes, and we said, 'He has been carried off or assassinated.'" He said: "So we spent the worst night that a people have ever spent. When morning came, he came from the direction of Ḥirāʾ." He said: "We said, 'O Messenger of Allah, we missed you and searched for you but could not find you, so we spent the worst night that a people have ever spent.' He said:
'The caller of the jinn came to me, so I went with him and recited the Qurʾān to them.'"
He said: "Then he went with us and showed us their traces and the traces of their fires. They asked him for provisions, and he said:
'For you is every bone over which the name of Allah has been mentioned; it will fall into your hands with more meat on it than ever, and every dropping is fodder for your animals.'"
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"So do not clean yourselves with these two, for they are the food of your brothers."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ led us in the dawn prayer in Makkah. He began Sūrat al-Muʾminūn until the mention of Moses and Aaron, or the mention of Jesus (Muḥammad ibn ʿAbbād was unsure, or they differed about it from him), and a cough seized the Prophet ﷺ, so he bowed. ʿAbdullāh ibn as-Sāʾib was present at that.
In the narration of ʿAbd ar-Razzāq: "He cut it short and bowed."
And in his narration: "and ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr."
He did not say "Ibn al-ʿĀṣ."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite in the noon prayer "By the night when it covers" and in the afternoon prayer something similar, and in the dawn prayer longer than that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When one of you leads the people in prayer, let him make it light, for among the people are the weak, the sick, and those with needs."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The last thing the Messenger of Allah ﷺ charged me with was:
"When you lead a people in prayer, make the prayer light for them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I never prayed behind anyone whose prayer was shorter yet complete than the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was moderate, and the prayer of Abū Bakr was moderate. When ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb [became leader], he lengthened the dawn prayer. And when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Allah hears whoever praises Him,"
he would stand so long that we would say, "He has forgotten."
Then he would prostrate and sit between the two prostrations so long that we would say, "He has forgotten."
label: machine translation

segments_en: They used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When he bowed, they bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing and said:
"Allah hears whoever praises Him,"
we would remain standing until we saw that he had placed his face on the ground, then we would follow him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ, that he used to say:

"O Allah, to You belongs all praise, filling the heavens and filling the earth and filling whatever You will beyond that. O Allah, purify me with snow, hail, and cold water. O Allah, purify me from sins and wrongdoings as a white garment is cleansed of dirt."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to say in his prostration:
"O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last."
Ibn as-Sarḥ added: "the open and the secret."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked ʿAṭāʾ, "What do you say in bowing?" He said: "As for me, [I say], 'Glory and praise be to You; there is no god but You.' Ibn Abī Mulaykah informed me from ʿĀʾishah, who said: 'I missed the Prophet ﷺ one night and thought he had gone to one of his wives, so I searched, then returned, and there he was bowing or prostrating, saying:
"Glory and praise be to You; there is no god but You."
I said, 'May my father and mother be ransomed for you! I am in one state while you are in another.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: And ʿAmr an-Nāqid,
and Zuhayr ibn Ḥarb,
and Isḥāq ibn Ibrāhīm,
(the wording is ʿAmr's) Isḥāq said, "He informed us," and the others said, "Wakīʿ narrated to us,"
"Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to us,"
from Yazīd ibn al-Aṣamm,
from Maymūnah bint al-Ḥārith,
who said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated, he held his arms apart so much that the whiteness of his armpits could be seen by whoever was behind him.
Wakīʿ said: meaning their whiteness.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite in the Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr prayers "By the heaven and the knocker [at night]" (Sūrat al-Ṭāriq), "By the heaven containing great stars" (Sūrat al-Burūj), and similar sūrahs.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Does one of you go down in his prayer and kneel the way a camel kneels?"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations in the night prayer:
"My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, mend my condition, provide for me, and raise me in rank."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade three things: pecking like a crow, spreading the forearms like a beast of prey, and a man designating a particular place in the mosque for his prayer, as a camel designates its resting place.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He feared Ziyād or the son of Ziyād, so he came to Medina and met Abū Hurayrah. He said: He asked about my lineage and I told him. Then he said: "Young man, shall I not narrate to you a hadith?" I said: Yes, may Allah have mercy on you.
Yūnus said: I think he mentioned it from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:

"The first of their deeds for which people will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection is prayer. Our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, will say to His angels, though He knows best: 'Look at the prayer of My servant. Did he complete it or fall short in it?' If it is complete, it is recorded as complete for him; and if he has fallen short in anything, He will say: 'See whether My servant has any voluntary prayers.' If he has voluntary prayers, He will say: 'Complete the obligatory prayer of My servant from his voluntary prayers.' Then the rest of the deeds will be taken into account in the same way."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to Sulaymān: Should I make supplication in prayer when I pass a verse that inspires fear? He then narrated to me from Saʿd ibn ʿUbaydah, from Mustawrid, from Ṣilah ibn Zufar, from Ḥudhayfah, that he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ, and he used to say in his bowing:
"Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty," and in his prostration:
"Glory be to my Lord, the Most High."
And he never passed a verse of mercy without stopping at it and asking, nor a verse of punishment without stopping at it and seeking refuge.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When one of you bows, let him say in his bowing: 'Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty,'
three times. If he does so, his bowing is complete. And when one of you prostrates, let him say in his prostration: 'Glory be to my Lord, the Most High,' three times.
If he does so, his prostration is complete, and that is the minimum."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was praying with the door locked. Aḥmad said: I came and asked for it to be opened. Aḥmad said: He walked and opened it for me, then returned to his place of prayer.
And he mentioned that the door was in the direction of the qiblah.
label: machine translation

segments_en: One of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying and I greeted him with salām. He returned the greeting by a gesture, and I only know that he said: with his finger.
label: machine translation

segments_en: That he
saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sitting in prayer, with his right forearm placed on his right thigh, raising his index finger, which he had bent slightly, as he was making supplication.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat after the first two rakʿahs, it was as if he were sitting on hot stones.
Shuʿbah said: Then Saʿd moved his lips with something. I said: "Until he stands?" He said: "Until he stands."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ led them in prayer and made a mistake, so he performed two prostrations, then recited the tashahhud, then gave the salām.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Among the best of your days is Friday. On it Ādam, peace be upon him, was created, on it he was taken in death, on it the blast of the Trumpet will occur, and on it the stunning cry will occur. So send blessings upon me abundantly on that day, for your blessings are presented to me."
They said: O Messenger of Allah, how will our blessings be presented to you when your body has decayed? That is, they meant: it has worn away. He said:
"Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden the earth to consume the bodies of the Prophets, peace be upon them."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was present when Muʿāwiyah ibn Abī Sufyān was asking Zayd ibn Arqam: Did you witness two ʿīds coinciding on one day with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: Yes.
He asked: What did he do? He said: He prayed the ʿīd prayer, then granted a concession regarding the Friday prayer, saying:
"Whoever wishes to pray it, let him pray."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sitting hugging the knees with the arms or a cloth on Friday, meaning while the imam is delivering the sermon.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr, a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ, on a Friday, when a man came stepping over the necks of the people. ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr said: A man came stepping over people's necks on Friday while the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the sermon, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him:
"Sit down, for you have caused harm."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We used to fast ʿĀshūrāʾ and pay zakāt al-fiṭr. Then, when [the fasting of] Ramadan was revealed and zakāh was revealed, we were neither commanded to do it nor forbidden from it, and we continued to do it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He was delivering a sermon on your pulpit, meaning the pulpit of Basra, saying: The charity of fitr is one ṣāʿ of food.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"One dirham has surpassed one hundred thousand."
They said: O Messenger of Allah, how is that? He said:
"A man has two dirhams, so he takes one of them and gives it in charity; and another man has abundant wealth, so he takes one hundred thousand from the side of his wealth and gives it in charity."
label: machine translation

segments_en: We came to Medina, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was standing on the pulpit addressing the people, saying:
"The giving hand is the upper hand. Begin with those you support: your mother and your father, your sister and your brother, then the next closest, and the next closest." [Abridged]
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ conquered Mecca, he stood up to give a sermon and said in his sermon:
"It is not permissible for a woman to give a gift except with her husband's permission." [Abridged]
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man said: O Messenger of Allah, which charity is best? He said:
"That you give charity while you are healthy and stingy, hoping for a long life and fearing poverty."
label: machine translation

segments_en: One day we were sitting in the mosque, together with a group of the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār. We sent a man to ʿĀʾishah to ask permission, and we entered upon her. She said: A beggar once came to me while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was with me, so I ordered that something be given to him. Then I called him back and looked at him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do you not want that nothing enters your house and nothing leaves it except with your knowledge?" I said: Yes. He said:
"Gently, O ʿĀʾishah! Do not keep count, or Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will keep count against you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"The believer to the believer is like a building, each part strengthening the other." And he said:
"The trustworthy treasurer who gives what he is commanded to give, willingly and with a good heart, is one of the two who give charity."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"There are three whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will not look at on the Day of Resurrection: the one who is disobedient to his parents, the woman who imitates men, and the dayyūth. And there are three who will not enter Paradise: the one who is disobedient to his parents, the one who is addicted to wine, and the one who reminds others of what he has given."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do not turn away the beggar, even if [you give] a burnt hoof."
In the narration of Hārūn: "burnt."
label: machine translation

segments_en: No man comes to his master asking him for some of his surplus, and he withholds it from him, except that on the Day of Resurrection a bald-headed serpent will be summoned for him, licking its lips, [representing] his surplus that he withheld."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Shall I not tell you who is the best of people in position?"
We said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said:
"A man who holds the head of his horse in the cause of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, until he dies or is killed. And shall I tell you who comes next?"
We said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said:
"A man who withdraws to a mountain pass, establishes prayer, pays zakāh, and keeps away from the evils of people. And shall I tell you who is the worst of people?"
We said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said:
"The one who is asked by Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and does not give by it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There are three whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will not speak to on the Day of Resurrection: the old man who commits adultery, the arrogant poor man, and the lying ruler."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"There are four whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, hates: the seller who swears oaths excessively, the arrogant poor man, the old man who commits adultery, and the unjust ruler."
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man
came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him, and he gave him. When the man placed his foot on the threshold of the door, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"If you knew what is in begging, no one would walk to another to ask him for anything."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Who will guarantee one thing for me, and he will have Paradise?"
Yaḥyā said: Here there is a word whose meaning is that he should not ask people for anything.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever asks while he possesses forty dirhams is one who begs importunately."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and said:
"Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, has made Hajj obligatory upon you."
Al-Aqraʿ ibn Ḥābis at-Tamīmī said: Every year, O Messenger of Allah? He remained silent, then said:
"If I had said yes, it would have become obligatory. And then you would not listen or obey. Rather, it is one Hajj."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The jihād of the old, the young, the weak, and the woman is Hajj and ʿUmrah."
label: machine translation

segments_en: She was asked about the prayer of
the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she said:
He would lead the people in the ʿIshāʾ prayer,
then return to his family and pray four rakʿahs,
then retire to his bed.
Then he narrated the hadith in full, but did not mention:
that he made them equal in recitation, bowing and prostration.
And in the part about the closing salutation, he did not mention: until he woke us.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I spent a night at the home of the Prophet ﷺ to observe how he prayed. He got up, performed ablution, and then prayed two rakʿahs, his standing being like his bowing,
and his bowing like his prostration. Then he slept.

Then he woke up, performed ablution and cleaned his teeth, then recited five verses from Āl ʿImrān: {Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day...} He kept doing this until he had prayed ten rakʿahs.
Then he stood and prayed one more rakʿah, with which he made the prayer odd-numbered (witr).
Then the caller to prayer called out at that time,
and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ got up after the muezzin had fallen silent and prayed two light rakʿahs,
then he sat until he led the Fajr prayer.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I spent the night at the home of my maternal aunt Maymūnah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came after nightfall and said: "Has the boy prayed?" They said: Yes.
Then he lay down, until when as much of the night had passed as Allah willed, he got up and performed ablution,
then prayed seven or five rakʿahs, making them odd-numbered, and he gave the closing salutation only at the end of them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: In this account he said:
He got up and prayed two rakʿahs at a time,
until he had prayed eight rakʿahs,
then he prayed witr with five, without sitting between them.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I said to ʿĀʾishah, may Allah be pleased with her:
With how many rakʿahs did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray witr? She said:
He would pray witr with four and three, six and three, eight and three, or ten and three.
He would not pray witr with fewer than seven,
nor with more than thirteen.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He entered upon ʿĀʾishah and asked her about the night prayer of
the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She said:
He used to pray thirteen rakʿahs at night.
Then later he prayed eleven rakʿahs,
and left off two. Then he was taken, ﷺ, when he was taken, while praying nine rakʿahs at night,
and the last of his night prayer was the witr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I spent the night at the home of my maternal aunt Maymūnah. The Prophet ﷺ got up to pray at night and prayed thirteen rakʿahs, including the two rakʿahs of Fajr.
I estimated his standing in each rakʿah to be about the length of {O you who wrap yourself}. Nūḥ did not say:
including the two rakʿahs of Fajr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "
Take on only as much of deeds as you can bear,
for Allah does not grow weary until you grow weary,
and the most beloved deed to Allah is the most constant, even if it is small."
And whenever he did a deed, he kept to it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ sent for ʿUthmān ibn Maẓʿūn, and he came. He said: "
O ʿUthmān, have you turned away from my sunnah?" He said:
No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah,
rather it is your sunnah that I seek. He said: "
I sleep and I pray, I fast and I break my fast, and I marry women.
So fear Allah, O ʿUthmān,
for your family has a right over you,
and your guest has a right over you,
and your own self has a right over you. So fast and break your fast, pray and sleep."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The people used to pray in the mosque in Ramadan in scattered groups. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered me, so I set up a mat for him, and he prayed on it. With this account, she said in it that he said, meaning the Prophet ﷺ: "
O people, by Allah, I did not spend this night of mine, praise be to Allah, unaware, and your position was not hidden from me."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out and found some people in Ramadan praying in a corner of the mosque. He said: "Who are these?"
It was said: These are people who do not know the Qur'an, and Ubayy ibn Kaʿb is praying and they are praying with his prayer. The Prophet ﷺ said: "
They have done right, and excellent is what they have done."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was told, "Water is drawn for you from the well of Buḍāʿah," which is a well into which the flesh of dogs, menstrual rags, and human filth were thrown.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Water is pure; nothing makes it impure."
label: machine translation

segments_en: One of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ washed herself in a large basin, and the Prophet ﷺ came to perform ablution from it, or to wash himself. She said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, I was in a state of major impurity."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Water does not become impure."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ibn Masʿūd on the night of the jinn, "Do you have any water with you?"
He said, "No, only nabīdh in a small waterskin."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Good dates and pure water. Pour it over me."
He said, "So I poured it over him, and he performed ablution with it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw ʿAlī perform ablution. He washed his hands three times, rinsed his mouth and snuffed water into his nose three times, washed his face three times and his forearms three times each, wiped his head, and washed his feet three times each. He said, "This is the ablution of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he performed ablution, rub between the toes of his feet with his little finger.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution, then take a handful of water and sprinkle his private part with it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: He mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ was brought a small vessel and performed ablution.
I said, "Did the Prophet ﷺ perform ablution for every prayer?" He said, "Yes."
He said, "And what about you?" He replied, "We used to pray several prayers as long as we had not broken our ablution." He said, "We used to pray several prayers with one ablution."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It was read to Mālik while I was listening,
from Abū al-Naḍr,
from Sulaymān ibn Yasār,
from al-Miqdād ibn al-Aswad,
from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib,

may Allah be pleased with him, that he instructed him to ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a man who comes close to a woman and then emits prostatic fluid (madhī): "For his daughter is my wife, and I am too shy to ask him."
So he asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that, and he said:
"When one of you finds that, let him sprinkle his private part with water and perform his ablution as for prayer."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I used to suffer great hardship and distress from madhī, and I would wash very frequently because of it. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about it, and he said:
"Ablution is sufficient for you in that case."
I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what about what gets on my garment from it?" He said:
"It is enough for you to take a handful of water and sprinkle it on your garment wherever you see that it has touched it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: From my land, that Sahl ibn Saʿd al-Sāʿidī

informed him that Ubayy ibn Kaʿb told him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had made that a concession for the people at the beginning of Islam because of the scarcity of clothing; then he commanded washing and forbade that.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would be in a state of major impurity and then sleep without touching water, until he got up afterward and washed himself.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about a man who finds wetness but does not remember a dream. He said, "He should wash."
And about a man who thinks he has had a dream but finds no wetness, he said:
"No washing is required of him."
Umm Salamah said, "O Messenger of Allah, must a woman who sees that wash?" He said:
"Yes, women are the counterparts of men."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Under every hair there is impurity from sexual defilement, so wash the hair and cleanse the skin."
label: machine translation

segments_en: She
came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and complained to him about bleeding, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her:
"That is only a vein. So watch: when your period (qarʾ) comes, do not pray, and when your period has passed, purify yourself, then pray between one period and the next."
This is evidence that the aqrāʾ are menstrual periods.
label: machine translation

segments_en: [Ḥakīm said:] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he gave me; then I asked him and he gave me; then I asked him and he gave me. Then he said:

"O Ḥakīm, this wealth is green and sweet. Whoever takes it with a generous heart, it is blessed for him; and whoever takes it with a greedy soul, it is not blessed for him, and he is like one who eats but is never satisfied. The upper hand is better than the lower hand."
Ḥakīm said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, by the One who sent you with the truth, I will not take anything from anyone after you until I leave this world."

Abū Bakr used to call Ḥakīm to give him his allowance, but he refused to accept it. Then ʿUmar called him to give him something, but he refused to accept anything from him. So ʿUmar said, "O assembly of Muslims, I call you to witness concerning Ḥakīm: I offer him his right from this fayʾ (spoils), but he refuses to take it."
So Ḥakīm did not take anything from anyone after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until he died.
He said: This hadith is authentic.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the first circumambulation of the House, he would walk briskly for three rounds and walk normally for four, from the Black Stone to the Black Stone. Ibn ʿUmar used to do the same.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUrwah said: I asked ʿĀʾishah, may Allah be pleased with her, and said to her: What do you make of the words of Allah, the Exalted: "Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah; so whoever performs Hajj to the House or ʿUmrah, there is no blame upon him for walking between them"? By Allah, there is no blame on anyone who does not walk between Ṣafā and Marwah.
She said: What an evil thing you have said, my nephew! If it were as you have interpreted it, it would read: "there is no blame on him if he does not walk between them."
But it was revealed concerning the Anṣār.
Before they became Muslims, they used to enter the state of pilgrimage for Manāt, the false idol they worshipped at al-Mushallal.
So whoever did so would feel reluctant to walk between Ṣafā and Marwah.
When they became Muslims, they asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that. They said: O Messenger of Allah,
we used to feel reluctant to walk between Ṣafā and Marwah.
Then Allah, the Exalted, revealed: "Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah," the verse.
ʿĀʾishah, may Allah be pleased with her, said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ established the walking between them as a practice,
so no one may abandon walking between them.
Then I informed Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān,
and he said: This is knowledge I had not heard.
But I have heard men of knowledge
mention that the people, except those whom ʿĀʾishah mentioned, who used to enter the state of pilgrimage for Manāt,
all used to walk between Ṣafā and Marwah.
Then when Allah, the Exalted, mentioned circumambulation of the House
and did not mention Ṣafā and Marwah in the Qurʾān, they said: O Messenger of Allah, we used to walk between Ṣafā and Marwah,
and Allah has revealed the circumambulation of the House,
but He did not mention Ṣafā; is there any blame on us if we walk between Ṣafā and Marwah? So Allah, the Exalted, revealed: "Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah," the verse.
Abū Bakr said: So hear this: the verse was revealed concerning both groups, those who felt reluctant to walk between Ṣafā and Marwah in the Jāhiliyyah,
and those who used to walk between them and then felt reluctant to do so in Islam, because Allah, the Exalted, had commanded circumambulation of the House
and had not mentioned Ṣafā, until He mentioned it after He had mentioned circumambulation of the House.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Sawdah asked permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the night of Muzdalifah to depart before him and before the crowding of the people, and she was a heavy woman. Al-Qāsim said: "thabiṭah" means heavy. [ʿĀʾishah] said: So he permitted her, and she left before his departure, while we were kept back until morning and then departed with his departure. For me to have asked permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as Sawdah asked, and so to depart with his permission, would be dearer to me than anything I could rejoice in.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I myself twisted

those garlands from wool that we had. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spent the morning among us in a state of lawfulness, doing what a man who is lawful does with his wife, or [she said:] what a man does with his wife.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever does not give up false speech and acting upon it, Allah has no need of his giving up his food and drink."
Aḥmad said: I understood its chain of narration from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, and a man beside him, whom I think was his nephew, helped me understand the hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Prophet ﷺ. (Transfer of chain.) And ʿAbdullāh ibn Maslamah narrated to us, from Mālik, from Hishām, from his father,
from ʿĀʾishah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would kiss some of his wives while fasting. Then she laughed.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever buys palm trees after they have been pollinated, their fruit belongs to the seller,
unless the buyer stipulates otherwise.
And whoever buys a slave who has property, his property belongs to the one who sold him, unless the buyer stipulates otherwise."
And from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from ʿUmar, concerning the slave:
label: machine translation

segments_en: that her mother, Umm Salamah, may Allah be pleased with her, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, informed her from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he heard a dispute at the door of his chamber, so he went out to them and said:
"I am only a human being, and litigants come to me.
Perhaps some of you may be more eloquent than others,
so I think that he is truthful
and I judge in his favor accordingly.
So whoever I judge for, [giving him] something that is the right of a Muslim, it is only a piece of the Fire,
so let him take it or leave it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: that the Prophet ﷺ — ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ — said:
"Indeed, Allah the Exalted has overlooked for my Ummah whatever their souls whisper to them, so long as they do not speak it or act upon it."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with them both, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of walāʾ and its gifting.
label: machine translation

segments_en: My foster uncle came and asked permission to enter upon me, but I refused to admit him until I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and I asked him about that, and he said:
"He is your uncle, so admit him."
She said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, it was only the woman who nursed me, not the man."
She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you."
ʿĀʾishah said: That was after the hijāb had been imposed upon us.
ʿĀʾishah said: What is prohibited through birth is prohibited through nursing.
label: machine translation

segments_en: ʿUmar acquired a piece of land in Khaybar, so he came to the Prophet ﷺ to seek his counsel about it. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have acquired land in Khaybar, and I have never acquired any wealth more precious to me than it. What do you command me to do with it?" He said:
"If you wish, you may keep its principal and give its yield in charity."
He said: So ʿUmar gave it in charity, on the condition that its principal would not be sold, bought, inherited, or given away.

He said: ʿUmar gave it in charity for the poor, for relatives, for freeing slaves, in the cause of Allah, for the wayfarer, and for the guest. There is no blame on whoever manages it if he eats from it in a reasonable manner or feeds a friend, without seeking to accumulate wealth from it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: It was asked, "O Messenger of Allah,

" And Muḥammad ibn Yūsuf said: Al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, al-Zuhrī narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yazīd al-Laythī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which of the people is best?" He said:
"A man who strives with his own self and his wealth,
and a man in one of the mountain passes who worships his Lord
and leaves people safe from his evil."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Read to him while I listened,
from Ibn al-Qāsim,
who said: Mālik narrated to me,
from Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥah,
from Anas ibn Mālik,

who said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to Qubāʾ, he would visit Umm Ḥarām bint Milḥān, and she would feed him. Umm Ḥarām bint Milḥān was married to ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit. One day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited her and she fed him, then she sat delousing his head. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ slept, then woke up laughing. She said: I asked, "What makes you laugh, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"Some people of my Ummah were shown to me as fighters in the cause of Allah, riding the middle of this sea like kings on thrones, or like kings on thrones." Isḥāq was unsure [of the wording].

I said, "O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicated for her, then slept again — and al-Ḥārith said, "and he slept" — then woke up and laughed. I said to him, "What makes you laugh, O Messenger of Allah?" He said:
"Some people of my Ummah were shown to me as fighters in the cause of Allah, kings on thrones, or like kings on thrones,"
as he had said the first time. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them." He said:
"You are among the first."
She then sailed the sea in the time of Muʿāwiyah, and was thrown from her mount when she came out of the sea, and she died.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed with my father, so we brought food closer to him and he ate from it. Then dates were brought, and he would eat them and throw the date stones between his two fingers, joining the index and middle fingers. Shuʿbah said: this is my assumption, Allah willing, that he threw the stones between two fingers. Then a drink was brought and he drank it, then passed it to the one on his right. [The narrator] said: My father, holding the bridle of his mount, said, "Supplicate for us." So he said:
"O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy on them."
He said: This is a ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ hadith.
It has also been narrated through another route from ʿAbdullāh ibn Busr.
label: machine translation

segments_en: that the Prophet ﷺ asked his family for condiment, and they said, "We have nothing but vinegar."
So he called for it and began to eat with it, saying:
"What an excellent condiment vinegar is! What an excellent condiment vinegar is!"
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with her, she said: The pillow of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, on which he slept at night—Ibn Manīʿ said this, then the two agreed—was made of leather, stuffed with palm fibre.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh,
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him:
"One bed for a man, one bed for his wife, a third for the guest, and the fourth for the devil."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a silver ring that he wore on his right hand. Its stone was Abyssinian, and he would set the stone toward his palm.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, or: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:

"When the strap of one of you breaks, or: whoever's sandal strap breaks, let him not walk in a single sandal until he repairs the strap, nor walk in a single leather sock, nor eat with his left hand, nor sit wrapped in a single garment with his knees drawn up, nor wrap himself up completely in a garment leaving no opening for the arms."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"When one of you lies on his back, let him not place one of his legs over the other."
This is a hadith narrated by more than one person from Sulaymān al-Taymī.
This Khidāsh is not known, who he is, and Sulaymān al-Taymī has narrated more than one hadith from him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade using saffron perfume.
Qutaybah said: Ḥammād said, meaning for men.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū Quḥāfah was brought on the day of the conquest of Makkah, and his head and beard were as white as thaghāmah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Change this with something, but avoid black."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to name our slaves with four names: Aflaḥ, Rabāḥ, Yasār, and Nāfiʿ.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Whoever looks into the house of a people without their permission, and they put out his eye, there is no blood-money for him and no retaliation."
label: machine translation

segments_en: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a sudden glance, and he commanded me to turn my gaze away.
label: machine translation

segments_en: that Jibrīl
came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Muḥammad, are you ailing?" He said, "Yes."

He said: "In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you."
label: machine translation

segments_en: that Umm Salamah,
the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, asked permission of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for cupping, and the Prophet ﷺ commanded Abū Ṭaybah to cup her.
He said: I think he was her foster brother, or a boy who had not yet reached puberty.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the family of al-Sharīd, called ʿAmr, from his father, who said: Among the delegation of Thaqīf was a man with leprosy, so the Prophet ﷺ sent word to him:
"Go back, for I have accepted your pledge."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the killing of the gecko, and called it a little transgressor.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever is offered basil should not refuse it, for it is light to carry and pleasant in scent."
label: machine translation

segments_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said:
"Whoever plays backgammon is as though he has dyed his hand in the flesh and blood of a pig."
label: machine translation

segments_en: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"A good dream is from Allah and a bad dream is from the devil. If one of you sees something he dislikes, let him spit to his left three times, seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil three times, and turn over from the side he was lying on."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had hair reaching the lobes of his ears, and I saw him in a red garment; I never saw anything more beautiful than him.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mixing unripe dates with ripe dates, or raisins with ripe dates, or raisins with unripe dates, and he said:
"Whoever among you drinks it, let him drink each one by itself: ripe dates by themselves, or unripe dates by themselves, or raisins by themselves."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ said to the delegation of ʿAbd al-Qays:

"I forbid you from [using] gourd containers, green glazed jars, hollowed palm-trunks, and pitch-coated vessels" — and the ḥantam is the waterskin with its neck cut off — "but drink from your waterskin and tie it shut."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Ibn al-Zubayr was asked about nabīdh prepared in earthen jars,
and he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Abū al-Zubayr said: I heard Jābir

say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade pitch-coated jars, gourd containers, and hollowed palm-trunks. And when the Prophet ﷺ could not find a waterskin in which nabīdh could be prepared for him, it was prepared for him in a stone basin.
label: machine translation

segments_en: A man

from Jayshān — and Jayshān is in Yemen — came and asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a drink that they drink in their land, made from corn, called al-mizr. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Is it intoxicating?" He said: Yes.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Every intoxicant is forbidden. Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has made a covenant with whoever drinks an intoxicant that He will give him to drink from the clay of khabāl."
They said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the clay of khabāl? He said:
"The sweat of the people of the Fire," or he said, "the discharge of the people of the Fire."
label: machine translation

segments_en: [It was] read to him while I was listening,
and the wording is his, on the authority of Ibn al-Qāsim,
who said: Mālik narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ,
from Ibn ʿUmar,
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever drinks wine in this world and does not repent from it, will be deprived of it in the Hereafter."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him. He said: Umm Sulaym had a cup made of ʿaydān wood, and she said: I gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ every kind of drink in it: water, honey, milk, and nabīdh.
label: machine translation

segments_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he asked for something to drink. A man said: O Messenger of Allah, shall we not give you nabīdh to drink? He said: "Yes."
He said: The man went out hurrying and came with a cup containing nabīdh. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Why did you not cover it, even by laying a stick across it?" He said: Then he drank.
label: machine translation

segments_en: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said:

"Cover the vessel, tie the waterskin shut, close the door, and put out the lamp. For the Shaytan does not untie a waterskin, does not open a door, and does not uncover a vessel. And if one of you finds nothing but to lay a stick across his vessel and mention the name of Allah, let him do so. For the little rodent can set the house ablaze over its occupants."
And Qutaybah did not mention in his narration, "close the door."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Do not let your livestock and your children go out when the sun has set, until the darkness of early night has passed. For the devils spread out when the sun sets, until the darkness of early night has passed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: When we attended a meal with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, none of us would put his hand [in the food] until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began. Once we attended a meal with him, and a Bedouin came as if he were being driven, and went to put his hand in the food, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ seized his hand. Then a girl came as if she were being driven, and went to put her hand in the food, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ seized her hand. And he said:

"Indeed, the Shaytan makes food lawful for himself when the name of Allah has not been mentioned over it. He brought this Bedouin to make it lawful for himself through him, so I seized his hand; and he brought this girl to make it lawful through her, so I seized her hand. By the One in whose hand is my soul, his hand is in my hand along with their hands."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to breathe three times while drinking, and he would say:
"It is more quenching, healthier, and more wholesome."
Anas said: So I breathe three times while drinking.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to eat with three fingers, and he would lick his hand before wiping it.
label: machine translation

segments_en: When one of you eats, let him lick his fingers, for he does not know in which of them the blessing lies."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ sent me, and when I returned to him, I found him eating dates while sitting on his haunches.
label: machine translation

segments_en: Three [people] Allah will not speak to on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He look at them: a man who swore an oath about merchandise that he had been offered more for it than he was actually offered, and he was lying;
and a man who swore a false oath after the ʿAṣr prayer in order to seize the property of a Muslim man;
and a man who withheld his surplus water. Allah will say on the Day of Resurrection:
'Today I withhold My favor from you,
just as you withheld the surplus of what your hands did not make.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Prophet ﷺ called the Anṣār to write [a grant of land] for them in Bahrain. They said: "No, by Allah, not unless you write for our brothers of Quraysh the like of it."
He said: "That is for them as Allah wills," and they kept saying that to him. Then he said:
"You will see after me preferential treatment [of others over you],
so be patient until you meet me at the Pond."
label: machine translation

segments_en: It is among the rights of camels that they be milked at the water."
label: machine translation

segments_en: and that they not be sold except for dinars and dirhams, except for the ʿarāyā.
label: machine translation

segments_en: I went on a military expedition with the Prophet ﷺ, and he said:
"How do you find your camel? Will you sell it to me?" I said: "Yes." So I sold it to him.
When he reached Medina, I went to him in the morning with the camel, and he gave me its price.
label: machine translation
